cadenas.Abrillantado de piso de mármol con pulid: Buffing of a marble floor with mechanical polishing and crystallizing. Includes the polishing, the crystallizing and the final buffing. Measured per square meter polished.
cadenas.Acabado de fachada aislada con mortero d: Finishing of an insulated facade with a protective stucco and mesh, ready for the final coating.
Rendered finish to an insulated facade.
cadenas.Acabado de juntas y remates de un trasdo: Finishing of the joints and trim of an already installed gypsum board lining, as a separate item. Includes going over the joints with compound and tape, filling the screw heads, sanding the joints and finishing the junctions with the walls and the ceiling. Measured per square meter of surface treated.
cadenas.Acabado de superficie de concreto estruc: Finishing of the surface of structural concrete. Includes troweling and finishing. Measured per square meter finished.
cadenas.Acabado decorativo tipo estuco veneciano: Decorative lime based Venetian plaster finish, applied in several coats with a spatula over a prepared interior substrate, with a final burnishing that produces the characteristic sheen. It is a purely finishing trade where the result depends almost entirely on the hand of the applicator, so a sample approved by the client should be done before starting on the bay. Includes preparing and sealing the substrate, applying the successive coats with the spatula, the burnishing and the final protective waxing. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Acabado superficial de la losa mediante: Surface finish of the slab by power troweling and its subsequent curing. Includes the initial screeding and floating, power troweling in as many passes as are needed to obtain the texture required according to whether it is to receive an adhered floor or to be left exposed, saw cutting the shrinkage joints at the right moment, and curing with a curing membrane or continuous watering over the first few days, without which the slab cracks by plastic shrinkage however well it has been poured. Measured by the area actually finished.
Finishing and curing of a foundation slab.
cadenas.Acabado y curado de losa de fundación. I: Finishing and curing of a mat foundation. Includes troweling and curing. Measured per square meter constructed.
cadenas.Accesorio de baño (toallero, jabonera, e: Bathroom accessory, such as a towel rail or soap dish.
cadenas.Acera de concreto de 8 cm sobre base com: Concrete sidewalk 8 cm thick on a compacted base, with control joints and a non-slip finish, with the cross fall for drainage. Includes setting out levels and falls, the perimeter formwork, placing the mesh, pouring and screeding, the finish, saw cutting or forming the control joints at the spacing indicated and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Achique de agua en excavación con bomba: Dewatering of an excavation with a submersible pump. Includes placing the pump and dewatering. Measured per cubic meter pumped out.
Irrigation service connection with a shut-off valve.
cadenas.Acometida eléctrica desde el punto de su: Electrical service from the supply point.
cadenas.Acometida eléctrica provisional de obra: Temporary electrical supply for the works, with a distribution panel.
Temporary electrical supply for the works with a distribution panel. Includes running the cable and the panel. Measured per supply actually installed.
Temporary electrical supply for the works.
cadenas.Acometida eléctrica subterránea. Incluye: Underground electrical service connection. Includes laying and the connection. Measured per service connection constructed.
cadenas.Acometida provisional de agua de obra. I: Temporary water supply for the works. Includes connecting to the main and the main stop valve. Measured per supply actually installed.
Storage of debris in stacked sacks.
cadenas.Acopio de escombro en sacos de rafia api: Storage of debris in stacked woven sacks in a delimited area, awaiting removal.
cadenas.Acopio de tierra en obra para su reutili: Stockpiling of soil on site for reuse. Includes stockpiling and protection. Measured per cubic meter stockpiled.
cadenas.Acopio provisional de tierra en obra par: Temporary stockpiling of soil on site for reuse.
cadenas.Acopio y reutilización de tierra en obra: Stockpiling and reuse of soil on site.
cadenas.Adecuación de foso de ascensor. Incluye: Preparation of the elevator pit. Includes preparing the pit. Measured per pit prepared.
cadenas.Adecuación de hueco para ascensor. Inclu: Preparation of the hoistway for an elevator. Includes preparing the hoistway. Measured per hoistway prepared.
cadenas.Adecuación de zona de vestuario y comedo: Fitting out of a site changing and canteen area, with furniture and basic services.
Fitting out of a changing and canteen area.
Air source heat pump for domestic hot water.
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto aligerado con anime: Lightweight concrete fill with polystyrene EPS as filler, for leveling floors. Includes the field layout, the casting and the leveling. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto de 8 cm de espesor: Concrete fill of 8 cm thickness with welded wire shrinkage mesh, poured over a compacted crushed stone base and a vapor barrier, with sawn control joints. Includes checking the base, laying the vapor barrier and the mesh on spacers, pouring and vibrating, ruling off to level, floating, sawing the control joints at the right moment, which is what prevents unplanned shrinkage cracking, and curing. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto sobre terreno, 8 cm: 8 cm concrete bed on the ground.
cadenas.Afirmado de mortero de cemento y arena d: Cement and sand mortar bed of 4 cm average thickness, screeded and ruled off, laid over a slab or a compacted base to receive the floor finish. This is the layer that sets the final level and flatness of the floor, so any defects left here are carried through to the whole of the subsequent finish. Includes cleaning and wetting the substrate, placing the screeds at the design level, laying and ruling off the mortar, floating the surface and curing over the first few days. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Agotamiento del agua acumulada en la exc: Dewatering of water accumulated in the excavation with a submersible pump and discharge hose to an authorized point, to allow the work to be carried out in the dry. It applies where groundwater, seepage or accumulated rainwater is encountered. Includes siting the pump at the low point, running the discharge hose to a point where the discharge will neither erode nor flood other areas, monitoring the operation, periodic cleaning of the suction strainer and removal of the equipment. Measured per hour of actual operation of the equipment.
Acoustic insulation of a party wall.
cadenas.Aislamiento acústico de tabique con lana: Acoustic insulation of a partition with mineral wool.
cadenas.Aislamiento acústico en tabique o cielo: Acoustic insulation in a partition or ceiling.
cadenas.Aislamiento de cubierta con manta reflec: Roof deck insulation with a reflective membrane.
cadenas.Aislamiento de cubierta plana con lana m: Flat roof insulation with mineral wool.
cadenas.Aislamiento de entrepiso entre viviendas: Insulation of an intermediate floor between dwellings.
cadenas.Aislamiento de fachada con lana mineral: Facade insulation with sprayed mineral wool.
Impact sound insulation to a floor.
cadenas.Aislamiento de los conductos de climatiz: Insulation of the HVAC ductwork, to prevent energy loss.
cadenas.Aislamiento de pared medianera con lana: Insulation of a party wall with rock wool.
cadenas.Aislamiento de piso con manta reflectiva: Floor insulation with a reflective membrane.
cadenas.Aislamiento de piso con panel rígido de: Floor insulation with rigid mineral wool board.
cadenas.Aislamiento de piso sobre cámara sanitar: Insulation of a floor over a crawl space.
cadenas.Aislamiento de puente térmico en vigas o: Insulation of a thermal bridge at beams or columns, with polystyrene boards. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
Insulation of thermal bridges at beams.
cadenas.Aislamiento de servicio de gas existente: Isolation of the existing gas service.
cadenas.Aislamiento de techo de entrepiso no aco: Insulation of the roof over an unconditioned intermediate floor.
Insulation of a roof between joists.
cadenas.Aislamiento del servicio de gas existent: Isolation of the existing gas service, by shutting off and temporarily capping the line. Includes closing the gas valve and capping it securely. Measured per service isolated.
cadenas.Aislamiento reflectivo de techo metálico: Reflective insulation to a metal roof.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico bajo losa de fundaci: Thermal insulation beneath a foundation slab.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico bajo techo inclinado: Thermal insulation beneath a pitched roof.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de conducto de clima: Thermal insulation of an HVAC duct.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cubierta con lana: Thermal insulation of a roof deck with mineral wool.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cubierta con pane: Thermal insulation of a roof deck with sandwich panels.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cubierta plana co: Thermal insulation of a flat roof with polystyrene.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cubierta transita: Thermal insulation of a trafficable roof deck.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de cámara de aire co: Thermal insulation of an air cavity with a reflective layer.
Thermal insulation of a water tank.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de fachada con panel: Thermal insulation of a facade with sandwich panels.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de fachada por el ex: External thermal insulation of a facade.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de losa con poliesti: Thermal insulation of a slab with polystyrene.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de muro con lana de: Thermal insulation of a wall with rock wool.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de muro con poliesti: Thermal insulation of a wall with extruded polystyrene.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de muro por el inter: Internal thermal insulation of a wall.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de piso con poliesti: Thermal insulation of a floor with polystyrene.
Thermal insulation of a radiant floor heating system.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de tabique con doble: Thermal insulation of a partition with a double panel.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico de techo con poliest: Thermal insulation of a roof with polystyrene.
Thermal insulation to a roof deck.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico reflectivo bajo cubi: Reflective thermal insulation beneath a roof.
cadenas.Aislamiento térmico reflectivo en fachad: Reflective thermal insulation on a facade.
cadenas.Ajuste de portón corredizo, con reajuste: Adjustment of a sliding gate, re-adjusting the carriers, guides and stops. Includes checking and re-adjusting. Measured per unit adjusted.
cadenas.Ajuste de puerta descolgada o que roza,: Adjustment of a door that has dropped or is binding, by re-adjusting the hinges. Includes checking and re-adjusting the hardware. Measured per unit adjusted.
Adjustment of a door that has dropped on its hinges.
Eaves of a metal sheet roof.
Eaves and edge trim of a roof.
cadenas.Alisado de paramento con pasta de nivela: Smoothing of a surface with leveling compound.
cadenas.Alisado de paramento existente mediante: Smoothing of an existing substrate by applying leveling compound with a trowel, to correct minor irregularities, roller marks, a fine textured finish or the remains of previous finishes, leaving the surface flat. It is the economical alternative to hacking off and re-plastering when the substrate is sound but has a texture or surface defects. Includes scraping the loose parts, applying the stabilizing primer, spreading the compound in one or two coats depending on the defect to be corrected, sanding with extraction and the final going over. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Alquiler de baño portátil de obra, por m: Rental of a portable site toilet, per month. Includes supply and cleaning. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Alquiler de contenedor de residuos mezcl: Hire of a container for mixed non-recoverable waste, including delivery and collection for landfill.
cadenas.Alquiler de contenedor destinado a chata: Hire of a container for scrap metal, including delivery and collection for handover to the waste carrier.
cadenas.Alquiler de contenedor destinado a resid: Hire of a container for lumber waste, including delivery and collection for recycling.
cadenas.Alquiler mensual de baño químico portáti: Monthly hire of a portable chemical toilet, including its maintenance and cleaning.
cadenas.Alquiler mensual de contenedor de escomb: Monthly hire of a 3 m³ debris container, including delivery and collection by the waste carrier.
Extension of a slab as a cantilever or balcony.
cadenas.Ampliación de losa existente en voladizo: Extension of an existing slab as a cantilever or the formation of a balcony, tied into the structure by chemically anchoring the continuity bars. The connection is the critical point: a cantilever works with the steel in the top face and with the full anchorage length within the existing slab, so the depth and the position of the holes admit no approximation. Includes shoring, hacking back and cleaning the existing edge, drilling and chemically anchoring the bars, the reinforcement, the formwork on shores, pouring and vibrating, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the area actually constructed.
Anchoring of a bar with epoxy resin.
cadenas.Anclaje de barra de acero en elemento de: Anchoring of a steel bar into an existing concrete element with two-component epoxy resin injected into the hole, to connect new elements to the existing structure. Includes setting out the point and avoiding the existing reinforcement by scanning beforehand, drilling to the diameter and depth specified by the resin manufacturer, cleaning the hole by repeated blowing out and brushing, the operation on which the capacity of the anchor depends entirely and the one most often skipped on site, injecting the resin from the bottom, inserting the bar with a twisting motion and respecting the curing time before loading it. Measured per unit actually constructed.
cadenas.Anclaje de estructura de techo a la losa: Anchoring of a roof structure to the slab.
cadenas.Anclaje químico de barra de acero en con: Chemical anchoring of a steel bar in concrete.
Chemical anchoring of a bar in concrete.
cadenas.Anclaje químico o mecánico de la estruct: Chemical or mechanical anchoring of the roof structure to the slab or supporting beam, with anchor bolts. Includes drilling and fixing.
cadenas.Andamio colgante o silleta para trabajos: Swing stage for work on a facade.
cadenas.Andamio colgante para trabajos en fachad: Swing stage for work on a facade.
cadenas.Andamio interior móvil o sobre borriquet: Mobile scaffold or trestle scaffold indoors.
cadenas.Andamio interior rodante o plataforma so: Mobile indoor scaffold or trestle platform for work at height indoors, such as ceilings, plaster on high walls and painting. Includes delivery of the equipment to site, its erection and leveling, the installation of guardrails where the working height requires it, successive repositioning and height adjustment through the working day, dismantling and removal. Measured by the area of ceiling or wall surface actually reached from the scaffold.
cadenas.Andamio tubular de fachada con plataform: Tubular scaffold to a facade with working platforms.
cadenas.Andamio tubular de fachada, montaje, alq: Tubular scaffold to a facade, including erection, monthly hire and dismantling.
cadenas.Andamio tubular metálico apoyado en fach: Tubular steel scaffold bearing on the facade, with working platforms, guardrails, toe boards and an internal access stair, including its erection, the first month on hire and its dismantling. Includes the prior assessment of the bearing and of the ties to the facade, erection by competent personnel, the installation of the collective protective measures, inspection of the whole assembly before it is brought into service and after any modification, orderly dismantling and removal of the material. It does not include hire beyond the first month, which is priced in the following item. Measured by the area of facade actually covered by the scaffold.
cadenas.Apeo de cubierta o techo durante trabajo: Shoring of a roof during strengthening work. Includes placing the shores. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a lintel while an opening is formed.
cadenas.Apeo de dintel durante la apertura de va: Shoring of a lintel while the opening is formed. Includes placing the shores. Measured per linear meter shored.
Shoring to the formwork of a beam.
cadenas.Apeo de escalera existente durante traba: Shoring of an existing stair during strengthening work. Includes placing the shores. Measured per linear meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de fachada durante demolición parci: Shoring of a facade during partial demolition.
Shoring of a facade during partial demolition. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de losa con puntales metálicos y du: Shoring of a slab with steel shores and spreader beams.
Shoring of a slab with steel shores and spreader beams. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with shores and spreader beams.
cadenas.Apeo de losa con torres de carga metálic: Shoring of a slab with steel load towers. Includes erecting the towers. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with load towers.
Shoring of a beam with steel shores.
cadenas.Apeo de viga con puntales metálicos. Inc: Shoring of a beam with steel shores. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per linear meter shored.
Shoring of a beam with shores.
cadenas.Apeo o arriostramiento provisional de mu: Temporary shoring or bracing of a wall using raking shores with spreader beams, to stabilize it against thrust or overturning while work goes on around it. Must follow the instruction of the engineer or architect in charge. Includes setting out the bearing points, preparing the spreader bases on the floor, erecting and loading the raking shores, periodically checking stability and tightness, and dismantling once the element has been made good. Measured over the area of wall actually shored.
Temporary shoring or bracing of a wall.
cadenas.Apeo provisional de losa mediante puntal: Temporary shoring of a slab with telescopic steel shores on spreader beams at head and base, to support the structure while demolition, openings or strengthening are carried out. It must be carried out to a calculation or to the express instruction of the responsible professional, who defines the spacing and the load on the shores. Includes field layout of the shoring grid, placing the spreader beams, erecting and loading the shores without forcing the structure, checking plumb and bearing, maintenance and inspection during the works, and the staged removal of the shoring once the specified strength has been reached. Measured by the area of slab actually shored.
cadenas.Apeo provisional de viga mediante puntal: Temporary shoring of a beam with telescopic steel shores and a spreader beam at the head, placed on both sides of the element being worked on. It must be carried out to a calculation or to the instruction of the responsible professional. Includes field layout of the shoring points, placing the spreader beams, erecting and progressively loading the shores, checking that the load is transferred to a bearing of sufficient capacity at the level below, inspection during the works and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the length of beam actually shored.
cadenas.Apeo y soporte de encofrado de viga. Inc: Shoring and support to the formwork of a beam. Includes placing the shores. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apertura de cata de reconocimiento en pa: Exploratory opening in a wall, roughly 30x30 cm, to identify the type of substrate, its thickness or the presence of concealed services before the work is designed. Includes scanning beforehand with an electronic detector so as not to drill into a live pipe or cable, carefully breaking out layer by layer until the element being sought is exposed, photographic recording of what is found, and patching the opening with repair mortar so the face is left ready for its finish. Measured per opening actually carried out.
cadenas.Apertura de cata de reconocimiento en pi: Exploratory opening in a floor or slab, roughly 40x40 cm, to identify the thickness and condition of the sub-base, whether waterproofing is present, or whether services are buried below, before the work is defined. Includes scanning beforehand with a detector, cutting around the perimeter with a disc saw for a clean edge, breaking out layer by layer and recording the thickness of each, photographic recording, and reinstating the opening with repair mortar finished flush with the existing level. Measured per opening actually carried out.
cadenas.Apertura de hueco en losa de concreto ar: Formation of an opening in a reinforced concrete slab for a stair, a services duct or a rooflight, by a perimeter cut with a diamond blade and demolition of the interior with an electric breaker. Includes the prior structural validation and strengthening of the edge where the design requires it, shoring the area, setting out and the perimeter cut that gives a clean edge without cracking running into the rest of the slab, cutting the reinforcement, lowering the debris under control and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area of opening actually formed.
Formation of an opening in a reinforced concrete slab.
cadenas.Apertura de hueco en losa de fundación p: Formation of an opening in a mat foundation for services to pass through, by cutting and demolition. Includes setting out, the perimeter cut and demolition of the panel. Measured per square meter of opening.
Formation of an opening in a foundation slab.
cadenas.Apertura de nicho u hornacina en pared d: Formation of a recess or niche in a masonry wall to house shelves, switchboards, equipment or decorative elements, with the jambs and the back made good. Includes checking beforehand that the wall is not loadbearing and that no services run within the area of the niche, the perimeter cut with a blade to obtain straight edges, controlled hacking out in layers, making good and plumbing the jambs and the back, forming the head where the span requires it and removing the debris. It does not include the stucco or the internal finish. Measured per recess actually formed.
Formation of a recess in a wall.
cadenas.Apertura de regata para cable en piso. I: Cutting a chase for a cable in a floor. Includes forming the chase. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Apertura de regata para tubería en pared: Cutting a chase for a pipe in a wall. Includes forming the chase. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Apertura de roza en bloque de arcilla. I: Cutting a chase in a clay block wall. Includes forming the chase. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Apertura de roza en muro de concreto par: Cutting a chase in a concrete wall for services. Includes setting out, forming it and clearing away. Measured per meter of chase.
Formation of a chase in a concrete wall.
cadenas.Apertura de roza en muro de concreto. In: Cutting a chase in a concrete wall. Includes forming the chase. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Apertura de roza en pared de bloque para: Cutting a chase in a blockwork wall for services. Includes forming the chase. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Apertura de roza en techo para instalaci: Cutting a chase in a ceiling for services. Includes forming the chase. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Apertura de rozas en pared de bloque o l: Cutting chases in a block or brick wall for services to run through. Includes setting out, forming the chase and clearing away. Measured per meter of chase.
cadenas.Apertura de rozas en pared para instalac: Formation of chases in a wall for services.
cadenas.Apertura de vano en muro de concreto, co: Formation of an opening in a concrete wall, by cutting and demolition. Includes setting out, the perimeter cut and demolition of the panel. Measured per meter of opening.
Formation of an opening in a concrete wall.
cadenas.Apertura de vano en pared de bloque o la: Formation of an opening in a blockwork or brick wall.
cadenas.Apertura de vano para puerta, ventana o: Formation of an opening for a door, window or doorway in an existing block or brick wall, by a perimeter cut with a diamond blade and demolition of the interior with an electric breaker. Includes setting out the opening, temporarily supporting the masonry over with shores before demolition starts, the perimeter cut that gives straight jambs without tearing into the rest of the wall, controlled demolition from the top down, removing the debris and making good the jambs plumb. It does not include the final lintel or the making good of the jambs, which are priced separately. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area of opening actually formed.
cadenas.Apertura y tapado de paso de instalación: Forming and making good a penetration for services in a slab. Includes forming the penetration and making good. Measured per meter constructed.
Forming and making good a penetration for services in a wall. Includes forming the penetration and making good. Measured per meter constructed.
Opening up and making good a penetration in a slab.
Opening up and making good a penetration in a wall.
cadenas.Apertura, limpieza y sellado de fisuras: Opening up, cleaning and sealing cracks in the surface of the roof before applying the waterproofing, with elastic sealant and a reinforcing strip. Waterproofing over an untreated crack does not solve it: the movement is transmitted to the membrane and cracks it along the same line before long. Includes mapping the cracks, chasing them out, cleaning and vacuuming, priming, filling with elastic sealant and laying the embedded reinforcing strip. Measured by the length of crack actually treated.
cadenas.Apertura, saneado y sellado de fisuras e: Opening up, making good and sealing cracks in a substrate before painting, with flexible sealant and reinforcing tape on the wider ones. Painting over an untreated crack only hides it for a few weeks: it reappears along the same line as soon as the substrate moves, and the client reads it as a fault in the paint. Includes mapping the cracks, chasing them out to give the sealant somewhere to sit, cleaning and vacuuming, priming, filling with flexible sealant, reinforcing with tape on the live cracks and sanding the transition. Measured by the length of crack actually treated.
Decorative metal paneling on a wall.
cadenas.Aplacado de paramento con lámina o panel: Cladding of a substrate with decorative metal sheet or panel, with mechanical fixing. Includes the preparation, fixing the panel and finishing the joints. Measured per square meter clad.
cadenas.Aplicación de abono y fertilizante sobre: Application of soil conditioner and fertilizer to a planted area, worked into the soil. Includes application.
cadenas.Aplicación de acabado decorativo textura: Application of a textured decorative finish on an internal or external substrate, with the technique and the grain agreed with the client. The result depends on keeping the same hand, the same tool and the same dosage throughout the bay, so it is advisable to carry out an approved sample first and not to interrupt the work within the same bay. Includes the preparation and sealing of the substrate, the application of the base coat, the execution of the texture in a continuous operation and the final protection when the system requires it. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Aplicación de acabado sobre superficie g: Application of a finish on a galvanized or aluminum surface, with a specific adhesion primer. These substrates are the painter's classic trap: a conventional anti-corrosion primer will not grip on galvanizing and the finish peels off in sheets after a few months, so thorough degreasing and a specific adhesion primer or a conversion treatment are needed. Includes the degreasing, the light sanding of the surface to create a mechanical key, the adhesion primer and the two finish coats. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Aplicación de barniz de poliuretano o la: Application of polyurethane varnish or lacquer on internal joinery and wood elements, in three coats with intermediate sanding. Includes the initial sanding in the direction of the grain, dusting off, applying the pore filler, the light sanding between coats which is what produces the smooth feel of the final finish, and the coats of varnish respecting the drying times. Measured by the surface actually treated, taking every face.
cadenas.Aplicación de barniz marino sobre carpin: Application of marine varnish on external wood joinery, with two coats. Includes preparing the wood and the two coats of varnish of high resistance to weathering. Measured per square meter varnished.
cadenas.Aplicación de barniz protector sobre mad: Application of protective varnish to interior structural wood, with two coats. Includes preparation of the wood and the two coats of varnish. Measured per square meter varnished.
cadenas.Aplicación de dos manos de esmalte sinté: Application of two coats of gloss synthetic enamel paint on metal or wood joinery, after preparing the substrate by sanding, degreasing and removing rust or remains of previous finishes. Includes masking glass, hardware and adjoining substrates, applying with a brush on profiles and moldings, light sanding between coats and removing the protection. Measured by the surface actually treated, measuring both faces separately.
cadenas.Aplicación de dos manos de pintura de ca: Application of two coats of washable matte acrylic latex paint on an internal substrate previously prepared and primed, applied with roller and brush at junctions and trim, with the intermediate sanding needed between coats and respecting the manufacturer's drying times. Includes protecting the surroundings, cutting in at edges and corners, final touch-ups and cleaning the work area. The color is selected by the client. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².

Application of two coats of exterior latex paint on a prepared facade, with a brush at junctions and a roller on the bays. Includes working from scaffolding, protecting the joinery and the surroundings at the foot of the facade, cutting in the perimeters and moldings, applying the coats respecting the drying time and avoiding painting under intense direct sun or with a threat of rain, which ruins the finish, and the final going over by complete bays so that the stops do not show. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².

Application of two coats of washable satin latex paint on a prepared internal substrate. The satin finish stands up to cleaning far better than matte, which makes it preferable in kitchens, bathrooms, hallways and children's areas, although it shows the irregularities of the substrate more, so it needs more careful preparation. Includes protecting the surroundings, cutting in at edges and junctions with a brush, applying with a roller in crossed coats, a light intermediate sanding and the final touch-ups. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Aplicación de dos manos de pintura sobre: Application of two coats of paint on a previously prepared ceiling, with an extension pole roller and a brush at junctions. Painting overhead has a considerably lower output than on a wall, means protecting the whole floor and the furniture against drips and penalizes the finish if a wet edge is not maintained, since the laps show up much more under the raking light that comes in from the windows. Includes the full protection of the room, cutting in the perimeters, applying in crossed coats and the final touch-ups. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte al agua sobre carp: Application of water based enamel paint to interior wood joinery, with a primer and two coats. Includes preparation of the surface, the primer and the two coats of enamel. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte lavable en paramen: Application of washable enamel paint on substrates in kitchens, pantries or service areas, with two coats. Includes preparing the substrate and the two coats of washable enamel paint resistant to frequent cleaning. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte o laca sobre persi: Application of enamel paint or lacquer to a wooden roller shutter, with a primer and two coats. Includes the preparation and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte o pintura anticorr: Application of enamel paint or anti-corrosion paint on exposed metal pipes and conduits, with two coats. Includes the cleaning and the two coats of protective paint. Measured per meter of pipe painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte sintético sobre ca: Application of synthetic enamel paint to exterior wood joinery, with a primer and two coats. Includes preparation of the wood, the primer and the two coats of enamel. Measured per square meter painted.

Application of synthetic enamel paint to exterior metal joinery, with an anticorrosion primer and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the primer and the two coats of enamel. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte sobre closet o mue: Application of enamel paint to a closet or wood cabinet, with a primer and two coats. Includes the preparation and the two coats of enamel. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte sobre estructura m: Application of enamel paint to an interior metal structure, with an anticorrosion primer and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the primer and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte sobre pasamanos o: Application of enamel paint to a metal handrail or guardrail, with an anticorrosion primer and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the primer and the two coats. Measured per meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte sobre portón o pue: Application of enamel paint to an exterior metal gate or door, with an anticorrosion primer and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the primer and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte sobre puerta metál: Application of enamel paint to a metal door, with an anticorrosion primer and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the primer and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de esmalte sobre reja, verja: Application of enamel paint on an exterior railing, gate or metal element, with an anti-corrosion primer and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the anti-corrosion primer and the two coats of enamel paint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de estuco a la cal decorativo: Application of decorative lime plaster to an interior substrate, with a hand crafted finish. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the plaster. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso con mortero impermea: Application of stucco with waterproofing mortar on a retaining wall or basement wall. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the waterproofing mortar. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de mortero coloreado: Application of colored mortar plaster to an interior or exterior substrate, with a smooth finish. Includes the screeds, applying the colored mortar and the finishing. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de mortero con acaba: Application of mortar plaster with a burnished finish, for interior substrates. Includes applying the mortar, the burnishing and the final finishing. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de mortero de cal so: Application of lime mortar plaster to an interior substrate, with a fine finish. Includes preparing the mix, the screeds and the finishing. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de mortero en techo,: Application of mortar stucco to a ceiling, with screeds and finishing. Includes preparation of the substrate, the screeds and the finishing. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de mortero en zonas: Application of mortar stucco in narrow areas, reveals and the finishing of openings. Includes applying the mortar and finishing the arrises. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de mortero sobre mur: Application of mortar stucco over a stone wall, making the surface even prior to the finish. Includes preparation of the substrate and applying the mortar. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de mortero sobre par: Application of mortar stucco to a concrete block substrate, with screeds and finishing, 1.5 cm thick. Includes wetting the substrate, the screeds and the finishing. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de yeso con fibra de: Application of gypsum plaster with reinforcing fiber for substrates with greater resistance to cracking. Includes applying the reinforced compound and the finishing. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso de yeso proyectado s: Application of sprayed gypsum plaster to an interior substrate, with screeds and finishing. Includes preparing the substrate and the mechanical application of the gypsum compound. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de friso en fachada con malla: Application of stucco on a facade with embedded reinforcing mesh to prevent cracking. Includes fitting the mesh and applying the mortar. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Aplicación de guarda o friso decorativo: Application of a painted decorative border or frieze internally, with one or two coats. Includes masking the line and the application. Measured per meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de hidrofugante a base de sil: Application of a siloxane based water repellent to a facade, vapor permeable. Includes the previous cleaning and applying the water repellent. Measured per square meter treated.
Application of a water repellent to a facade.
cadenas.Aplicación de hidrofugante incoloro de i: Application of a colorless penetrating water repellent to a concrete, face brick, stone or stuccoed facade, to reduce the absorption of water without forming a film or altering the appearance. Unlike a paint, it leaves the pore open to vapor, so the facade continues to breathe and there is no delamination from vapor pressure from inside. Includes cleaning and drying the substrate beforehand, repairing cracks, applying to saturation from the bottom up until the product runs down over the area already treated, and the second coat applied wet on the first. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Aplicación de hidrofugante incoloro en f: Application of a clear water repellent to a facade.
Application of a colorless water repellent to a facade. Includes cleaning beforehand and application. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de hidrofugante previo y dos: Application of a water repellent first and two coats of exterior paint on facades exposed to rain. Includes applying the water repellent, the two coats of paint and protecting the surroundings. Measured per square meter treated and painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de hidrofugante sobre cubiert: Application of a water repellent to a tiled roof, to repel water and prevent absorption. Includes the previous cleaning and applying the water repellent. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de hidrofugante sobre fachada: Application of a water repellent to a natural stone or exposed brick facade, to repel water without stopping it from breathing. Includes the previous cleaning and applying the water repellent. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de hidrofugante sobre paramen: Application of a water repellent to an exterior concrete substrate, to repel water. Includes the previous cleaning and the application. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de imprimación selladora o fo: Application of a sealing primer or stabilizing primer to a porous substrate prior to painting. Includes the cleaning and applying the sealer. Measured per square meter primed.
cadenas.Aplicación de laca sobre carpintería int: Application of lacquer to interior wood joinery, with a primer and two coats. Includes sanding, the primer and the two coats of lacquer. Measured per square meter lacquered.
cadenas.Aplicación de laca sobre puertas de inte: Application of lacquer to interior doors, with a primer and two coats. Includes the preparation, the primer and the two coats of lacquer. Measured per square meter lacquered.
cadenas.Aplicación de lasur decorativo sobre mad: Application of a decorative woodstain on external wood, with two coats that let the grain show through. Includes preparing the wood and the two coats of woodstain. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de lasur protector sobre pérg: Application of a protective woodstain on a pergola or external wood, with two coats. Includes preparing the wood and the two coats of woodstain. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de lámina de control solar so: Application of solar control film to the glazing, to reduce heat gain.
cadenas.Aplicación de lámina o recubrimiento imp: Application of a waterproof sheet or coating to a bathroom cabinet, to protect the melamine from moisture. Includes cutting and fixing.
cadenas.Aplicación de membrana de poliurea sobre: Application of a polyurea membrane on a roof or exposed surface, in a continuous coat. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the polyurea. Measured per square meter applied.
cadenas.Aplicación de microcemento decorativo en: Application of decorative microcement to a ceiling, with mesh and a sealed finish. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the microcement. Measured per square meter applied.
cadenas.Aplicación de microcemento en techo, con: Application of microcement on a ceiling, with mesh and a sealed finish. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the microcement. Measured per square meter applied.
cadenas.Aplicación de mortero impermeabilizante: Application of a flexible cementitious waterproofing mortar in two coats to the substrate in shower areas and areas in direct contact with water, as a base beneath the tiling. This is the layer that actually stops the water: ceramic tile and its grout are not watertight, and without this base the damp ends up appearing in the adjoining room. Includes making the substrate level beforehand, rounding off or reinforcing the wall and floor junctions and the corners with flexible tape, which are the points where the system fails, applying the two coats crosswise respecting the time between them and the watertightness test before tiling. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Aplicación de película reflectiva sobre: Application of a reflective coating to the roof, to reduce solar heat gain.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura acrílica antihongo: Application of anti-mold acrylic paint on substrates in kitchens, bathrooms or premises subject to condensation, with two coats. Includes the cleaning of the surface, the prior treatment of the affected areas and the two coats of anti-mold paint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura acrílica lavable e: Application of washable latex paint to kitchen walls, with two coats. Includes preparation of the substrate and the two coats of paint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura anticorrosiva sobr: Application of anti-corrosion paint to a metal boundary, with cleaning beforehand. Includes preparation and application.
Application of anti-corrosion paint to a metal roof structure, with cleaning beforehand and two coats. Includes preparation of the surface.

Application of anti-corrosion paint on a metal structure, with two primer coats. Includes the cleaning of the surface, the anti-corrosion preparation and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de caucho a dos co: Application of latex paint in two colors on the same substrate, with a border or a straight division line. Includes the application of both colors with masking of the line and the clean finish of the joint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de caucho en techo: Application of elastomeric paint to a ceiling with an extension roller, with two coats. Includes the preparation and the two coats of paint. Measured per square meter painted.

Application of latex paint on ceilings or high substrates that require scaffolding, with two coats. Includes erecting the scaffolding, applying the paint and protecting the work area. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de caucho exterior: Application of exterior latex paint with a satin finish on a facade, with two coats. Includes preparing the substrate and the two satin finish coats. Measured per square meter painted.

Application of exterior latex paint on new stucco, with a sealing primer and three coats. Includes applying the primer, the three coats of paint and protecting windows and floors. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de caucho o epóxic: Application of elastomeric or epoxy paint in a basement or interior garage, with two coats. Includes preparation of the substrate and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de caucho semibril: Application of washable semi-gloss latex paint on substrates in high traffic areas, hallways and service areas, with two coats. Includes preparing the substrate and the two semi-gloss finish coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de caucho sobre ci: Application of latex paint on an exposed concrete soffit, with a sealing primer and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the primer and the two finish coats, with protection of walls and floors. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de caucho sobre fr: Application of latex paint on a new internal stucco, with a sealing primer and three finish coats. Includes applying the primer, the three coats of paint and protecting floors and joinery. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de demarcación sob: Application of line marking paint on industrial floors and parking lots, for the delimitation of zones and circulation routes. Includes setting out the lines and applying the traffic paint. Measured per square meter marked.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de pizarra efecto: Application of chalkboard paint on an internal substrate, with two coats over a prepared base. Includes the sealing primer, the two coats of chalkboard paint and the curing before use. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura de señalización de: Application of internal safety marking paint, with stripes and markings to the applicable standard. Includes setting out the markings and the application. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura decorativa con aca: Application of decorative paint with a pearlescent or metallic finish on an internal substrate. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the finish. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura decorativa con pla: Application of decorative paint with a stencil on an internal substrate, with one or more coats. Includes setting out the design and applying with a stencil. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura epóxica bicomponen: Application of a two-component epoxy coating on a floor or substrate, with a primer and two finish coats, for heavy traffic areas, commercial kitchens and workshops. It requires mixing the two components in the exact proportion and applying within the pot life of the mix, which is short: after that time the product still looks usable but no longer cures properly. Includes the mechanical preparation of the substrate to open the pores, the measurement of moisture, the primer, the controlled mixing and the application of the coats with the manufacturer's recoating times. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura epóxica sobre para: Application of epoxy paint on a vertical substrate, with a primer and two coats. Includes preparing the substrate, the primer and the two coats of epoxy paint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura exterior a dos col: Application of exterior paint in two colors on a facade, with masking of the division line. Includes the application of both colors and the clean finish. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura exterior con acaba: Application of flat exterior paint to a facade, with two coats. Includes preparation of the substrate and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
Application of exterior paint with a textured or stippled finish on a facade, with two coats. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the textured coating. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura exterior en cornis: Application of exterior paint on cornices, eaves and facade trim, with two coats. Includes protecting the adjacent elements and the two coats of paint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura exterior en cubier: Application of exterior paint to a roof or a sloping ceiling surface, with two coats. Includes the preparation and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura exterior en muro d: Application of exterior paint on an enclosing wall or party wall, with two coats. Includes the cleaning of the surface and the two coats of exterior latex paint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura exterior en zócalo: Application of exterior paint to the base of a facade, with two coats. Includes preparation of the substrate and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura exterior sobre fac: Application of exterior paint on a concrete block facade, with a primer and two coats. Includes the sealing of the block, the primer and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura exterior sobre mur: Application of exterior paint to a retaining wall, with two coats. Includes preparation of the substrate and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura impermeabilizante: Application of an elastomeric waterproofing coating to a metal roof, in two coats. Includes cleaning and application.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura intumescente igníf: Application of intumescent fire resistant paint to a structure or interior substrate, with the coats needed for the required fire resistance rating. Includes preparation of the substrate and the application. Measured per square meter painted.
Application of intumescent fire retardant paint on structural or finishing wood. Includes the preparation and the application of the necessary coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura magnética como bas: Application of magnetic paint as a base coat on a wall, prior to the finish paint, with two coats. Includes preparing the substrate and the two coats of magnetic paint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura mineral a base de: Application of lime based mineral paint on internal substrates in basements, storage rooms and ventilated spaces, with two coats. Includes preparing the substrate and the two coats of lime paint. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura satinada lavable e: Application of washable satin paint in high humidity premises, with a damp proof primer and two coats. Includes the preparation and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de pintura sobre concreto vis: Application of paint to exposed concrete or an exterior mineral surface, with a sealing primer and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the primer and the two finishing coats. Measured per square meter painted.

Application of paint on exposed concrete, block or porous mineral surface, with a previous sealing primer. Young concrete is strongly alkaline and attacks conventional paints, causing saponification and flaking, so the curing time has to be respected or an alkali resistant primer used. Includes the cleaning and removal of efflorescence, the sealing primer, the patching of blowholes and the finish coats. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Aplicación de preservante fungicida e in: Application of fungicidal and insecticidal preservative to a lumber roof structure, in two coats. Includes cleaning and treatment.

Application of a fungicidal and insecticidal preservative on structural or building lumber, with one or two coats. Includes preparing the wood and applying the preservative. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de preservante fungicida sobr: Application of a fungicidal preservative to structural lumber.
cadenas.Aplicación de protector anti-graffiti en: Application of an anti-graffiti coating to a facade. Includes cleaning beforehand and application. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de protector anti-graffiti so: Application of an anti-graffiti protector on a painted facade, which makes the cleaning of graffiti easier. Includes the previous cleaning and the application of the protector. Measured per square meter treated.
Application of an anti-graffiti protector on a painted facade. Includes the previous cleaning and the application of the protector. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de puente de adherencia sobre: Application of a bonding coat to a hardened concrete substrate prior to laying mortar or tiling. Includes the cleaning and the application of the bonding coat. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de puente de adherencia y dos: Application of a bonding coat and two coats of exterior paint on a facade with an uneven substrate. Includes the bonding coat, the two coats and protecting the surroundings. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento antiderrapan: Application of an anti-slip resin coating on a ramp, for safe circulation. Includes the preparation and the application of the coating. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de fachada c: Application of a facade coating with a decorative and waterproof acrylic stucco. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the acrylic stucco. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de poliureta: Application of a two-component polyurethane coating on an internal floor, with a primer and two coats. Includes preparing the substrate, the primer and the two coats of polyurethane. Measured per square meter coated.
Application of an abrasion resistant polyurethane concrete coating on a floor. Includes the preparation and the application of the coating. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de resina ac: Application of a decorative acrylic resin coating on a floor or substrate. Includes the preparation and the application of the resin. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de resina co: Application of a resin coating with anti-slip colored quartz aggregate on a floor. Includes the preparation, the resin and the broadcasting of the quartz. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento de resina en: Application of a resin coating in a cold room or cold store. Includes the preparation and the application of the coating suitable for cold. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento decorativo t: Application of a textured decorative coating on a substrate, with the finish of the client's choice. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the textured coating. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento elastomérico: Application of an elastomeric waterproofing coating on a facade, in two or three coats until the film thickness that guarantees the bridging of cracks is reached. Unlike a conventional paint, its value lies in the thickness: applied thin to save material it loses the elasticity that justifies its price and stops bridging the cracks. Includes preparing the substrate, the prior treatment of larger cracks with tape, the application of the crossed coats respecting the coverage rate indicated by the manufacturer and the verification of the thickness. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico anti: Application of an anti-slip epoxy coating on an internal or external floor, with a primer coat and a finish with aggregate. Includes the preparation, the primer and the anti-slip finish. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico auto: Application of a self-draining epoxy coating on an industrial floor, with a drainage fall. Includes the preparation, the primer and the self-draining finish. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico cond: Application of an anti-static conductive epoxy coating on a laboratory or electronics industry floor. Includes the preparation and the application of the conductive coating. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico deco: Application of a decorative epoxy coating with colored flakes on a floor or substrate. Includes the preparation, the primer and the application with flakes. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento epóxico en p: Application of an epoxy coating to a commercial kitchen substrate, resistant to grease and cleaning. Includes the preparation and the application. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de recubrimiento reflectivo s: Application of a reflective coating on a roof, to reduce the thermal load. Includes the cleaning and the application of the reflective coating. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de revestimiento epóxico de a: Application of a high chemical resistance epoxy coating on a floor or substrate in a laboratory or industrial premises. Includes the preparation, the primer and the chemical resistant finish coats. Measured per square meter coated.
cadenas.Aplicación de sellador hidrofugante y an: Application of a water repellent and anti-stain sealer on a natural stone floor or cladding. Includes the previous cleaning and the application of the protective sealer. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de tinte o colorante para mad: Application of stain or wood dye for internal wood, with one or two coats. Includes preparing the wood and applying the stain. Measured per square meter stained.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento anticarbónico: Application of an anti-carbonation or protective coating to a facade. Includes cleaning beforehand and application. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento anticorrosivo: Application of anti-corrosion treatment to a metal roof, with cleaning beforehand and two coats. Includes preparation of the surface.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento fitosanitario: Application of pest and disease treatment to a planted area. Includes application.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento ignífugo sobre: Application of a fire-retardant treatment to a wood structure on site, to improve its fire resistance.
cadenas.Aplicación de tratamiento preservante fu: Application of fungicidal and insecticidal preservative to structural lumber, in two coats by brush or by dipping. In a tropical climate this treatment is not optional: unprotected lumber has a short service life against termites and rot fungi. Includes sanding and cleaning the surface beforehand, applying the first coat with particular attention to the end grain, the joints and the bearing areas, which carry the greatest risk, respecting the absorption time and applying the second coat. Measured by the area actually treated, taking every face.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de estructura de techo ex: Shoring of an existing roof structure.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de losa durante el vaciad: Shoring of a slab during the pour and curing.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de losa mediante puntales: Shoring of a slab with telescopic steel shores on spreader beams, sized to carry the weight of the wet concrete, of the formwork and of the construction loads, and kept in place until the slab reaches the specified strength. Premature removal of the shoring is one of the most frequent causes of excessive deflection and permanent cracking. Includes setting out the grid, placing spreader beams at head and base, erecting and loading the shores, checking that the load is transferred to a level below of sufficient capacity, inspection during the pour and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the area of slab actually shored.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de muro con madera y punt: Shoring of a wall with lumber and shores. Includes installing the shoring. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a wall with lumber.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de talud o excavación int: Shoring of an internal slope or excavation. Includes installing the trench sheeting. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento de vano durante la apertu: Shoring of an opening while it is formed.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento provisional de estructura: Temporary shoring of a roof structure during repair, with steel shores and spreader beams. Includes erection and dismantling.
cadenas.Apuntalamiento provisional del muro situ: Temporary shoring of the wall over an opening that is to be formed or widened, using shores and spreader beams that carry the load of the masonry above while the demolition is carried out and the permanent lintel is placed. This is what stops the masonry collapsing when its support is removed. Includes setting out, cutting the bearing pockets for the spreader beam into the wall, erecting and loading the shores on both faces, checking them during the demolition, removing the shoring once the permanent lintel has cured and taken load, and patching the bearing pockets. Measured per opening actually shored.
cadenas.Auditoría de los consumos energéticos de: Audit of the energy consumption of the dwelling, with analysis of bills and a proposal for improvement.
cadenas.Automatización de portón batiente existe: Automation of an existing swinging gate.
cadenas.Automatización de portón corredizo exist: Automation of an existing sliding gate.
cadenas.Automatización de toldo con sensor solar: Automation of an awning with a sun sensor, for automatic operation. The system is selected by the client.
Automation of an awning with a solar sensor.
cadenas.Automatización de un portón batiente exi: Automation of an existing hinged gate, with motors and control. Includes fitting the motors and the programming. Measured per unit automated.
cadenas.Automatización de un portón corredizo ex: Automation of an existing sliding gate, with motor, control and limit switches. Includes fitting the motor and the programming. Measured per unit automated.

cadenas.Ayuda de albañilería para datos y teleco: Builder's work for the data and telecommunications installation.
Builder's work for the gas installation.
Builder's work for the fire protection installation.
cadenas.Ayuda de albañilería para instalación co: Builder's work for the fire protection installation: penetrations and making good. Includes forming the penetrations and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
cadenas.Ayuda de albañilería para instalación de: Builder's work for the pumping installation: bases and penetrations. Includes forming the bases and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
Builder's work for the HVAC installation: penetrations and making good. Includes forming the penetrations and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
Builder's work for the data installation: penetrations and making good. Includes forming the penetrations and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
Builder's work for the gas installation: chases and making good. Includes forming the chases and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
Builder's work for the ventilation installation: penetrations and making good. Includes forming the penetrations and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
cadenas.Ayuda de albañilería para instalación el: Builder's work for the electrical installation.
Builder's work for the electrical installation: chases, making good and patching. Includes forming the chases and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
cadenas.Ayuda de albañilería para instalación sa: Builder's work for the plumbing installation.
Builder's work for the plumbing installation: penetrations, making good and patching. Includes forming the penetrations and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
cadenas.Ayuda de albañilería para instalación so: Builder's work for the solar installation: bases and penetrations. Includes forming the bases and making good. Measured per unit of builder's work.
Builder's work for the solar installation.
Builder's work for the ventilation installation.
cadenas.Bajada de escombro desde plantas altas h: Removal of debris from upper floors to the storage or loading point, by hoist, hopper or by hand, depending on access at the site. It is a cost that is consistently forgotten, and in a building without a site hoist it can exceed the cost of disposal itself. Includes bagging the debris, moving it to the point of descent, lowering it by the means available, stacking it neatly at ground level and the continuous cleaning of the common circulation areas, which in an occupied building is mandatory and takes real time. Measured by the volume of bulked debris actually removed.
cadenas.Bajada de escombro desde plantas altas m: Removal of debris from upper floors through a debris chute or vertical duct, with a receiving hopper and water spray for dust control.
Removal of debris from upper floors by site hoist, with loading and unloading by hand.
cadenas.Bajada de escombro desde plantas altas p: Removal of debris from upper floors by hand in sacks, to the storage area at ground floor level.
Removal of debris from upper floors.
cadenas.Bajada de escombro por escombrera o duct: Removal of debris through a debris chute.
cadenas.Bajante con contador de descargas y mand: Down conductor with strike counter and test joint.
cadenas.Bajante de aguas lluvias en cubierta met: Rainwater downspout on a metal roof.
Bare copper down conductor with fixings.
cadenas.Balanceo de los caudales de ventilación,: Balancing of the ventilation air flows with an anemometer, to verify the specified air change rate.
Recessed inground light for exterior floors.
Perimeter strip at the floor and wall junction.
cadenas.Baranda de acero con pasamanos de madera: Steel guardrail with a wood handrail.
Steel guardrail with a perforated sheet infill.
Steel guardrail with a mesh infill.
cadenas.Baranda de acero galvanizado con pasaman: Galvanized steel guardrail with a wood handrail.
cadenas.Baranda de acero inoxidable con tensores: Stainless steel guardrail with tension rods.
Stair guardrail on a lumber stringer.
Wood guardrail for an interior balcony.
cadenas.Baranda de madera para escalera interior: Wood guardrail for an interior stair.
cadenas.Baranda de protección en perímetro de lo: Guardrail around the perimeter of a slab.
cadenas.Baranda provisional de protección en bor: Temporary guardrail at the edges of slabs, openings, stairways and voids, with posts, a top rail, a mid rail and a toe board. It is the collective measure that prevents falls from height, the leading cause of serious accidents on site. It must be erected before the risk arises, not afterwards. Includes erecting the guardrail system with its fixings, installing the top rail, mid rail and toe board that stops material falling, periodic inspection of the assembly and its removal once the permanent protection is in place. Measured by the length actually protected.
Facade guardrail with a protective barrier.
cadenas.Barnizado de barandas y pasamanos de mad: Varnishing of wood guardrails and handrails, with sanding and two coats of varnish. Includes preparation of the surface and the two coats of varnish. Measured per square meter varnished.
Varnishing of lumber guardrails and handrails.
cadenas.Barnizado de mueble de madera exterior,: Varnishing of exterior wood furniture, with sanding and two coats of marine varnish. Includes the preparation and the two coats of varnish. Measured per square meter varnished.
cadenas.Barnizado de puerta de madera interior,: Varnishing of an interior wood door, with sanding and two coats of varnish. Includes the preparation and the two coats of varnish. Measured per square meter varnished.
Grab bar in a shower or bathtub.
cadenas.Barrera anticapilaridad en arranque de m: Damp-proof course at the base of a wall.
cadenas.Barrera antipolvo con lámina plástica y: Dust barrier in plastic sheeting with an access opening.
Vapor barrier beneath a roof deck.
Vapor barrier beneath a foundation slab.
cadenas.Barrera de vapor de polietileno bajo los: Polyethylene vapor barrier beneath a foundation slab.
cadenas.Barrera provisional de confinamiento de: Temporary dust containment barrier between the work area and the areas still in use, made up of a lumber batten frame with polyethylene sheeting stretched and sealed around its whole perimeter against floor, walls and ceiling, with a zip door for access. This is what allows work to go on in one room while the rest of the building stays occupied and operating. Includes setting out, erecting the frame, fitting and sealing the sheeting, fitting the access opening, maintaining the barrier while the works last, and dismantling and removing it at the end. Measured over the area of barrier actually erected.
cadenas.Base continua de mortero de cemento sobr: Continuous cement mortar bed over the roof slope to receive tiling or sheeting, with reinforcing mesh at the junctions. Includes spreading, screeding and finishing.
Compacted sand base beneath paving. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per square meter constructed.
Concrete base for a gate post.
Mortar base for a tile roof.
cadenas.Base de piedra picada compactada para pa: Compacted crushed stone base for paving.
Compacted crushed stone base for paving. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per square meter constructed.
cadenas.Base de piedra picada extendida y compac: Crushed stone base spread and compacted beneath floors, sidewalks or external paving, acting as a drainage and load spreading layer and breaking the capillary rise of moisture into the floor. Includes supply and placing of the stone, spreading it in 15 cm layers, blinding with fine material where the surface has to be closed, compaction with a plate compactor and checking the final level and regularity. Measured by the volume of compacted base to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Baño portátil de obra, por mes de perman: Portable site toilet, per month on site.
Shadow gap in a suspended ceiling.
cadenas.Borde perimetral de sombra para iluminac: Perimeter shadow gap for indirect lighting.
Edge and parapet of a flat roof.
Medicine cabinet with an integrated mirror.
cadenas.Cabezal de concreto armado de resistenci: Reinforced concrete pile cap of 250 kg/cm² strength that receives the load of the column and distributes it across the group of piles, including its formwork, pouring, vibration and curing. Includes setting out over the cut-off heads, erecting and bracing the formwork, checking that the starter bars from the piles are embedded with the anchorage length specified, pouring in layers with vibration, stripping and curing. It does not include the reinforcement, which is priced by weight. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Cajón de persiana en dintel con registro: Roller shutter box in a lintel, with an access panel.
Roller shutter box in a window lintel.
Roller shutter box with an access panel.
cadenas.Calafateado y sellado de la carpintería: Caulking and sealing of the external joinery, to eliminate air and water infiltration.
cadenas.Calibración y balanceo del sistema de cl: Calibration and balancing of the HVAC system, to ensure optimum performance.
Calibration and balancing of the system.
cadenas.Cambio del cilindro de una cerradura exi: Changing the cylinder of an existing lock, keeping the body. Includes removing the old cylinder and fitting the new. Measured per unit changed.
Drainage channel with a metal grille.
Linear drainage channel with a grille.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica con conductor de: Electrical conduit with a 10 AWG conductor. Includes drawing in the conductor. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica dedicada para equ: Dedicated electrical conduit for air conditioning equipment, with its conduit, a conductor of the right size and provision for the separate protective device in the panel. Includes setting out the route between the panel and the unit, cutting the chase or running in the plenum, drawing in the conductor sized to the power of the unit, the penetration to the outdoor unit with the seal at the facade and identifying the circuit. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica empotrada con con: Concealed electrical conduit, 20 mm, with 12 AWG conductor.
Concealed electrical conduit. Includes laying the conduit. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica en cielo raso o s: Electrical conduit in a suspended ceiling or surface mounted.
cadenas.Canalización eléctrica no empotrada, ten: Surface electrical conduit run in the ceiling plenum or fixed on the surface with conduit and its clips, with copper conductor. Against concealed conduit it avoids hacking out and making good, and leaves the installation accessible, which makes it preferable in refurbishment provided the run stays hidden. Includes setting out, fixing the conduit with clips at the spacing indicated, drawing in the conductors, identifying the circuits and the junction boxes at accessible points. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Canalón de recogida en cubierta metálica: Collection gutter on a metal roof.
Concealed gutter beneath a tile eaves.
Landfill tipping fee for mixed debris.
cadenas.Canon de vertido en vertedero autorizado: Landfill tipping fee for mixed non-recoverable debris at a licensed disposal site.
cadenas.Capa de acabado fino de pasta aplicada s: Fine finishing coat of compound applied over mortar or gypsum plaster, 2 to 3 mm thick, to obtain a smooth surface suitable for high gloss paints or for finishes where any irregularity shows up under raking light. Includes checking and sealing the substrate beforehand, applying the compound in two crosswise coats with a trowel, sanding between coats and the final sanding with extraction, and going over it under raking light to find and correct the defects that only appear under that lighting. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Capa de compresión de cubierta con malla: Structural topping to a roof deck with mesh.
cadenas.Capa de compresión de mortero armado con: Reinforced mortar structural topping with welded wire mesh over lightweight roof fill, to spread loads. Includes spreading, embedding the mesh and floating.
cadenas.Capa de concreto pobre de limpieza de 5: Mud slab of 5 cm average thickness, poured over the bottom of the excavation before the footing is reinforced. It serves a purpose of execution rather than a structural one: it separates the steel from the ground, stops soil contaminating the structural concrete and gives a clean level surface on which to set out and stand the spacers. Includes going over and compacting the bottom, pouring and spreading the concrete, screeding it level and marking the center lines of the footing on the hardened slab. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Capa de mortero de protección sobre el a: Protective mortar screed over the roof insulation, before the waterproofing, to give support and continuity. Includes spreading and floating.
cadenas.Capa de mortero de protección sobre la i: Protective mortar screed over the waterproofing of a flat roof, reinforced with mesh and with shrinkage joints, protecting the membrane from traffic and from radiation. It must be laid on a separating layer: if it is poured directly onto the waterproofing, the shrinkage of the mortar drags on the membrane and tears it. Includes laying the separating sheet, the shrinkage mesh, pouring and screeding the mortar, forming shrinkage joints in bays and against the parapets, floating and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Capa de nivelación con mortero seco de c: Leveling layer of semi-dry mortar of damp earth consistency, spread and compacted, used where significant unevenness has to be taken up or services have to be buried under the floor without resorting to a thickness of conventional mortar that would prove costly and heavy. Includes cleaning the substrate, setting out the levels with screeds, spreading and compacting the mortar in layers, the final ruling off and applying the surface sealing slurry that seals the layer and allows the floor adhesive to be applied. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
Drainage layer with a dimpled membrane.
Drainage layer of a green roof.
cadenas.Capa separadora de geotextil en cubierta: Geotextile separating layer on a roof deck.
Geotextile separating layer on a terrace.
Air terminal on a chimney for lightning protection.
cadenas.Carga de gas refrigerante del sistema de: Charging of refrigerant into the HVAC system, using scales and verifying pressures.
cadenas.Carga manual de escombro sobre contenedo: Hand loading of debris into a container or vehicle, using shovels and sacks, for removal.
Hand loading of debris into a container.
cadenas.Carga manual de tierra sobrante a carret: Hand loading of surplus spoil into a wheelbarrow or sack. Includes loading. Measured per cubic meter loaded.
cadenas.Carga manual del material sobrante de ex: Hand loading of surplus excavated material onto a dump truck and cartage to a licensed spoil site, including the tipping fee, based on an average distance of 25 km. It is used where the stockpile cannot be reached by loading plant. Includes loading onto the vehicle by shovel, sheeting and securing the load to prevent spillage in transit, cartage, tipping and cleaning of the loading area. Measured by the volume of bulked material actually removed.
