cadenas.Carga manual y transporte de tierra sobr: Hand loading and cartage of surplus spoil to a spoil site.
cadenas.Carga mecanizada de tierra sobrante a ca: Mechanical loading of surplus spoil onto a truck. Includes loading. Measured per cubic meter loaded.
cadenas.Carga mecanizada del material sobrante d: Mechanical loading of surplus excavated material with a backhoe onto a dump truck and cartage to a licensed spoil site, including the tipping fee, based on an average distance of 25 km. Includes loading with the machine, sheeting and securing the load, cartage, tipping, hand trimming of the residual stockpile and cleaning of the loading area. Measured by the volume of bulked material actually removed.
cadenas.Carga mecanizada y transporte de tierra: Mechanical loading and cartage of surplus spoil to a spoil site.
cadenas.Carga mecánica de escombro sobre vehícul: Mechanical loading of debris onto a vehicle or dump truck with suitable equipment, for removal to landfill.
Mechanical loading of debris onto a vehicle.
cadenas.Caseta o zona cerrada de acopio de mater: Store or enclosed area for materials and tools, per month.
Store or enclosed area for materials, per month. Includes erection and the period on site. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Cata en muro para reconocimiento de espe: Exploratory opening in a wall to check its thickness and makeup. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per linear meter of opening.
Exploratory opening in a wall to check its thickness.
cadenas.Cata en pared para reconocimiento de ins: Exploratory opening in a wall to identify services or substrate.
cadenas.Cata en piso o losa para reconocimiento: Exploratory opening in a floor or slab to identify layers or services.
cadenas.Cata en techo o cara inferior de losa pa: Exploratory opening in a ceiling or the underside of a slab to inspect the structure. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per linear meter of opening.
cadenas.Cata en techo para reconocimiento de los: Exploratory opening in a ceiling to inspect the slab.
cadenas.Cata para localización de tubería enterr: Exploratory opening to locate a buried pipe.
Exploratory opening to locate a buried pipe. Includes opening up and cleaning. Measured per opening carried out.
cadenas.Cenefa integrada de iluminación en cielo: Integrated lighting cove in a ceiling.
cadenas.Cenefa o listelo decorativo en enchapado: Decorative border or listello in tiling.
cadenas.Central domótica con configuración inici: Home automation controller with initial configuration.
Home automation controller with remote control.
Grille fence on a blockwork dwarf wall.
cadenas.Cerca perimetral de bloque de concreto c: Perimeter wall of concrete blocks with its confining piers and ring beam, stuccoed on both faces. Includes setting out the boundary line, constructing the strip footing, building the masonry level and plumb, the confining piers at the spacing specified, the ring beam, the stucco on both faces and the coping with a fall that sheds water and protects the top of the wall. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cerca perimetral de malla ciclónica con: Perimeter chain link fence with its posts, straining wires, barbed wire topping and concrete footings. Includes setting out the line, excavating and pouring the post footings, plumbing and bracing the corner and straining posts, which take all the tension of the mesh, running out and tensioning the mesh with its tie wire, fitting the straining wires and the topping. Measured by the length actually constructed.
cadenas.Cerramiento de vano con lámina de madera: Closing off of an opening with a wood panel.
cadenas.Cerramiento perimetral provisional de ob: Temporary perimeter hoarding with warning mesh.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional de vano con lámi: Temporary closure of an opening with a wood panel.
Temporary closing off of an opening with a wood panel. Includes fixing the panel. Measured per square meter closed off.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional de vano de puert: Temporary closure of a door or window opening using a plywood or OSB panel on a batten frame, anchored into the opening. Used to close up voids left by demolition or by removing doors and windows, keeping the interior safe from the weather and from intruders until the permanent units arrive. Includes setting out and cutting the panel, building the frame, fixing it into the opening with anchors, sealing around the perimeter, maintaining it while the works last, and taking it down when the permanent units are fitted. Measured over the area of opening actually closed.
cadenas.Cerramiento provisional del perímetro de: Temporary enclosure of the perimeter of the work area using plastic warning mesh on steel or lumber posts, with warning signs. It defines the work area and keeps unauthorized people out, a basic safety requirement where the works share the site with areas still in use or open onto common areas. Includes setting out, placing and bracing the posts, stretching and fixing the mesh, putting up the warning signs, maintaining it while the works last, and dismantling and removing it at the end. Measured over the length actually enclosed.
cadenas.Cielo desmontable con foseado perimetral: Suspended ceiling with a perimeter recess.
Suspended ceiling with a clip system.
cadenas.Cielo desmontable de alta absorción acús: Suspended ceiling with high acoustic absorption.
cadenas.Cielo desmontable de fibra con perfilerí: Mineral fiber suspended ceiling with a concealed grid.
cadenas.Cielo raso con láminas machihembradas de: Ceiling of interlocking PVC sheets on battens or sections, with perimeter trim profiles. It is the most widely used economical and moisture resistant solution in service areas, porches and bathrooms, with the advantage that it washes with water and does not stain. Includes setting out and leveling, installing the battens, fitting the perimeter profiles, laying the sheets by pushing them together, the fitting cuts around light fittings and the final trim. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Cielo raso con machihembrado de madera s: Ceiling of interlocking wood boards on battens suspended from the slab, with a ventilated cavity and a preservative treatment. In a tropical climate the ventilation of the cavity and the preservative on every face, including the end grain, are what prevent termite attack and rot. Includes setting out and leveling the battens, applying the preservative, installing the interlocking boards with secret nailing, the perimeter trim with molding and the final sanding. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo con doble placa de y: Continuous ceiling with a double layer of gypsum board on a framework suspended with anti-vibration clips and mineral wool in the cavity, to reduce the transmission of airborne and impact noise from the floor above. The acoustic improvement depends as much on the mass of the double board as on the framework being isolated: if a single screw makes a rigid bridge to the slab, the insulation drops. Includes setting out, the perimeter angle with an elastic strip, installing the framework with anti-vibration elements, placing the wool, screwing the two layers with staggered joints, the joint treatment and sanding. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo con doble placa y ai: Continuous ceiling with two layers of board and insulation.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo con foso de iluminac: Continuous ceiling with an integrated lighting recess.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo con junta de dilatac: Continuous ceiling with an expansion joint.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo con placa de yeso la: Continuous ceiling of 12.5 mm moisture resistant gypsum board on a concealed suspended framework, for bathrooms, kitchens and service areas. The moisture resistant board withstands condensation and ambient humidity, but not a leak: if there is water coming through from the slab above it has to be dealt with first, because no board will take it. Includes setting out and leveling, the perimeter angle, installing and leveling the furring channels, screwing the boards, the joint treatment with tape and compound, sanding and forming the openings for light fittings and grilles. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo con placa perforada: Continuous ceiling with acoustic perforated board.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo con tapa de registro: Continuous ceiling with an access hatch.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo curvo de placa de ye: Continuous curved ceiling of gypsum board, with a framework shaped to the design. Includes the curved framework, the shaped board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de doble placa de ye: Continuous ceiling with a double layer of gypsum board and a mineral wool panel, for reinforced acoustic and thermal insulation. Includes the suspended framework, the wool, the double board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de placa de cemento: Continuous ceiling of fiber cement board on a cantilever or external soffit. Includes the framework, the cement board and sealing the joints. Measured per square meter completed.
Continuous ceiling of fiber cement board for bathrooms and wet areas. Includes the suspended framework, the board and sealing the joints. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de placa de yeso a d: Continuous gypsum board ceiling at double height, with the framework and the board on two levels. Includes the framework, the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de placa de yeso con: Continuous gypsum board ceiling with an integrated recess for recessed lighting. Includes the framework, the recess, the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
Continuous gypsum board ceiling with a perimeter or intermediate movement joint. Includes the framework, the board, the joint and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.

Continuous gypsum board ceiling with a frame and trim for a rooflight or skylight. Includes the framework, the board, the frame of the rooflight and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
Continuous gypsum board ceiling with an access panel for inspection. Includes the framework, the board, the access panel and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de placa de yeso en: Continuous gypsum board ceiling in a bathroom.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de placa de yeso lam: Continuous ceiling of gypsum board with a mineral wool panel in the cavity, for acoustic insulation. Includes the suspended framework, the wool and the board with its joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
Continuous ceiling of high hardness gypsum board, for circulation areas and common areas. Includes the suspended framework, the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
Continuous gypsum board ceiling in a stairwell, with the framework and the board. Includes the framework, the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.

Continuous ceiling of fire rated gypsum board, for the protection of structure and services. Includes the suspended framework, the fire rated board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
Continuous gypsum board ceiling on a concealed suspension system.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de placa de yeso per: Continuous ceiling of perforated acoustic gypsum board, for premises that require absorption. Includes the suspended framework, the perforated board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de placa de yeso res: Continuous ceiling of moisture resistant gypsum board in a bathroom, with framework and board. Includes the framework, the moisture resistant board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de yeso a una pendie: Continuous gypsum ceiling on a slope or inclined, with a framework shaped to the pitch. Includes the inclined framework, the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de yeso con aislamie: Continuous gypsum board ceiling with acoustic insulation.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de yeso con placa de: Continuous gypsum board ceiling with high-impact board.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo de yeso con placa ig: Continuous gypsum board ceiling with fire-rated board.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo en voladizo exterior: Continuous ceiling to an exterior overhang.
cadenas.Cielo raso continuo formado por una plac: Continuous ceiling formed by a 12.5 mm gypsum board screwed to a concealed framework of galvanized steel sections, suspended from the slab by hanger rod and clip, with a perimeter angle around the whole edge. Includes setting out and leveling with a water level or a laser, fitting the perimeter, installing and leveling the furring channels, screwing the boards, the joint treatment with tape and compound, sanding until the surface is ready to paint, and forming the openings for light fittings and grilles. Measured by the area actually completed.
PVC ceiling for a bathroom or kitchen.
cadenas.Cielo raso de listones de madera con jun: Ceiling of wood strips with an open joint, on battens. Includes the framework, laying the strips and the finish. Measured per square meter completed.
Timber batten ceiling with open joints.
cadenas.Cielo raso de listones de madera sobre r: Ceiling of wood strips on battens, with an open or closed joint. Includes the fixing framework, laying the strips and the finish. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso de láminas de PVC para baño,: Ceiling of PVC sheets for a bathroom, kitchen or wet room, with its sections. Includes the fixing framework, laying the sheets and the trim. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso de láminas de PVC para local: PVC sheet ceiling for commercial premises or service areas, with the grid system. Includes the framework, fixing the sheets and the finishing. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso de paneles acústicos de mader: Wood acoustic panel ceiling, with the fixing framework and the trim. Includes the framework, fixing the panels and the perimeter trim. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso de placa de cemento en área h: Cement board ceiling in a wet area.
cadenas.Cielo raso de tablero decorativo de made: Decorative wood board ceiling on battens, with the finish. Includes the framework, fixing the board and the finishing. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso de yeso laminado con doble pl: Acoustic gypsum board ceiling with two layers of board.
cadenas.Cielo raso de yeso laminado con dos o má: Gypsum board ceiling with two or more levels, forming steps, niches or trays, with its reinforcing framework at the changes of plane. Each change of level means a vertical face that has to be framed, lined on two faces and finished with corner bead, which multiplies the work compared with a flat ceiling of the same area. Includes setting out the break lines, the framework of both planes and of the faces, the lining, the joint and arris treatment with bead, sanding and forming the openings for access panels and lighting. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Cielo raso desmontable con foseado perim: Demountable ceiling with a perimeter recessed section to conceal services and to house curtains. Includes the framework, the panels and the perimeter recessed section. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso desmontable de bandeja metáli: Demountable ceiling of linear metal trays, with a suspension framework. Includes the framework, laying the trays and the perimeter trim. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso desmontable de fibra mineral: Demountable ceiling of mineral fiber with a wool panel in the cavity, for acoustic insulation. Includes the framework, the wool, the panels and the perimeter trim. Measured per square meter completed.
Demountable mineral fiber ceiling with a concealed grid, on a 60x60 grid. Includes the suspended framework, fixing the panels and the perimeter trim. Measured per square meter completed.
Demountable mineral fiber ceiling with high acoustic absorption, with the grid system. Includes the framework, fixing the panels and the finishing. Measured per square meter completed.
Mineral fiber suspended ceiling with an exposed grid.
cadenas.Cielo raso desmontable de lámina de alum: Demountable linear aluminum strip ceiling, with the suspension system. Includes the framework, fixing the sheets and the perimeter trim. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso desmontable de malla o grilla: Demountable ceiling of metal mesh or grille, with a suspension framework. Includes the framework, laying the mesh panels and the trim. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso desmontable de panel con sist: Demountable ceiling of panels with a quick release clip system. Includes the framework, laying the panels with clips and the trim. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Cielo raso en alero, porche o área exter: Ceiling on a soffit, porch or covered external area, with PVC sheet or cement board on a moisture resistant framework. The material and the framework must be suitable for external use: a gypsum board, even a moisture resistant one, will not stand the permanent ambient humidity of an overhang and ends up sagging. Includes setting out and leveling, the framework of galvanized sections, laying the material with its movement joints, the ventilation of the cavity and the perimeter trim. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
Exterior ceiling to an eave or porch.
cadenas.Cielo raso registrable con bandejas o la: Suspended ceiling with prefinished metal trays or slats on a suspended framework. Compared with mineral fiber it stands up far better to moisture and to frequent cleaning, which makes it ideal in commercial kitchens, public toilets and protected external areas, although its acoustic behavior is worse unless a perforated tray with an acoustic fleece is used. Includes setting out and leveling, the perimeter, installing the supporting framework, laying the trays by fitting them in and adjusting the perimeter pieces. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Cielo raso registrable formado por panel: Suspended ceiling formed by 60x60 cm mineral fiber panels laid on exposed T bar sections suspended from the slab, with a perimeter angle. Its decisive advantage is the full access to the plenum: all the services running above stay accessible without breaking anything, so it is the standard solution in offices and commercial premises. Includes setting out and leveling with a laser, the perimeter angle, installing the grid with hangers, laying the panels and fitting the perimeter panels by cutting them clean. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Cierre y bloqueo de suministro eléctrico: Shut-off and lock-out of the electrical supply.
cadenas.Cierre y bloqueo del suministro eléctric: Shut-off and lock-out of the main electrical supply to the work area. Includes switching off the main isolator and locking it out. Measured per service locked out.
Shut-off and draining of the water installation.
cadenas.Cierre y drenaje de la instalación de ag: Shut-off and draining of the water installation serving the work area. Includes closing the stop valves and draining the pipework. Measured per service shut off.
cadenas.Cimbra y apuntalamiento de losa durante: Falsework and shoring of a slab during the pour. Includes placing the shores. Measured per square meter shored.
Falsework and shoring to a slab.
cadenas.Cinta o perfil antideslizante en nariz d: Anti-slip strip or profile on a stair nosing.
Opening skylight in a roof deck.
cadenas.Clasificación en obra del material proce: Sorting on site of material arising from demolition to separate what can be recovered from what is to be thrown away, with separate storage and management. Scrap, copper, aluminum and cardboard have a recovery value that can be deducted from the price or left to the benefit of the client, and separating them also reduces the volume going to landfill and therefore the cost of disposal. Includes manual separation by type of material, separate storage, removal of foreign items from the scrap and delivery or sale to the licensed waste carrier against a receipt. Measured by the volume of material actually sorted.
cadenas.Clasificación en origen de los residuos: Separation at source of demolition and strip-out waste, separating recoverable material from material for landfill, to cut the cost of disposal.
cadenas.Clasificación y recuperación de material: Sorting and recovery of reusable material.
cadenas.Colocación de accesorio de baño (toaller: Installation of a bathroom accessory (towel rail, soap dish, hook) fixed to the wall. Includes setting out and fixing.
Placing of reinforcement in a stair.
cadenas.Colocación de acero en losa de fundación: Placing of reinforcement in a foundation slab.
cadenas.Colocación de acero en muro de contenció: Placing of reinforcement in a retaining wall.
Placing of reinforcement in a pile.
cadenas.Colocación de aislamiento acústico de la: Laying mineral wool acoustic insulation in the cavity of gypsum board partitions or suspended ceilings. The insulation absorbs sound energy within the cavity, but its effect is cancelled out if there are rigid bridges or air paths: a back box placed back to back on either side of the partition lets through more noise than the insulation holds back. Includes cutting the boards oversize so that they stay in place by friction without slumping, laying them over the whole cavity leaving no voids and sealing around the service penetrations. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de aislamiento bajo el piso s: Installation of insulation beneath the floor over a crawl space, to prevent heat loss to outside.
cadenas.Colocación de aislamiento en el entrepis: Installation of insulation in the floor between dwellings, to improve thermal and acoustic performance.
cadenas.Colocación de aislamiento en el perímetr: Installation of insulation around the perimeter of the rooflight, to reduce heat loss.
Installation of insulation around the perimeter of the floor, to avoid the thermal bridge to the ground.
cadenas.Colocación de aislamiento en el piso del: Installation of insulation in the garage floor, to reduce heat loss to outside.
Installation of insulation in the attic floor, to reduce heat loss through the roof.
cadenas.Colocación de aislamiento en el techo qu: Installation of insulation in the ceiling separating conditioned from unconditioned spaces.
cadenas.Colocación de aislamiento entre las vigu: Installation of insulation between the ceiling joists, to eliminate thermal bridges.
cadenas.Colocación de aislamiento térmico bajo l: Laying thermal insulation beneath a mat foundation. Includes laying the boards. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de alfombra o moqueta, median: Laying of carpet, by direct gluing or a tackless strip system depending on the type, with its perimeter trim. Includes checking that the substrate is clean and dry, laying the underlay where the system requires it, cutting and laying out the lengths respecting the direction of the pile, which must be the same throughout the room because otherwise the lengths read as different tones, gluing or stretching, sealing the seams and the trim at thresholds and around the perimeter. The material is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de alféizar de madera. Incluy: Installation of a wood window sill. Includes fixing and finishing. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de alféizar de mármol. Incluy: Installation of a marble window sill. Includes bedding and pointing. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de alféizar de piedra. Incluy: Installation of a stone window sill. Includes bedding and pointing. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de anclaje mecánico de expans: Installation of an expansion anchor in concrete. Includes drilling and installation. Measured per anchor installed.
cadenas.Colocación de asiento abatible de ducha: Installation of a folding shower seat for accessibility, with strengthened fixing. Includes setting out and fixing. The seat is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de banca de descanso exterior: Installation of an external bench, anchored and fixed. Includes fixing. The furniture is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de banca de jugadores de canc: Installation of a team bench for a court, anchored and fixed. Includes fixing. The furniture is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de banda perimetral de desoli: Installation of a perimeter isolation strip at the floor to wall junction. Includes laying the strip and cutting it to length. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de banda perimetral elástica: Installation of an elastic perimeter strip at the floor to wall junction, to eliminate the acoustic and thermal bridge.
cadenas.Colocación de baranda de acceso peatonal: Installation of a guardrail at a pedestrian access, fixed and painted. Includes fixing and finishing.
cadenas.Colocación de baranda de protección en e: Installation of a guardrail around the perimeter of the slab, with posts and a toe board, to prevent falls.
cadenas.Colocación de barandilla o señalización: Installation of a guardrail or signage at the edge of an excavation, to prevent falls.
cadenas.Colocación de barra de apoyo abatible o: Installation of a folding or fixed grab bar at a toilet, with strengthened fixing. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de barra de apoyo de acero in: Installation of a stainless steel accessibility grab bar in a bathroom, with strengthened fixing to the wall. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de barra de apoyo en ducha o: Installation of a grab bar in a shower or bathtub for accessibility, with strengthened fixing. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de barra de colgar y soportes: Installation of a hanging rail and closet supports, fixed to the sides. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de barrera anticapilaridad en: Installation of a damp-proof course at the base of the wall, over the footing. Includes laying the membrane and the finish. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de barrera antihumedad en pis: Laying a damp-proof membrane to a floor, before the finish. Includes spreading the membrane and the laps. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de barrera antipolvo con lámi: Installation of a dust barrier of plastic sheeting. Includes fixing the sheeting and the closure. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de barrera de vapor bajo el a: Installation of a vapor control layer beneath the roof insulation, to prevent condensation.
cadenas.Colocación de barrera de vapor de poliet: Laying a polyethylene vapor barrier beneath the slab. Includes spreading and the laps. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de bordillo prefabricado de c: Installation of a precast concrete curb on a mortar bed. Includes laying and pointing.
cadenas.Colocación de burlete de estanqueidad en: Installation of draught seals around the perimeter of the external doors, to reduce infiltration.
cadenas.Colocación de buzón de correspondencia,: Installation of a mailbox, fixed to or recessed into the boundary. Includes fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de canal de PVC o lámina galv: Installation of a PVC or galvanized sheet gutter at the eaves, with brackets and a fall to the downpipe. Includes setting out, fixing and the finishings.
cadenas.Colocación de canal de drenaje lineal pr: Installation of a precast linear drainage channel with a grate, on a mortar bed. Includes laying and leveling.
cadenas.Colocación de cantonera en mocheta o ari: Installation of a corner bead at the reveal or arris of an opening. Includes fixing the bead and the trim. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de capa de gravilla lavada de: Laying a protective layer of washed gravel over the roof waterproofing, on a separating geotextile. The gravel protects the membrane from ultraviolet radiation, which is what ages it and cracks it, and ballasts it against wind uplift. Includes laying the separating geotextile that stops the gravel puncturing the membrane, spreading the layer to the uniform thickness specified and keeping clear margins around the roof drains so as not to block them. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de capa de protección de grav: Laying a protective gravel layer over the waterproofing. Includes spreading the gravel and leveling it. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de capa separadora de polieti: Laying a polyethylene separating layer beneath a slab or waterproofing. Includes spreading the sheet and the laps. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de cartel informativo de obra: Installation of a site information board. Includes fixing the board. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Colocación de celosía o romanilla de alu: Installation of an aluminum louver screen on a terrace, with a frame and fixing. Includes installation.
Installation of an aluminum louver screen for shading, reducing solar gain.
cadenas.Colocación de cenefa, listelo o pieza de: Fixing of a border, listello or continuous decorative tile within the ceramic tiling, bedded in adhesive and grouted to match. Includes setting out the line, which has to be coordinated with the general layout so that the border lines up with the joint between tiles and does not force awkward cuts, fixing tile by tile with leveling, the adjusting cuts at corners and junctions, grouting and cleaning. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Colocación de conector de cortante solda: Installation of a welded shear stud to a composite slab. Includes welding the stud. Measured per stud installed.
cadenas.Colocación de cornisa de yeso. Incluye l: Installation of a plaster cornice. Includes fixing and finishing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de coronación de muro con cha: Installation of a sheet metal coping to a wall. Includes fixing and sealing. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de correas de acero sobre las: Fixing steel purlins over the trusses to support the roof covering, welded or bolted. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de correas de madera sobre la: Fixing lumber purlins over the structure to support the roof covering, mechanically fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de cortina térmica interior,: Installation of an internal thermal blind, to improve the insulation of the opening.
cadenas.Colocación de dintel prefabricado de con: Installation of a precast reinforced concrete lintel over a door or window opening in a masonry wall, with the minimum bearing on each side. Includes checking that the bearing available on each side reaches the minimum required, the requirement on which it depends that the lintel works as one rather than merely filling the gap, leveling the bed in mortar, placing the unit level and plumb, bedding the bearings solid and filling the joint over. Measured by the length actually installed, including the bearings.
Installation of a precast reinforced concrete lintel over an opening. Includes hoisting and placing the lintel. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de directorio de planta con r: Installation of a floor directory with lettering, fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de enchapado cerámico o de po: Fixing of ceramic or porcelain tiling on a facade or exterior substrate, in a thin bed with a high performance cementitious adhesive type C2 with reduced slip, with movement joints in the bays and at the junctions. Outdoors the covering suffers thermal movement and moisture, so the adhesive, the wide joint and the movement joints stop being optional: they are what prevents the tiles from coming away. Includes working from scaffolding, checking the substrate, setting out, back buttering, forming the movement joints, grouting with an exterior mortar and cleaning. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de entrepaño flotante de pare: Installation of a melamine floating wall shelf, on concealed supports. Includes setting out, cutting and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de entrepaños y organizadores: Installation of closet shelves and internal organizers, with adjustable supports. Includes cutting and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de escalera de acceso a la ex: Installation of an access ladder to the excavation, for the safe evacuation of personnel.
cadenas.Colocación de escalera de acceso provisi: Installation of a temporary access ladder to the work area. Includes erection of the ladder. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de escalera de mano con fijac: Installation of a portable ladder, secured and stabilized, for one-off work at height.
cadenas.Colocación de escalera fija de acceso a: Installation of a fixed ladder giving access to the roof, anchored and fixed to the structure. Includes setting out and assembly.
cadenas.Colocación de espejo de cuerpo entero de: Installation of a full length bathroom mirror, fixed and sealed. Includes setting out and fixing. The mirror is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de espejo y botiquín de baño,: Installation of a bathroom mirror and medicine cabinet, fixed and sealed. Includes setting out and fixing. The mirror is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de faldón o panel de remate e: Installation of an infill panel between the countertop and the wall cabinet, in melamine or a matching material. Includes cutting and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de gancho o anclaje de seguri: Installation of a safety hook or anchor on the roof to attach a lifeline, fixed to the structure. Includes drilling and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de geocompuesto drenante en m: Installation of a drainage geocomposite to a wall or roof. Includes laying the geocomposite and the finish. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de geotextil de separación en: Laying a separating geotextile at the bottom of the footing excavation. Includes laying the geotextile. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de geotextil no tejido como c: Laying a non-woven geotextile as a separating layer between the insulation and the waterproofing membrane. Includes spreading, the laps and cutting in at the junctions.
cadenas.Colocación de geotextil separador bajo r: Laying a separating geotextile beneath fill or paving. Includes spreading the geotextile and the laps. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de geotextil separador en ter: Laying a separating geotextile on a terrace, between the waterproofing and the finish. Includes spreading the geotextile and the laps. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de huella y contrahuella de m: Fixing of wood treads and risers over an existing concrete stair, fixed with adhesive and concealed screws. It is a very common solution in refurbishment to renew a stair without demolishing it. Includes checking and making the surface of the concrete tread level, measuring tread by tread because on an existing stair they are rarely all the same, cutting and fitting each piece, gluing and concealed screwing, fitting the nosing and the side trim. The wood is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length of tread actually completed.
cadenas.Colocación de identificación y etiquetad: Identification and labelling of the containers or storage areas, indicating the type of waste accepted.
cadenas.Colocación de iluminación de emergencia: Installation of emergency lighting in the circulation and escape routes on site.
cadenas.Colocación de jardinera de concreto pref: Installation of a precast concrete planter, leveled and drained. Includes installation.
cadenas.Colocación de jardinera prefabricada ext: Installation of a precast external planter, fixed and drained. Includes installation. The planter is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de juego de accesorios y herr: Installation of a set of cabinet accessories and hardware (pulls, hinges, supports), fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de junta de estanqueidad anti: Installation of a dust-tight seal around an opening. Includes fixing the seal. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de laja o piedra natural de f: Fixing of flagstone or irregular format natural stone to an interior or exterior substrate, bedded in mortar or a high deformability adhesive depending on the thickness and the weight of the piece. As there is no regular layout, the work consists of composing the bay piece by piece looking for the fit and the distribution of tones, which reduces the output compared with any modular tiling. Includes selecting and sorting the material beforehand, setting out the bay, laying with a controlled irregular joint, grouting or a butt jointed finish depending on the design, cleaning and applying the water repellent sealer. The stone is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de listonado de madera sobre: Fixing lumber battens over the structure to receive the roof tiling, spaced according to the lap of the unit. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de lámina de polietileno como: Laying a polyethylene sheet as a vapor control layer beneath the roof insulation, with sealed laps and upstands at the walls. Includes cleaning the substrate and sealing the junctions.
cadenas.Colocación de lámina de polietileno de a: Laying a high density polyethylene sheet over the compacted base as a vapor barrier, to stop the capillary rise of moisture from the ground into the slab and the finished floor. It is a cheap layer whose omission causes permanent damp in the floor that cannot afterwards be put right without demolition. Includes checking that the base presents no arrises that could puncture the sheet, laying it with 20 cm laps sealed with tape, turning it up at the perimeter to the top of the slab and repairing any puncture made while the reinforcement is being placed. Measured by the area actually covered.
cadenas.Colocación de lámina drenante nodular en: Installation of a dimpled drainage membrane to a buried wall. Includes laying the membrane and the finish. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de lámina drenante nodular so: Installation of a dimpled drainage membrane over the waterproofing of a buried wall. Includes laying the membrane and the finish. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de lámina drenante sobre impe: Installation of a drainage membrane over the waterproofing of a footing. Includes laying the membrane. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de malla de protección en la: Installation of protective netting on the facade or on the scaffold, to contain falling material and dust towards the public highway or neighboring property. It is required whenever work at height is carried out over areas in use, and its absence is a common reason for the local authority to stop the work. Includes hoisting, hanging the overlapping sheets, tying them to the scaffold structure around the whole perimeter, periodic checking of the ties after windy weather and dismantling. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Colocación de malla de protección o defe: Installation of a protective mesh or guard to the facade. Includes fixing the mesh. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de malla electrosoldada de re: Placing welded wire mesh reinforcement to a slab. Includes placing and the laps. Measured per square meter placed.
Placing welded wire mesh reinforcement to a wall. Includes placing and the laps. Measured per square meter placed.
cadenas.Colocación de mampara antipolvo con puer: Installation of a dust screen with a door. Includes the frame and the sheeting. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de manta reflectiva bajo el p: Installation of reflective foil beneath the floor, to improve comfort and reduce heat loss.
cadenas.Colocación de manta reflectiva de doble: Installation of double bubble reflective foil beneath the roof, to reduce heat gain.

Laying double bubble reflective foil beneath a metal or tiled roof, fixed to the structure with sealed laps. It works by reflecting infrared radiation, not by thermal resistance, so it needs a ventilated air space beneath it to function: laid tight against the ceiling it loses almost all its effectiveness. Includes setting out, running out the sheets with lapped and sealed joints using aluminum tape, fixing to the purlins and the finish at the eaves and ridge. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de marquesina de protección s: Installation of a protective canopy over the site access, to prevent falling objects.
cadenas.Colocación de mesa de picnic exterior, c: Installation of an external picnic table, anchored and fixed. Includes fixing. The furniture is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de mesón de baño sobre mueble: Installation of a vanity top onto a unit or structure, drilled for the basin and sealed. Includes installation and sealing.
cadenas.Colocación de mesón de cuarzo compacto c: Installation of an engineered quartz countertop with a polished square edge and the drill holes. Includes templating, cutting and sealing. The quartz is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de moldura corrida de yeso. I: Installation of a run of plaster molding. Includes fixing and finishing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de moldura de madera. Incluye: Installation of a wood molding. Includes fixing and finishing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de moldura de poliuretano. In: Installation of a polyurethane molding. Includes fixing and finishing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de moldura de techo decorativ: Installation of a decorative ceiling molding. Includes fixing and finishing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de mulch o acolchado orgánico: Application of mulch over a planting bed, to retain moisture. Includes spreading.
cadenas.Colocación de nariz de peldaño de metal: Fixing of a metal stair nosing (aluminum or steel) with an anti-slip profile. Includes fixing the profile to the stair nosing. Measured per meter of nosing.
cadenas.Colocación de organizador de alacena con: Installation of a pantry organizer with pull-out baskets and supports. Includes fixing and adjustment.
cadenas.Colocación de panel composite sobre fach: Installation of composite panels on a facade, mechanically fixed, to improve insulation and appearance.
cadenas.Colocación de panel de aislamiento térmi: Laying thermal insulation boards over the roof deck, beneath the protection or the waterproofing depending on the system. In a tropical climate roof insulation has more impact on comfort and on air conditioning consumption than anything else, far more than facade insulation, because the roof is the surface that takes direct solar radiation all day. Includes leveling the substrate, laying the boards staggered and fitted tight without gaps, since any open joint is a thermal bridge, and fixing or ballasting them. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de panel de corcho o pizarra: Installation of a cork or whiteboard panel in an office, fixed to the wall. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de panel de lana de roca sobr: Installation of rock wool boards on the roof, to improve thermal and acoustic insulation.
Installation of rock wool boards on a facade, fixed and with a protective coating.
cadenas.Colocación de panel de lana mineral rígi: Laying rigid mineral wool boards on a flat roof or roof slope, for thermal and acoustic insulation. Includes setting out, cutting and laying with closed joints and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de panel de lana mineral sobr: Installation of mineral wool boards on a flat roof, before the waterproofing.
cadenas.Colocación de panel de poliestireno bajo: Installation of polystyrene boards beneath the floor, to reduce heat loss to the ground.
cadenas.Colocación de panel de poliestireno extr: Installation of extruded polystyrene boards on the roof, to reduce heat loss.
Installation of extruded polystyrene boards on a facade, fixed and with a protective coating.
cadenas.Colocación de panel rígido de lana miner: Installation of rigid mineral wool boards beneath the floor, for thermal and acoustic insulation.
cadenas.Colocación de paneles decorativos de PVC: Fixing of decorative panels in PVC, engineered wood, laminate or similar material to an interior substrate, mounted on battens or adhered depending on the system. Includes setting out the layout to center the bay and avoid narrow pieces at the edges, assembling and leveling the battens where the system requires it, fixing the panels with their interlocking system or adhesive, trimming around fittings and openings, and fitting the perimeter trim profiles. The panel is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de paneles rígidos de poliest: Laying rigid expanded polystyrene boards on a flat roof, tightly butted, for thermal insulation before the waterproofing. Includes setting out, cutting and laying with closed joints.
cadenas.Colocación de papel tapiz sobre parament: Hanging of wallpaper on an interior substrate previously prepared, with wallpaper adhesive. Includes checking that the substrate is smooth, dry and of uniform absorption, a condition without which the joints open or the irregularities show through, applying the sealing primer, plumbing the first length, cutting the lengths respecting the pattern match, pasting and hanging with the removal of bubbles and creases, trimming the excess at the baseboard and the ceiling, and cleaning off the adhesive residue. The paper is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de parquet encolado directame: Laying of parquet glued directly to the mortar bed with a polyurethane adhesive, without battens. It demands a perfectly flat, dry bed with no residual moisture: parquet glued over a damp base tents and comes away beyond remedy, so measuring the moisture of the substrate before laying is not a formality but the condition of the work. Includes checking the flatness and the moisture, priming the substrate if the adhesive requires it, setting out the layout, gluing and laying under pressure, the perimeter gap and the removal of adhesive residue. Sanding and varnishing are not included. The parquet is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de pasamanos de acero inoxida: Installation of a stainless steel handrail in a corridor for accessibility, with strengthened fixing. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de pasamanos de madera sobre: Fixing of a wood handrail on a stair, with brackets and end caps. Includes fixing the handrail and the finish. Measured per meter of handrail.
cadenas.Colocación de pasamanos exterior de acer: Installation of an external steel handrail, fixed and painted. Includes fixing and finishing.
cadenas.Colocación de peldaño de madera flotante: Fixing of a floating wood tread over an existing stair, with fixing. Includes preparing the substrate and fixing the tread. Measured per meter of tread.
cadenas.Colocación de peldaño prefabricado de co: Installation of a precast concrete step for an external stair. Includes laying and pointing.
cadenas.Colocación de perfil de cierre entre cie: Fixing of a closure profile between ceilings at different levels, as a transition. Includes fixing the profile and the finishing. Measured per meter of closure.
cadenas.Colocación de perfil de remate decorativ: Installation of a decorative trim. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de perfil de remate en frente: Installation of a trim to the slab edge. Includes fixing the profile and the trim. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de perfil de remate perimetra: Installation of a perimeter trim profile between the ceiling and the wall, as a finish. Includes fixing the profile and finishing the joints. Measured per meter of trim.
cadenas.Colocación de perfil de transición decor: Installation of a decorative transition profile. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de perfil esquinero decorativ: Installation of a decorative corner trim. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de perno de anclaje en concre: Installation of an anchor bolt in concrete. Includes drilling and installation. Measured per bolt installed.
cadenas.Colocación de persiana aislante con cajó: Installation of an insulated roller shutter with a sealed box, to improve the insulation of the opening. The shutter is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de persiana enrollable de alu: Installation of an aluminum roller shutter for solar control. The shutter is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de pieza de coronación de mur: Installation of a coping unit to a wall. Includes laying the unit. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de piezas cerámicas o de porc: Fixing of ceramic or porcelain tiles to the treads and risers of a stair, with a nosing piece or a bullnosed edge. The output is noticeably lower than on a plain floor because of the working position, the fragmentation into treads and because each tread has to be cut to measure. Includes setting out, checking that the going and the rise stay constant throughout the flight, a safety requirement because a difference between treads causes trips, the cuts, back buttering, fitting the nosing, grouting and cleaning. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, taking the treads and the risers.
cadenas.Colocación de piezas de mármol, granito: Fixing of marble, granite or natural stone to the treads and risers of a stair, bedded in a high performance white cementitious adhesive. It is the stair covering with the lowest output, because of the weight of the pieces, the leveling demanded and cutting each tread to measure. Includes setting out, verifying that the going and the rise are constant, cutting and polishing the edge of the tread, back buttering, leveling, grouting to match and cleaning with non acidic products. The stone is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, taking the treads and the risers.
cadenas.Colocación de piezas de piedra natural e: Fixing of natural stone on a facade by means of stainless steel mechanical anchors, without relying on the adhesive as the load bearing element. It is the required solution beyond a certain height, thickness or weight of slab, where an adhered cladding does not offer sufficient security against the pieces coming away. Includes working from scaffolding, setting out, drilling the housings in the edge of the slab and in the substrate, placing the anchors with their resin, plumbing and leveling each slab, sealing the joints and cleaning. The stone is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso cerámico con guarda o: Laying of a ceramic tile floor with a perimeter border of decorative tile, in a thin bed. Includes the field layout, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de piso cerámico o de porcela: Laying of ceramic or porcelain tiling on a terrace, patio or exterior area, with a high performance cementitious adhesive, a wide joint and movement joints around the perimeter and in the bays. Outdoors the floor suffers thermal movement and moisture beneath the tile, so the wide joint and the movement joints are what prevent tenting and the tiles coming away through the build up of stress. Includes checking the drainage fall of the substrate, setting out, back buttering, forming the movement joints, grouting with an exterior mortar and the perimeter sealing. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².

Laying of ceramic or porcelain tiling in a wet area, forming the falls towards the drain and treating the junction with the floor drain. Getting the fall right is what determines whether the water drains away or lies in puddles, a defect that in a shower or a laundry is noticed on the first day of use. Includes setting out the falls from the edges towards the drain, cutting and fitting the tiles around the drain, back buttering, leveling while keeping the fall, grouting with a mortar suitable for wet areas, and the flexible sealing of the junction with the walls and with the drain. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso cerámico por el métod: Laying of ceramic tiling by the traditional thick bed method, bedding the tile on a layer of fresh mortar that both receives the tile and forms the level. It is used where the substrate has unevenness that would make a thin bed unviable, since it allows the level and the flatness to be corrected in a single operation, although it demands more material and more skill from the tiler. Includes setting out the levels with screeds, spreading the mortar, dusting with cement, bedding and tapping the tile down to level, continuous checking with a straightedge and a level, grouting and cleaning. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso con baldosa de granit: Laying of a floor with precast terrazzo tiles, bedded in mortar or adhesive depending on the thickness, with a leveling grind on site. Includes setting out the layout, laying with leveling and a minimal joint, grouting with a cement slurry to match, the leveling grind that removes the lippage between tiles and unifies the plane, filling the pores and buffing. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso con pieza cerámica o: Laying of a floor with standard format ceramic or porcelain tile, up to 60x60 cm, over a substrate previously made level and clean. Laid in a thin bed with an improved cementitious adhesive C2 TE applied with a notched trowel and back buttering the tile, leveling with a system of spacers and wedges, and grouting with a CG2 cementitious mortar in the chosen color. Includes setting out beforehand to center the layout, cuts and adjustments at junctions and where services pass through, the final cleaning of the surface and the removal of debris. The ceramic tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso con pieza de porcelan: Laying of a floor with large format rectified porcelain tile, 120x60 cm or larger, over a substrate previously made level. Laid in a thin bed with an improved cementitious adhesive C2 TE by back buttering, handling the tiles with a set of suction cups, leveling with wedges to guarantee the flatness the format demands, and a minimal joint grouted with a CG2 mortar. Includes checking the flatness of the substrate beforehand, setting out the layout, cutting with a water cooled diamond disc cutter, the final cleaning and the removal of debris. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso de baldosa hidráulica: Laying of a hydraulic tile or cement mosaic floor, bedded in mortar and grouted with a slurry, with a leveling grind on site if the finish requires it. It is a tile of great decorative value, very much present in traditional Venezuelan building, but it is porous and does not come calibrated, so it has to be sealed before grouting so that the grout does not stain it permanently. Includes setting out the layout of the pattern, sealing the tile beforehand, bedding with leveling, grouting, immediate cleaning and the final sealing. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso de bambú encolado sob: Laying of a glued bamboo floor over a leveled fill. Includes preparation of the substrate, the gluing and finishing the joints. Measured per square meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de piso de caucho en rollo o: Laying of a rubber floor in roll or tile form, glued to the substrate, for gymnasiums, sports areas, plant rooms and heavy traffic areas. Includes preparing and leveling the substrate, cutting and laying out the material and leaving it to relax so that it recovers its dimension before fixing, gluing, rolling, adjusting and sealing the joints, and the perimeter trim with a cove or a profile. The material is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso de caucho, loseta dre: Laying of a rubber floor, drainage tile or artificial grass in exterior areas, terraces and play areas, over a prepared base. Includes checking and leveling the base with its drainage fall, laying the material interlocking or glued depending on the system, cutting the adjusting pieces, the perimeter trim, and on artificial grass the brushing and the silica sand infill that keeps the fiber standing up. The material is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso de laja o piedra natu: Laying of a flagstone or irregular format natural stone floor, bedded in mortar or a high deformability adhesive depending on the thickness of the piece. As there is no regular layout, the bay is composed piece by piece looking for the fit and the distribution of tones, which noticeably reduces the output. Includes selecting and sorting the material beforehand, setting out the bay, laying with a controlled irregular joint, grouting, cleaning and applying the water repellent sealer that protects the stone and makes it easier to maintain. The stone is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso de linóleo encolado s: Laying of a glued linoleum floor over a leveled substrate. Includes the preparation, the gluing and finishing the joints. Measured per square meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de piso de mármol en placa de: Laying of a marble floor in large format slabs, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de piso de mármol o granito e: Laying of a marble or granite floor in a thin bed with a high performance white cementitious adhesive, with a minimal joint. White adhesive is essential on light marbles because the grey shows through the slab and produces irreversible staining. Includes checking and making the substrate level beforehand, setting out the layout taking account of the veining and the tone so that the composition runs continuously, back buttering, leveling with wedges, cutting with a water cooled disc, grouting to match and cleaning with non acidic products, since acid attacks marble permanently. The slab is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso de parquet encolado e: Laying of a glued parquet floor in a herringbone pattern, over a leveled fill. Includes setting out the pattern, the gluing and sanding. Measured per square meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de piso de piedra natural a j: Laying of a natural stone floor with a minimal joint, in a thin bed. Includes the preparation, laying and sealing the joint. Measured per square meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de piso de porcelanato rectif: Laying of a rectified porcelain tile floor with a minimal joint, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de piso laminado flotante sob: Laying of a laminate floating floor on an acoustic underlay, assembled by interlocking without adhesive, with a perimeter expansion gap. The floating system requires the perimeter gap to be left free all round and hidden under the baseboard: if the floor is butted tight against the wall, it tents and lifts when it expands. Includes checking the flatness and the moisture of the mortar bed, laying the underlay with sealed laps, setting out the direction of the boards and the width of the last row, interlocking assembly with perimeter wedges, the adjusting cuts at frames and pipes and removing the wedges. The floor is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso vinílico de lujo tipo: Laying of a luxury vinyl SPC (rigid core) floating floor, with an acoustic underlay. Includes the preparation, the floating installation and the trim. Measured per square meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de piso vinílico en baldosa o: Laying of a vinyl floor in tile or plank form, LVT type, self adhesive, glued or interlocking depending on the system. It combines the ease of replacing piece by piece with an appearance very close to that of wood or stone. Includes checking the flatness, cleanliness and moisture of the substrate, setting out the layout to center the bay and avoid narrow pieces at the edges, laying with a butt joint, rolling on the glued systems, the adjusting cuts at frames and pipes, and the perimeter trim. The material is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de piso vinílico en lámina co: Laying of a continuous sheet vinyl floor, glued to the mortar bed, with the joints between sheets welded or sealed. Its advantage over tile is the almost total absence of joints, which makes it ideal in areas with demanding hygiene requirements. It needs a perfectly smooth substrate, since vinyl is a thin material that copies and makes visible any grain or irregularity in the bed. Includes the fine leveling beforehand if the substrate needs it, cutting and laying out the sheets and leaving them to relax, gluing, rolling to remove the air, welding or sealing the joints and the perimeter trim. The material is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación de placa de identificación de: Installation of a door identification plate, fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de placa de rotulación en bra: Installation of a braille sign plate for accessibility, fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de plancha de cemento o loset: Laying cement boards or protective slabs over the waterproofing membrane of a trafficable roof, bedded on supports. Includes setting out and laying.
cadenas.Colocación de protección de fachada cont: Installation of impact protection to the facade. Includes fixing the protection. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de rampa portátil de acceso p: Installation of a portable access ramp for accessibility, anchored and fixed. Includes placing and anchoring.
cadenas.Colocación de red de seguridad en hueco: Installation of safety netting in a stairwell opening, with tie cords, to prevent falls.
cadenas.Colocación de red de seguridad en huecos: Installation of safety netting at horizontal openings, light wells and perimeters, with its tie cords and anchors. It acts as secondary protection where the risk of falling cannot be eliminated, and its effectiveness depends entirely on the strength of the anchors and on the net being free of openings and damage. Includes field layout of the anchor points, installation of the net with the perimeter rope tied at every point specified, periodic inspection and inspection after any incident, and dismantling. Measured by the area of netting actually installed.
cadenas.Colocación de red de seguridad horizonta: Installation of horizontal safety netting beneath a roof, to arrest falls.
cadenas.Colocación de red vertical de protección: Installation of vertical safety netting at the edge of a slab, with its supports.
cadenas.Colocación de refuerzo de aislamiento en: Installation of additional insulation at the ridge of the roof, to eliminate the thermal bridge.
Installation of additional insulation at parapets, edges and details of the facade.
cadenas.Colocación de refuerzo interior de mader: Installation of internal strengthening in wood or metal section between the studs of a gypsum board partition, at the position intended to hang cabinets, televisions, wall hung basins, grab bars or any point load. It has to be set out and fixed before the partition is closed: doing it afterwards means opening the board. Includes setting out the exact height and position according to the element to be carried, cutting and fixing the strengthening to the studs, and recording its position on the drawing so that it can be found once the partition is closed and finished. Measured per strengthening actually installed.
cadenas.Colocación de registro de acceso practic: Installation of an access panel in a demountable ceiling, for the inspection of services. Includes fixing the panel and the trim. Measured per unit of access panel.
cadenas.Colocación de remate de borde de piso. I: Installation of a floor edge trim. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de remate de cenefa de ilumin: Installation of a pelmet trim for indirect lighting. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de remate de escalera. Incluy: Installation of a stair edge trim. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de remate de tapajuntas de es: Installation of a corner piece to the architrave. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de remate de vano con perfil: Installation of an aluminum trim to an opening. Includes fixing the profile and the trim. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de remate de vano con pieza d: Installation of a cast stone trim to an opening. Includes placing the unit and pointing. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de remate de zócalo decorativ: Installation of a decorative baseboard trim. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de remate decorativo perimetr: Installation of a decorative perimeter trim to a ceiling, with a profile or molding. Includes fixing the trim and the finish. Measured per meter of trim.
cadenas.Colocación de remate especial de cielo r: Installation of a special ceiling trim. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de remate especial de fachada: Installation of a special facade trim. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de repisa de baño en melamina: Installation of a melamine or wood bathroom shelf, fixed to the wall. Includes cutting and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié cerámico corrido e: Fixing of a continuous ceramic baseboard at the foot of the substrate, in service areas, corridors and circulation areas, to protect the plaster from knocks and from the moisture of cleaning. Includes setting out the height, cutting the tiles, the adhesive, leveling, grouting and sealing the bottom joint with the floor. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié de PVC con canalet: Fixing of a PVC baseboard with an integrated channel for running services. Includes fixing the baseboard channel and the trim. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié de PVC, con su adh: Fixing of a PVC baseboard, with its adhesive and trim. Includes preparation of the substrate and fixing the baseboard. Measured per meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié de aluminio, con f: Fixing of an aluminum baseboard, with mechanical or adhesive fixing. Includes preparation of the substrate and fixing the baseboard. Measured per meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié de madera lacada,: Fixing of a lacquered wood baseboard, with mechanical or adhesive fixing. Includes preparation of the substrate and fixing the baseboard. Measured per meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié de madera o MDF la: Fixing of a wood or lacquered MDF baseboard, fixed to the substrate with adhesive and secret nailing, with mitre cuts at the corners. Includes setting out, the mitre cuts at internal and external corners, fitting around the door frames, fixing with a combination of adhesive and pins, filling and hiding the nail holes, and sealing the top joint with the wall where the finish requires it. The baseboard is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié de piedra natural,: Fixing of a natural stone baseboard, with adhesive and grouting. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié de pieza cerámica: Fixing of a ceramic or porcelain baseboard to match the flooring, bedded in an improved cementitious adhesive C2 TE over a substrate previously made level. Includes setting out, mitre cuts at corners and junctions, fitting to the joinery frames, grouting with a CG2 mortar and sealing the bottom joint with the flooring. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length actually completed, deducting the doorways.
cadenas.Colocación de rodapié de porcelanato rec: Fixing of a rectified porcelain baseboard, with adhesive and a minimal joint. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per meter laid.
cadenas.Colocación de rotulación corporativa de: Installation of corporate signage on a facade, anchored and fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de salpicadero de mesón en el: Installation of a countertop backsplash in the same material as the countertop or in the facing, with the joints sealed. Includes fixing and sealing.
cadenas.Colocación de salpicadero de vidrio o ac: Installation of a glass or acrylic backsplash over the countertop, fixed and sealed. Includes cutting and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de señal de evacuación y emer: Installation of an escape and emergency sign, fixed and lettered. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de señal de identificación de: Installation of a sign identifying interior areas and zones, fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de señal de prohibición o adv: Installation of a prohibition or warning sign, fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de señal exterior de parcela: Installation of an external sign for the plot or premises, fixed and anchored. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de señal fotoluminiscente de: Installation of a photoluminescent escape sign, fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de señalización de escaleras: Installation of signage for stairs and handrails, fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de señalización de extintores: Installation of signage for fire extinguishers and the site firefighting equipment.
Installation of signage for fire extinguishers and safety equipment, fixed. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de señalización de riesgos (c: Installation of hazard signage (falls, impact, electricity) on site.
cadenas.Colocación de señalización de vías de ev: Installation of signage for escape routes and emergency exits on site.
cadenas.Colocación de soporte de bicicletas exte: Installation of an external bicycle rack, anchored and fixed. Includes fixing. The furniture is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de soporte de ducha teléfono: Installation of an accessible hand shower holder, with strengthened fixing. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de tapajuntas de MDF. Incluye: Installation of an MDF architrave. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de tapajuntas de PVC. Incluye: Installation of a PVC cover strip. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de tapajuntas de aluminio. In: Installation of an aluminum cover strip. Includes fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de tapajuntas de madera en pu: Installation of wood architrave to a door or window. Includes fixing and finishing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Colocación de teja de borde o de remate: Laying edge or eaves closing tiles with a fixing clip, to prevent wind uplift. Includes mechanically fixing each unit.
cadenas.Colocación de tira LED de iluminación ef: Installation of an efficient LED strip light, with driver and profile. The strip is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de tira LED exterior decorati: Installation of a decorative external LED strip, with the driver and profile. Includes connection. The strip is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de toldo exterior de protecci: Installation of an external solar shading awning, to reduce heat gain. The awning is selected by the client.
cadenas.Colocación de tragante o boquilla de des: Installation of a roof drain, connected to the downpipe and sealed into the waterproofing. Includes forming the opening and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de tragante o sumidero de des: Installation of a roof drain in a translucent roof, connected to the downpipe and sealed. Includes forming the opening and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de tubería de drenaje de agua: Installation of external PVC rainwater drainage pipe, with falls and fittings. Includes laying and backfilling.
cadenas.Colocación de tubería de drenaje perfora: Installation of perforated corrugated drainage pipe wrapped in geotextile, on a gravel bed. Includes laying and backfilling.
cadenas.Colocación de vidrio en marco existente,: Installation of glass in an existing frame, replacing the broken pane. Includes removing the broken glass, measuring and installing the new. Measured per square meter installed.
Installation of glass in an existing frame.
cadenas.Colocación de vidrio esmerilado en divis: Installation of frosted glass in a divider.
cadenas.Colocación de vidrio templado en carpint: Installation of tempered glass in joinery.
cadenas.Colocación de vierteaguas de chapa metál: Installation of a sheet metal weather sill. Includes fixing and sealing. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de vierteaguas de piedra arti: Installation of a cast stone weather sill. Includes bedding and pointing. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de vierteaguas prefabricado d: Installation of a precast concrete weather sill. Includes bedding. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Colocación de viga cumbrera de madera en: Fixing a lumber ridge beam at the top of the roof, to carry the rafters. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Colocación de zócalo de piedra natural a: Fixing of a natural stone base to match the floor or the substrate, bedded in white cementitious adhesive. Includes setting out the height, the mitre cuts at corners and junctions, fixing with leveling, grouting and sealing the bottom joint with the floor. The stone is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Colocación en pared de pieza de mármol o: Fixing of marble or granite to a wall in a thin bed, with a high performance white cementitious adhesive. The white adhesive is not a whim: light marbles are translucent and a grey adhesive shows through and stains the slab irreversibly. Includes checking and making the substrate level, setting out the layout taking account of the veining and the tone so that the composition runs continuously, back buttering, leveling, cutting with a water cooled disc, grouting with a minimal joint to match and cleaning with non acidic products. The slab is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Colocación en pared de pieza de porcelan: Fixing of large format rectified porcelain tile to a wall, 60x120 cm or larger, in a thin bed with an improved cementitious adhesive and back buttering. On a vertical surface, large format demands a perfectly flat substrate and the use of leveling systems and temporary supports to hold the tile while the adhesive grabs, because its weight tends to make it slide down. Includes checking and correcting the flatness beforehand, setting out the layout, back buttering, leveling with wedges, cutting with a water cooled disc cutter, grouting and the final cleaning. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Compactación de terraplén con plancha vi: Compaction of an embankment with a plate compactor. Includes compaction in layers. Measured per square meter compacted.
cadenas.Concreto estructural con aditivo plastif: Structural concrete with a plasticizing admixture. Includes pouring with the admixture. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural de alta resistencia: High strength structural concrete (300 kg/cm²). Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para columna, vacia: Structural concrete for a column, cast in place. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para dintel. Incluy: Structural concrete for a lintel. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para escalera. Incl: Structural concrete for a stair. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para losa de entrep: Structural concrete for an intermediate floor slab. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para losa maciza. I: Structural concrete for a solid slab. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
