Structural concrete for a ribbed slab. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para muro o pantall: Structural concrete for a structural wall. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para rampa. Incluye: Structural concrete for a ramp. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para viga de amarre: Structural concrete for a tie beam. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para viga de corona: Structural concrete for a ring beam. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para viga, vaciado: Structural concrete for a beam, cast in place. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto estructural para zapata de medi: Structural concrete for a party wall footing. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para base o dado de equipo. Inc: Concrete for an equipment plinth or base. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para cabezal de pilotes. Incluy: Concrete for a pile cap. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para escalera de concreto armad: Concrete for a reinforced concrete stair.
Concrete for an intermediate floor slab.
cadenas.Concreto para losa de fundación. Incluye: Concrete for a mat foundation. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para muro de contención. Incluy: Concrete for a retaining wall. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para pedestal de concreto armad: Concrete for a reinforced concrete pedestal.
Concrete for a reinforced concrete pedestal. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para pila o elemento de fundaci: Concrete for a pier or deep foundation element. Includes pouring. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para pilote de gran sección. In: Concrete for a large diameter pile. Includes pouring. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para pilote vaciado en sitio. I: Concrete for a cast-in-place pile. Includes pouring. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para viga de amarre. Incluye el: Concrete for a tie beam. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para viga de fundación. Incluye: Concrete for a grade beam. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para viga de riostra. Incluye e: Concrete for a tie beam. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto para zapata combinada. Incluye: Concrete for a combined footing. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
Concrete for a party wall footing.
cadenas.Concreto para zapata de medianería. Incl: Concrete for a party wall footing. Includes pouring and vibrating. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto pobre de limpieza bajo fundació: Mud slab beneath a footing, 5 cm thick. Includes pouring and leveling. Measured per square meter constructed.
cadenas.Concreto premezclado de resistencia 210: Ready-mixed concrete of 210 kg/cm² strength poured into a tie beam, including compaction by vibration and curing. The tie beam ties the footings together and is what absorbs differential settlement, so its continuity and the correct execution of the joints with the footings are decisive. Includes the prior check of the cage and of the cover, taking delivery of the concrete, pouring continuously to avoid cold joints at the connections, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding the top face and curing. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 210 kg/cm² strength poured into an isolated footing, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the formwork and of the cover, taking delivery of and checking the concrete on arrival and rejecting the load if the slump is not right, pouring in layers avoiding segregation, compacting with an internal vibrator without touching the cage or the formwork, screeding the top face, curing over the first few days and taking test cylinders where quality control requires it. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 210 kg/cm² strength poured into a strip footing under a wall or a line of columns, including compaction by vibration and curing. Pouring into a continuous trench gives a slightly better output than isolated footings because of the continuity of the working face. Includes the prior check of the cage and of the cover, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring in layers, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding the top face to the level specified and curing over the first few days. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Concreto premezclado de resistencia 250: Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a column, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes cleaning the bottom of the formwork through the opening provided before closing it, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring in layers of limited height using a drop chute to avoid segregation from free fall, compacting each layer with an internal vibrator without touching the cage, striking off the head and leaving the surface rough for the joint with the beam above, stripping and curing. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a stair, including compaction by vibration and curing. Pouring on a slope needs a drier mix than usual so that it does not run down the flight, and it must be done working upwards from the foot. Includes the prior check of the formwork, the shoring and the cage, taking delivery of the concrete at the right slump, pouring upwards step by step, compacting with a vibrator, floating the treads and risers, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a mat foundation, including compaction by vibration. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the spacers and of the vapor barrier, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring continuously in bays avoiding cold joints, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding to level against screed rails and removing the bleed water before finishing. It does not include the surface finish or the curing, which are priced in the following item. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a solid intermediate floor or roof slab, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the formwork, of the shoring, of the cage and of the cover, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring continuously in bays to avoid cold joints, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding to level against screed rails, floating the surface and curing over the first few days. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a retaining wall, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the formwork and of the cover, taking delivery of the concrete, pouring in layers of limited height and at alternate points so as not to rack the formwork, using a drop chute where the height of fall could cause segregation, compacting each layer with an internal vibrator, extended curing and stripping once the strength has been reached. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a structural wall, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the formwork and of the cover, taking delivery of the concrete, pouring in layers of limited height and at alternate points so as not to rack the formwork, using a drop chute to avoid segregation, compacting each layer with an internal vibrator, extended curing and stripping once the strength has been reached. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a bored pile, placed by tremie pipe or hopper with a drop tube. Includes checking that the bottom is clean and that the cage is in position, taking delivery of the concrete at a consistency that allows it to be placed without vibration over the full depth, pouring continuously from the bottom upwards without interruptions that would cause discontinuities, comparing the volume actually placed against the theoretical as an indicator of possible overbreak or losses, and overpouring the head to displace the contaminated concrete. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design diameter and length.

Ready-mixed concrete of 250 kg/cm² strength poured into a beam, including compaction by vibration and curing. Includes the prior check of the cage, of the shoring and of the cover, taking delivery of and checking the concrete, pouring continuously to avoid cold joints and respecting the position of the construction joints specified in the middle third of the span, compacting with an internal vibrator, screeding the top face, curing and the staged removal of the shoring once the strength has been reached. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Conductor captador de cumbrera y perímet: Air-termination conductor along the ridge and roof perimeter.
Shear connector in a composite slab.
cadenas.Conexión de bomba exterior con tubería,: Connection of an external pump with pipework, a valve and the electrical supply. Includes the hydraulic and electrical connections. The pump is selected by the client.
Connection of drainage to an existing system.
cadenas.Conexión de drenaje exterior a la red ex: Connection of external drainage to the existing system, with excavation, the junction and backfilling. Includes connection and backfilling.
cadenas.Conexión de red de riego por goteo a tan: Connection of a drip irrigation system to a storage tank, with a valve and filter. Includes connection.
Connection of drip irrigation to a tank.
Connection of a photovoltaic system to the grid.
cadenas.Conexión del sistema fotovoltaico a la r: Connection of the photovoltaic system to the grid, with protective devices and commissioning.
Welded connection of a base plate.
cadenas.Construcción de jardinera de obra en ext: Construction of a planter externally, with its masonry, stucco, internal waterproofing, drainage and filter layer. A planter without waterproofing and without drainage transmits permanent moisture to the adjoining wall and waterlogs the soil until the roots rot, so both layers are part of the element and not an extra. Includes the footing, building the masonry, the external stucco, the internal waterproofing with reinforcement at the junctions, the sleeve and the drainage pipe, the gravel layer with geotextile and the capping. The growing medium and the planting are not included. Measured by the length of planter.
cadenas.Construcción de tanquilla o registro de: Construction of a drainage inspection chamber in masonry or concrete, with its base slab, stuccoed walls, cover and connections. Includes excavation, pouring the base slab with the benching that guides the flow and prevents siltation, building the walls, the waterproofed internal stucco, connecting the inlet and outlet pipes at their levels and gradients, setting the frame and cover flush with the paving and the flow test. Measured per unit constructed.
cadenas.Construcción o instalación de registro d: Construction or installation of an inspection chamber in the drainage system, with its benched base, walls, airtight cover and connections. The chamber has to be sited at changes of direction and on long runs, because it is the only point from which the system can be cleared without breaking up the floor. Includes excavation, the base with the benching that guides the flow and prevents siltation, building the walls, the waterproofed internal stucco, the connections at their levels and the airtight cover set flush with the floor. Measured per unit constructed.
cadenas.Contenedor de escombro, por mes de perma: Debris container, per month on site.
Control of access to the work area.
Control of access to the site.
cadenas.Control de apriete de pernos estructural: Checking the tightening of structural bolts.
cadenas.Control de planitud de pisos con regla y: Flatness check of floors with a straightedge and level. Includes the check. Measured per square meter checked.
Checking of concrete cover to reinforcement.
Geometric check of wall and ceiling surfaces.
cadenas.Control geométrico de plomos y niveles d: Geometric check that wall and ceiling surfaces are plumb and level. Includes checking with a laser level. Measured per square meter checked.
cadenas.Cornisa para iluminación indirecta en ci: Cornice for indirect lighting in a ceiling.
Coping of a wall with sheet metal.
Coping of a wall in mortar.
Coping of a wall with precast units.
cadenas.Correas de madera aserrada para cubierta: Sawn lumber purlins for a roof.
cadenas.Correas metálicas para estructura de tec: Steel purlins for a roof structure.
cadenas.Correas y viguetas de madera para cubier: Wood purlins and joists for a roof or intermediate floor.
Cutting of concrete with a diamond blade.
cadenas.Corte de concreto o mampostería con disc: Cutting concrete or masonry with a water cooled diamond blade, to define demolitions, open joints or prepare openings with a straight edge. The cut beforehand is what stops the demolition dragging and cracking the material that remains, and it is the difference between a clean opening and a hole that has to be rebuilt. Includes setting out and marking the line, checking beforehand that no services or critical reinforcement run along the line, cutting with water, collecting the slurry produced and clearing away. Measured by the length actually cut.
cadenas.Corte de losa de concreto para apertura: Cutting a concrete slab to form an opening for a stair or hoist. Includes the shoring, the perimeter cut and demolition of the panel. Measured per square meter of opening.
cadenas.Corte de losa para escalera o montacarga: Cutting of a slab for a stair or lift.
cadenas.Corte de muro de fundación con disco de: Cutting a foundation wall with a diamond blade, to form an opening or for partial demolition. Includes setting out the cut and cutting dry or with water. Measured per meter cut.
Saw cutting of a foundation wall.
cadenas.Corte de oxicorte con pantalla de protec: Oxy-fuel cutting with a protective screen.
cadenas.Corte y demolición de viga de fundación: Cutting and demolition of a grade beam or tie beam, with the steel cut and mechanical demolition. Includes cutting the ends and removing the debris. Measured per meter demolished.
Cutting and demolition of a foundation beam.
Recessed curtain track in a ceiling.
cadenas.Cristalizado y abrillantado de piso de p: Crystallizing and buffing of a natural stone or granite floor, to recover the shine and the surface protection. Includes the mechanical polishing with abrasives and the final buffing. Measured per square meter polished.
Crystallization and buffing of a stone floor.
cadenas.Cubierta con lámina metálica acanalada g: Roof covering of galvanized or prefinished corrugated metal sheet, fixed to the purlins with self-drilling screws and neoprene washers. The screw must be tightened until the washer is compressed without deforming the sheet: overtightened, the washer degrades and leaks; undertightened, it does not seal. Includes setting out the side and end laps against the prevailing wind, placing and aligning the sheets, fixing on the crown of the corrugation, sealing the laps and the eaves, ridge and edge finishings. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cubierta con panel sándwich de doble cha: Roof covering of sandwich panels with two metal faces and a polyurethane insulating core, fixed to the purlins with purpose-made fasteners and sealed tongue and groove joints. It resolves the covering, the thermal insulation and the internal finish in a single operation, which offsets its higher material cost against plain sheeting with separate insulation. Includes setting out, hoisting and placing the panels with the joints engaged, sealing the joints, fixing and the ridge, eaves and edge finishings with purpose-made units. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cubierta con teja asfáltica tipo shingle: Roof covering of asphalt shingles nailed to a continuous deck over asphalt felt. It needs a continuous firm deck, not simply battens, because an asphalt shingle has no stiffness of its own and follows every irregularity in the substrate. Includes laying the felt with laps, setting out the courses, nailing the shingles with the number and position of nails the manufacturer specifies, since wind resistance depends on it, forming the ridges with purpose-made units and the edge finishes with metal trim. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cubierta con teja criolla de arcilla coc: Roof covering of fired clay barrel tiles on battens or a continuous bed, bedded in mortar at the eaves, ridges and edges and laid dry on the slope. Includes setting out the courses so that the closing tile is not cut, laying the pan and cover tiles with the lap the gradient requires, bedding the edge tiles in mortar, which are the ones the wind lifts, forming the ridges and hips and the final clean. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Cubierta de lámina de fibrocemento ondul: Roof covering of corrugated fiber cement sheet on purlins, screwed with laps. Includes setting out, fixing and the finishings.
cadenas.Cubierta de lámina de zinc con fieltro b: Zinc sheet roof on an underlayment.
cadenas.Cubierta de lámina metálica acanalada ga: Roof covering of galvanized corrugated metal sheet on purlins, screwed with side and end laps. Includes setting out, fixing and the finishings.
cadenas.Cubierta de lámina metálica acanalada pr: Roof covering of prefinished corrugated metal sheet on purlins, screwed with laps and side finishings. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Cubierta de lámina metálica con fieltro: Roof covering of metal sheet with a felt or membrane beneath, on a continuous deck, to prevent condensation. Includes laying the barrier and the sheeting.
cadenas.Cubierta de malla sombra tensada sobre e: Tensioned shade netting on a structure for recreation areas, with cables and anchors. Includes the structure and tensioning the netting.
cadenas.Cubierta de panel sándwich con núcleo de: Roof covering of sandwich panels with a polyurethane core on purlins, with tongue and groove joints fixed with self-drilling screws. Includes setting out and the finishings.
Sandwich panel roof with a polyurethane core.
cadenas.Cubierta de teja asfáltica en shingle so: Roof covering of asphalt shingles on a continuous bed, nailed with the factory laps. Includes the base felt, laying and the ridge finishings.
cadenas.Cubierta de teja criolla con canal y cob: Barrel tile roof laid pan and cover.
cadenas.Cubierta de teja criolla de arcilla colo: Roof covering of clay barrel tiles laid pan and cover on battens, with the eaves and ridges bedded in mortar. Includes setting out, laying and the finishings.
cadenas.Cubierta de teja criolla de arcilla reci: Roof covering of clay barrel tiles bedded in mortar on a continuous bed, without battens, for medium pitches. Includes the bed, laying and the finishings.
cadenas.Cubierta de teja criolla sobre base cont: Barrel tile roof on a continuous base.
cadenas.Cubierta de teja de concreto perfilada s: Roof covering of profiled concrete tiles on battens, nailed or screwed, with eaves and ridge finishings. Includes setting out and laying.
cadenas.Cubierta de teja metálica acanalada imit: Roof covering of corrugated tile-effect metal sheet on purlins, screwed with side and end laps. Includes setting out and fixing.
cadenas.Cubierta fría con aislamiento y ventilac: Cold roof with insulation and ventilation.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de lona tensada sobre es: Lightweight tensioned fabric roof on a structure, for shading terraces and parking areas. Includes the support structure, tensioning and the anchors.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de lámina acrílica trans: Lightweight translucent acrylic sheet roof covering on framing, for rooflights and canopies. Includes the framing and laying.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de lámina de policarbona: Lightweight roof covering of solid polycarbonate sheet for canopies and awnings, with framing and fixing. Includes setting out and laying.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de lámina metálica delga: Lightweight thin metal sheet roof covering for sheds and service areas, on lumber purlins. Includes laying and fixing.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de panel de policarbonat: Lightweight polycarbonate panel roof with sealing joints.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de policarbonato alveola: Lightweight multiwall polycarbonate roof covering with weathertight joint profiles, for galleries exposed to rain. Includes laying and sealing the joints.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de policarbonato curvo p: Lightweight curved polycarbonate roof covering for skylights and corridor rooflights. Includes the support framing and laying.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de policarbonato multica: Lightweight multiwall polycarbonate roof covering of high thickness for roofs with a high thermal requirement. Includes the framing and laying.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera de teja translúcida de p: Lightweight translucent polycarbonate tile-effect roof covering, for natural light while keeping the appearance of tiling. Includes laying and fixing.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera translúcida de panel de: Lightweight translucent roof covering of corrugated glass fiber panels on purlins, for work or washing areas. Includes laying and fixing.
cadenas.Cubierta ligera translúcida de policarbo: Lightweight translucent roof covering of multiwall polycarbonate on framing, for natural light to galleries and terraces. Includes the support structure, laying and the finishings.
Lightweight translucent roof covering of multiwall polycarbonate on framing, with joint strips and screw fixing. Includes setting out and laying.
cadenas.Cubierta o lucernario con lámina de poli: Roof covering or rooflight of multiwall polycarbonate sheet on a structure, with joint profiles and the cells sealed. The cells must be sealed with micro-perforated tape at the bottom and airtight tape at the top, and run in the direction of the fall: if they are closed badly they fill with condensation and dust and the sheet turns opaque within months. Includes setting out, cutting, placing with the face protected against ultraviolet radiation to the outside, sealing the cells, fitting the joint profiles and the finishings. Measured by the area actually constructed.
Flat roof with a gravel finish.
cadenas.Cubierta plana con membrana líquida de p: Flat roof with a liquid polyurethane membrane.
cadenas.Cubierta plana de losa de concreto armad: Cast-in-place reinforced concrete flat roof slab, with formwork, reinforcement and curing. Includes formwork, reinforcement and pouring with vibration.
cadenas.Cubierta plana invertida con aislamiento: Inverted flat roof with rigid insulation laid over the waterproofing membrane and protected with gravel. Includes laying the insulation and the protective layer.
cadenas.Cubierta plana no transitable con acabad: Non-trafficable flat roof finished with a protective layer of washed gravel over the waterproofing membrane. Includes spreading the gravel in an even layer over the membrane.
cadenas.Cubierta plana no transitable con membra: Non-trafficable flat roof with a PVC membrane.
cadenas.Cubierta plana transitable acabada con b: Trafficable flat roof finished with non-slip ceramic tile on a bedding mortar, with sealed joints and falls to the drains. Includes the mortar bed, laying and grouting.
Trafficable flat roof with paving tiles.
cadenas.Cubrición de huecos de ascensor con tabl: Covering of elevator shaft openings with boards and a guardrail, to prevent falls during the works.
Ridge and ridge cap of a metal sheet roof.
Ridge and hip of a tile roof.
Ridge and trims of a tile roof.
cadenas.Curado de concreto estructural con membr: Curing of structural concrete with a curing membrane. Includes applying the curing compound. Measured per square meter cured.
cadenas.Dado o base de concreto para equipo o má: Concrete base or plinth for equipment or machinery.
cadenas.Decapado químico de capas de pintura exi: Chemical stripping of existing paint layers on a substrate or joinery, prior to a new finish. Includes applying the stripper, the removal of the softened paint and the cleaning of the surface. Measured per square meter stripped.
cadenas.Delimitación de zonas de riesgo con cint: Delimitation of risk areas with hazard tape and cones, to prevent access.
cadenas.Delimitación y acordonamiento de zonas d: Delimitation and barring off of risk areas within the site, using mesh, hazard tape, cones or barriers, with signage. Includes setting out the perimeter leaving a sufficient safety distance from the hazard, erecting the supports, running out the mesh or tape, placing the corresponding signage and maintaining and replacing it for as long as the hazard remains. Measured by the length actually delimited.
Delimitation and barring off of risk areas.
Marking out of a sports court.
cadenas.Demarcación de líneas, símbolos y zonas: Marking out of lines, symbols and areas on the floor with traffic paint, for parking, circulation and safety areas. Includes cleaning and degreasing the strip, setting out and masking the lines, applying the paint in two coats at the thickness that gives durability under traffic, removing the tape while the paint is wet to get a clean edge and barring off until dry. Measured by the length of line actually marked.
cadenas.Demarcación de zona de seguridad pintada: Painted marking of a safety zone.
cadenas.Demolición de acera de concreto. Incluye: Demolition of a concrete sidewalk. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de afirmado o base de mortero: Demolition of a leveling screed or mortar base up to 5 cm thick, once the floor finish has been removed, with a hand held electric breaker, leaving the structural slab exposed and clean. It is used where the existing base is friable, hollow or out of level and cannot receive the new floor. Includes checking the condition of the base beforehand by sounding, protecting the adjoining rooms, dust control by vacuum, removing the debris by hand in sacks and the final sweep of the slab. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually demolished.
Demolition of a leveling bed of mortar.
cadenas.Demolición de antepecho o peto de fachad: Demolition of a masonry apron or parapet to the facade. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de bancada o base de equipo d: Demolition of a concrete plinth or equipment base. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per unit demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de base de concreto ciclópeo,: Demolition of a cyclopean concrete base, by mechanical means. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
Demolition of a rubble concrete base.
Demolition of an external concrete base.
cadenas.Demolición de base o losa de concreto ex: Demolition of an external concrete base or slab. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de bordillo o brocal de acera: Demolition of a curb. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de brocal, cordón o bordillo: Demolition of a curb, whether precast or cast in place, together with its concrete bed, with a hand held electric breaker. Includes barring off and signing the work area because it sits in a traffic route, cutting the joints between units, demolishing the bed, removing the debris, stacking the precast units worth keeping where the client wishes to reuse them and clearing the area. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de cabezal de pilote de concr: Demolition of a reinforced concrete pile cap, by mechanical and manual means. Includes breaking out the concrete, cutting the steel and removing the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de cielo raso continuo de pla: Demolition of a continuous gypsum board ceiling, together with the galvanized steel framing, the hanger rods and the perimeter angle, by hand. Includes disconnecting and removing beforehand the light fixtures, grilles and diffusers set in the plane of the ceiling, protecting the floor and the furniture, taking the boards down in an orderly way to avoid uncontrolled falls, removing the debris in sacks and the framing tied in bundles, and clearing the area leaving the slab exposed. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de cielo raso de yeso laminad: Demolition of a gypsum board ceiling and its framing.
cadenas.Demolición de cielo raso de yeso vaciado: Demolition of a plaster or skim ceiling.

Demolition of a cast plaster, filler or traditional lath and plaster ceiling, together with its support structure and hangers, by hand and with an electric breaker where the thickness requires it. Being a solid material it produces more debris and more fine dust than a boarded ceiling. Includes disconnecting the light fixtures beforehand, protecting the floor and the furniture, dust control by vacuum, removing the debris in sacks and cleaning the resulting slab. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de columna de concreto armado: Demolition of a reinforced concrete column, with shoring and mechanical means. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per meter demolished.

Demolition of a reinforced concrete column, with an electric or pneumatic breaker depending on the section, with the longitudinal reinforcement cut beforehand. It requires the structure the column carries to be shored beforehand and the structural design to be validated, work that is priced separately. Includes protecting the surroundings, demolishing downwards in stages to keep control of the element, cutting out and removing the steel, breaking up the concrete, lowering the debris and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the volume actually demolished.
Demolition of a reinforced concrete column.
cadenas.Demolición de contrafuerte o machón de c: Demolition of a reinforced concrete buttress or pier. Includes cutting the steel, the demolition and removal. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de contrapiso o relleno de fu: Demolition of a subfloor or fill to the footing, by mechanical means. Includes the demolition and removal of the material. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
Demolition of a plaster or mortar cornice. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de cornisa o remate de fachad: Demolition of a facade cornice or trim.
cadenas.Demolición de cornisa, alero o remate de: Demolition of a cornice, eaves overhang or trim to the facade in concrete or mortar. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de cubierta de concreto armad: Demolition of a reinforced concrete roof. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de dintel prefabricado o carg: Demolition of a precast concrete lintel over a door or window opening, with an electric breaker after the masonry above has been shored. Includes assessing beforehand the load the lintel transmits and erecting the temporary shoring on props, an essential operation before any cut, demolition in stages, cutting the reinforcement, removing the debris and preparing the bearing to receive the new lintel. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de escalera de concreto armad: Demolition of a reinforced concrete stair, comprising the inclined slab, the steps and the landings, with a pneumatic breaker and the reinforcement cut, after structural validation and shoring. It is one of the most complex demolitions because of the working position, the difficulty of removing the debris and because it is usually the only route of communication between levels, which means an alternative access has to be arranged before starting. Includes the structural validation, the shoring, barring off both levels, demolition working down from the top landing, cutting the steel, lowering the debris and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually completed.
Demolition of a reinforced concrete stair, with shoring and mechanical means. Includes shoring beforehand, cutting the steel and removing the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
Demolition of a reinforced concrete stair.
cadenas.Demolición de escalera estructural de co: Demolition of a structural reinforced concrete stair.
cadenas.Demolición de escalera exterior de concr: Demolition of an external concrete stair. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de fundación de mampostería d: Demolition of a stone or brick masonry footing, by mechanical means. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de jardinera o elemento de ob: Demolition of a planter or other external masonry element.
Demolition of a planter or external masonry element. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de jardinera, banco, murete d: Demolition of a planter, bench, decorative dwarf wall or minor external masonry element, including its fill, its finish and its footing. Includes emptying the soil and the planting beforehand in the case of planters, setting aside any plants the client wishes to keep, chipping off the finishes, demolishing the masonry and the footing, removing the debris sorted to separate soil and green waste from inert debris, and backfilling and compacting the void. It does not include disposal. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Demolición de la cabeza del pilote hasta: Breaking down the head of the pile to the design level, removing the concrete contaminated by the overpour, and preparing the starter bars for connection to the pile cap or the capping beam. Includes marking the cut-off level, breaking down with an electric breaker without damaging the starter bars or cracking the concrete that remains, straightening and cleaning the starter bars, hacking the contact surface to give a bond to the element above and removing the debris. Measured per pile actually cut off.
cadenas.Demolición de la capa de pendientado y d: Demolition of the screed to falls and of the protection to a flat roof, comprising the lightweight fill forming the falls, the protective mortar screed and the surface finish, down to the structural slab. Carried out with a hand held electric breaker. Includes protecting and temporarily capping the drains, checking that the slab is not pierced, controlling the stockpile of debris on the roof so as not to overload it, lowering it by mechanical means and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de losa de concreto con nervi: Demolition of a ribbed or lightweightened concrete slab, by mechanical means. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a ribbed concrete slab.
cadenas.Demolición de losa de cubierta aligerada: Demolition of a lightweight roof slab.
Demolition of a lightweightened roof slab. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de losa de entrepiso de concr: Demolition of a reinforced concrete intermediate floor slab, solid or ribbed, with a pneumatic breaker and the reinforcement cut, with the bays that remain shored beforehand. Includes the structural validation, erecting the shoring, barring off and protecting the level below to prevent access during the work, demolition in controlled strips from the bearings towards the center, cutting out and separating the steel, lowering the debris and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de losa de entrepiso maciza o: Demolition of a solid or ribbed intermediate floor slab.
cadenas.Demolición de losa de fundación de concr: Demolition of a reinforced concrete mat foundation, with a hydraulic breaker mounted on an excavator and the reinforcing mesh cut. Includes the perimeter cut beforehand to define the area of work, checking that no buried services run beneath the slab, breaking the concrete into loadable pieces, cutting out and separating the steel for separate management, stockpiling the debris and clearing the resulting ground. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the volume actually demolished.
Demolition of a reinforced concrete foundation slab.
cadenas.Demolición de losa de piso de sótano o d: Demolition of a basement or foundation floor slab, by mechanical means. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a basement floor slab.
cadenas.Demolición de losa de techo de concreto: Demolition of a reinforced concrete roof slab, with shoring. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a concrete roof slab.
cadenas.Demolición de losa nervada de entrepiso: Demolition of a ribbed intermediate floor or roof slab, with shoring and mechanical means. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de mezzanina o entrepiso de c: Demolition of a concrete mezzanine or intermediate floor, with shoring. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de bloque de concreto: Demolition of a concrete block wall, with its finishes. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a concrete block wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de carga de concreto: Demolition of a reinforced concrete loadbearing wall, with shoring. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
Demolition of a load-bearing concrete wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de cerca perimetral d: Demolition of a perimeter boundary wall of block, brick or concrete, including its finishes and the bracing columns, with an electric or pneumatic breaker according to the thickness. Includes barring off and signing the area on both sides of the wall, checking that there are no services attached and no neighboring rights of way, demolishing downwards course by course to avoid uncontrolled overturning, cutting the reinforcement to the columns, stockpiling the debris and clearing the ground. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
Demolition of a perimeter boundary wall.
Demolition of a perimeter boundary wall. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de cerramiento de fac: Demolition of a facade enclosure wall of concrete block or brick, including its finishes to both faces, with a hand held electric breaker from scaffold. Includes checking beforehand that the wall has no loadbearing function, barring off and signing the drop zone at the foot of the facade, protecting the joinery that remains, demolishing downwards course by course to avoid overturning, controlling the fall of debris, removing it in sacks and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de concreto no estruc: Demolition of a non-structural concrete wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de fachada de bloque: Demolition of a blockwork or brick facade wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de fachada de concret: Demolition of a concrete facade wall, with shoring and mechanical means. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a concrete facade wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de fachada de mampost: Demolition of a stone or brick masonry facade wall. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a masonry facade wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de piedra de fundació: Demolition of a stone foundation wall, by mechanical means. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
Demolition of a stone foundation wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de sótano de concreto: Demolition of a reinforced concrete basement wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro de sótano o contenció: Demolition of a reinforced concrete basement or retaining wall, by mechanical means with the steel cut. Includes shoring beforehand, demolition in bays and removal of the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de muro estructural de concre: Demolition of a reinforced concrete structural wall, with shoring and mechanical means. Includes the shoring, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
Demolition of a structural concrete wall.
cadenas.Demolición de muro interior de concreto: Demolition of a non-loadbearing internal concrete wall, including its finishes, with a pneumatic breaker and the reinforcing mesh cut where present. Includes the prior structural check establishing that the wall is neither loadbearing nor provides bracing, an essential requirement before any intervention, the perimeter cut with a diamond blade, protecting the surroundings, dust control, breaking up the debris and removing it in sacks. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de pared de bloques con armad: Demolition of a block wall with internal steel reinforcement. Includes the demolition, cutting the steel and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a reinforced blockwork wall.
cadenas.Demolición de pared de ladrillo a la vis: Demolition of a face brick wall, taking care not to damage the surroundings. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a face brick wall.
cadenas.Demolición de pared de mampostería estru: Demolition of a reinforced structural masonry wall. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a structural masonry wall.
cadenas.Demolición de pavimento asfáltico de est: Demolition of asphalt paving in a parking lot.
cadenas.Demolición de pavimento asfáltico de has: Demolition of asphalt paving up to 10 cm thick, with a hydraulic breaker mounted on an excavator, with a perimeter cut beforehand to give a straight edge that makes reinstatement easier. Includes checking for buried services, barring off and signing the area, the perimeter cut with a blade, breaking out the asphalt, stockpiling the planings separately because they can be specifically recycled, and cleaning and sweeping the resulting base. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de pavimento asfáltico. Inclu: Demolition of asphalt paving. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de pavimento de concreto exte: Demolition of an exterior concrete paving.
Demolition of external concrete paving. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de pavimento exterior de conc: Demolition of external concrete paving, to a sidewalk, yard or access road, up to 15 cm thick, with a hydraulic breaker mounted on an excavator. Includes checking beforehand that no buried services run beneath the paving, the perimeter cut with a diamond blade to define the area of work, barring off the work area, breaking the concrete into loadable pieces, cutting out and separating the reinforcing mesh where present, stockpiling the debris and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
Demolition of an exterior concrete paving.
cadenas.Demolición de pedestal de concreto armad: Demolition of a reinforced concrete pedestal, by mechanical means. Includes cutting the steel, the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
Demolition of a reinforced concrete pedestal.
Demolition of the screed to falls of a roof.
cadenas.Demolición de pendientado y capa de prot: Demolition of the screed to falls and protective layer to a flat roof. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de pendientado y protección d: Demolition of the screed to falls and protection of a flat roof.
cadenas.Demolición de piso cerámico y su capa de: Demolition of ceramic tile flooring and its adhesive bed.
cadenas.Demolición de piso continuo de cemento p: Demolition of a continuous polished cement floor and its mortar base, with a hand held electric breaker, without affecting the structural slab. Includes the perimeter cut with an angle grinder where the demolition is partial, protecting the adjoining rooms, dust control by vacuum, breaking up the debris, removing it by hand in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the resulting surface. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de piso continuo de concreto: Demolition of a continuous concrete floor up to 10 cm thick, with a pneumatic breaker, without affecting the structural slab or the services running beneath it. Includes checking beforehand that there are no buried pipes or conduits in the area, the perimeter cut with an angle grinder and diamond blade to define the demolition, protecting the adjoining rooms, dust control, breaking the debris into manageable pieces, removing it in sacks to the stockpile and clearing away. Where the floor is reinforced with welded wire mesh, cutting it out and removing it is included. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually demolished.
Demolition of a continuous concrete floor.
cadenas.Demolición de piso continuo de granito v: Demolition of a continuous cast-in-place terrazzo floor, including its mortar base and the divider strips at the joints, with a pneumatic breaker because it is a monolithic surface of great hardness. Includes the perimeter cut beforehand with an angle grinder and diamond blade to define the area of work and prevent material coming away outside it, protecting the adjoining rooms, dust control, breaking the debris into manageable pieces, removing it in sacks and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually demolished.
Demolition of a polished cement floor.
cadenas.Demolición de piso de granito o terrazo: Demolition of terrazzo or granite tile flooring.
cadenas.Demolición de piso existente de baldosa: Demolition of an existing ceramic or porcelain tile floor, together with its bedding mortar, with a hand held electric breaker without compromising the slab or the adjoining construction. Includes protecting the walls, doors and adjoining rooms beforehand, dust control by vacuum, removing the debris by hand in sacks to the stockpile and sweeping the resulting surface, leaving it ready to receive the new screed. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.

Demolition of an existing floor of precast granite or terrazzo tile, together with its bedding mortar, with a hand held electric breaker. Because of the hardness and the thickness of this type of tile the output is lower than for a ceramic floor and the debris is heavier, which shows in the output of the item. Includes protecting the adjoining rooms beforehand, dust control, removing the debris by hand in sacks and cleaning the surface. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de piso existente de piedra n: Demolition of an existing natural stone floor, whether marble, natural granite or flagstone, together with its bedding mortar, with a hand held electric breaker. Where the client wishes to recover the units, they are lifted one by one with care, cleaned of mortar and stored protected, which reduces output and should be noted in the price. Includes protecting the adjoining rooms, dust control, removing the debris by hand in sacks and cleaning the surface. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de platea de fundación de con: Demolition of a reinforced concrete raft foundation, by mechanical means. Includes cutting the steel, demolition in strips and removal of the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de rampa de concreto exterior: Demolition of an external concrete ramp. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de revestimiento de granito o: Demolition of terrazzo or natural stone stair cladding.
cadenas.Demolición de rodapié corrido de mortero: Demolition of a continuous cement mortar baseboard, by hand with a chisel, taking care not to damage the stucco above the line of the baseboard. Includes hacking off the material remaining bonded to the wall, removing the debris by hand in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the area. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the length actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de rodapié de granito o terra: Demolition of a terrazzo or granite base.
Demolition of a natural stone base.
cadenas.Demolición de rodapié existente de baldo: Demolition of an existing ceramic or porcelain tile baseboard and its bedding, by hand with an electric breaker, taking care not to damage the stucco above the line of the baseboard. Includes removing the debris by hand in sacks to the stockpile, hacking off the mortar remaining bonded and cleaning the area. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the length actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de rodapié existente de grani: Demolition of an existing precast granite or terrazzo baseboard and its bedding, with a hand held electric breaker, taking care not to damage the stucco to the wall. Includes hacking off the mortar remaining bonded, removing the debris by hand in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the area. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the length actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de rodapié existente de piedr: Demolition of an existing natural stone baseboard and its bedding, with a hand held electric breaker, taking care not to damage the stucco to the wall. Includes hacking off the mortar remaining bonded, removing the debris by hand in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the area. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the length actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de sobrecimiento o arranque d: Demolition of a concrete plinth course or wall base, by mechanical means. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de bloque de arcil: Demolition of a clay block partition, with its finishes. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a clay block partition.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de bloque de vidri: Demolition of an existing glass block partition.
Demolition of a glass block partition, removing the blocks. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a glass block partition.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de bloque o ladril: Demolition of a block or brick wall built against an existing wall as a lining, including its finishes and the intermediate cavity, with a hand held electric breaker without damaging the original wall that remains. Includes checking beforehand that the lining has no structural function and houses no live services, protecting the surroundings, dust control, breaking the debris into manageable pieces, removing it in sacks to the stockpile and hacking off the mortar remaining bonded to the wall. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
Demolition of a blockwork or brick partition, including its finishes.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de doble placa de: Demolition of a partition with two layers of gypsum board and insulation. Includes demolishing the boards, the wool and the framing. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a double gypsum board partition.
Demolition of a fiber or panel partition.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de ladrillo macizo: Demolition of a solid brick partition, with its finishes. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a solid brick partition.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de madera o machih: Demolition of a wood or tongue and groove partition, by dismantling. Includes dismantling and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de panel de fibra: Demolition of a fiber or composite panel partition. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de panel liviano p: Demolition of a lightweight precast panel partition. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a lightweight panel partition.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de placa de cement: Demolition of a cement board partition on a metal frame. Includes demolishing the board and dismantling the frame. Measured per square meter demolished.
Demolition of a cement board partition.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique de yeso laminado y: Demolition of a gypsum board partition and its framing.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique interior de placa: Demolition of an internal gypsum board partition, together with the galvanized steel framing and the insulation in the cavity, by hand. Includes locating and disconnecting beforehand the services that run within the partition, a critical operation in this system because the pipework and cabling are concealed and unmarked, protecting the floor, taking the boards down in order, removing the insulation, dismantling the framing and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Demolición de tabique interior no estruc: Demolition of a non-loadbearing internal partition of concrete block or brick, with its finishes to both faces, with a hand held electric breaker without affecting the stability of the adjoining construction. Includes checking beforehand that the partition is not loadbearing and that it houses no live services, protecting the surroundings, local shoring where necessary, breaking the debris into manageable pieces, removing it in sacks to the stockpile and clearing the area. It does not include cartage to a disposal site. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de tabique o paño de bloque d: Demolition of a glass block partition or panel, including the mortar joints and the reinforcement between courses, by hand with an electric breaker. It requires specific precautions against the projection of sharp fragments: the face of the blocks is taped beforehand so that they break in a contained way, and face protection and cut resistant gloves are used. Includes protecting the surroundings, demolishing downwards course by course, carefully removing the material in reinforced sacks and thoroughly cleaning up the splinters. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de tanquilla o registro enter: Demolition of a buried manhole or inspection chamber.
Demolition of a buried inspection chamber or manhole. Includes the demolition and removal. Measured per unit demolished.
Demolition of a manhole or inspection chamber.
cadenas.Demolición de tanquilla, registro o caja: Demolition of a buried inspection chamber, manhole or draw pit of concrete or masonry, including its cover, its walls and its base slab, with an electric breaker after excavation to expose it. Includes checking beforehand that the chamber is out of service, emptying and cleaning the inside, capping the pipes that connect to it and remain active, demolishing the walls and the base slab, removing the debris and backfilling and compacting the resulting void. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured per unit demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de trasdosado autoportante de: Demolition of a self-supporting gypsum board wall lining, together with the galvanized steel framing and the insulation held in the cavity, by hand. Includes locating and disconnecting beforehand the accessories and services running in the lining, protecting the floor and the furniture, taking the boards down in order, removing the insulation in sacks, dismantling the framing and its fixings to the wall, and clearing the area leaving the original face exposed. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de trasdosado de bloque o lad: Demolition of a blockwork or brick lining against a wall.
cadenas.Demolición de trasdosado de yeso laminad: Demolition of a gypsum board wall lining and its framing.
cadenas.Demolición de vierteaguas o alféizar de: Demolition of a weather sill or window sill. Includes the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de viga de amarre o de borde,: Demolition of a tie beam or edge beam, with the steel cut and mechanical means. Includes cutting the steel, the demolition and removal. Measured per meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de viga de concreto armado, e: Demolition of a reinforced concrete beam, with an electric or pneumatic breaker, with the slab or the elements the beam carries shored beforehand. Includes the prior structural validation, erecting the temporary shoring, protecting the surroundings and the level below, demolition in controlled stages from scaffold, cutting out and removing the reinforcing bars, lowering the debris and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the volume actually demolished.
Demolition of a reinforced concrete beam.
cadenas.Demolición de viga de corona de fundació: Demolition of a foundation ring beam.
cadenas.Demolición de viga de corona o amarre de: Demolition of a ring beam or footing tie beam, with the steel cut. Includes cutting the steel, the demolition and removal of the debris. Measured per cubic meter demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de viga de riostra o muro de: Demolition of a concrete tie beam or retaining wall.
cadenas.Demolición de viga de riostra, muro de c: Demolition of a tie beam, retaining wall or reinforced concrete dwarf wall, with a pneumatic breaker and the reinforcement cut. Includes checking beforehand that the element is not holding active earth pressure or, where it is, temporarily supporting the ground, protecting the surroundings, cutting out and removing the reinforcing steel, breaking up the concrete and stockpiling it, and clearing the area. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the volume actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de zapata aislada o pedestal: Demolition of an isolated footing or reinforced concrete pedestal, with a pneumatic breaker and the reinforcement cut by oxy-fuel cutting or angle grinder. It requires a structural check beforehand that the element no longer serves a loadbearing function or that the structure is properly shored. Includes excavation to expose the element where it is buried, protecting the surroundings, cutting out and removing the steel bars, breaking the concrete into manageable pieces and stockpiling it, and backfilling the resulting void where the design requires it. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the volume actually demolished.
cadenas.Demolición de zapata o pedestal de concr: Demolition of a reinforced concrete footing or pedestal.
cadenas.Demolición de zócalo escalonado de escal: Demolition of a stepped base to a stair.
cadenas.Demolición del revestimiento cerámico de: Demolition of the ceramic finish to a stair, comprising the treads, the risers and its bedding mortar, with a hand held electric breaker without compromising the stair slab. Output is appreciably lower than on a level floor because of the awkward working position, the surface broken up into steps and the difficulty of getting the debris down the stair itself. Includes protecting the stairwell and the handrail, dust control, removing the debris by hand in sacks and clearing up, leaving the steps ready for the new finish. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished, taking the treads and risers as developed.
cadenas.Demolición del revestimiento de granito,: Demolition of the granite, terrazzo or natural stone finish to a stair, comprising the treads, the risers and its bedding, with a hand held electric breaker. The greater thickness and weight of the units is added to the difficulty inherent in working on a stair, so output is the lowest of any of the finish demolition groups. Includes protecting the stairwell and the handrail, dust control, removing the debris by hand in sacks and hacking off the mortar remaining bonded to the steps. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually demolished, taking the treads and risers as developed.
cadenas.Demolición del zócalo o rodapié escalona: Demolition of the stepped skirting that follows the stair where it meets the wall, including its bedding, by hand and with an electric breaker, taking care not to damage the stucco above the line of the skirting. Includes hacking off the mortar remaining bonded, removing the debris in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the area. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the actual length of the inclined line of the skirting.
cadenas.Desbroce con retiro de capa vegetal y ra: Clearing and grubbing, including removal of topsoil and surface roots. Includes clearing and stockpiling. Measured per square meter cleared.
Clearing and grubbing, including removal of topsoil.
cadenas.Desbroce de vegetación arbustiva y malez: Clearing and grubbing of scrub vegetation and undergrowth from the site. Includes cutting back the shrubs and clearing. Measured per square meter cleared.
Clearing and grubbing of scrub vegetation.
cadenas.Descabezado de pilote de concreto. Inclu: Cutting off the head of a concrete pile. Includes cutting the steel and breaking down the head. Measured per unit cut off.
Stripping of the site, including survey.
cadenas.Descapote del terreno mediante retiro de: Stripping of the site by removing the surface layer of topsoil, some 20 cm average thickness, down to firm ground suitable to receive foundations or fill. Topsoil is compressible and will not carry load, so removing it is a precondition of any foundation. Includes setting out the area, excavating the layer by mechanical or manual means depending on access, heaping it separately from the rest of the material in case the client wants to reuse it for landscaping, and trimming the resulting surface. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the area actually stripped.
cadenas.Descapote y retiro de capa vegetal con c: Stripping and removal of topsoil with survey control. Includes stripping and leveling. Measured per square meter stripped.
cadenas.Desconexión de equipo de aire acondicion: Disconnection of air conditioning equipment, with recovery of the refrigerant. Includes refrigerant recovery and electrical disconnection. Measured per unit disconnected.
cadenas.Desconexión de instalación eléctrica exi: Disconnection of the existing electrical installation.
cadenas.Desconexión de la instalación de agua ex: Disconnection of the existing water installation before work starts, by shutting off the stop valves. Includes shutting off and checking that the system is watertight. Measured per installation disconnected.
cadenas.Desconexión de la instalación de gas exi: Disconnection of the existing gas installation before work starts, by shutting off the gas valve. Includes shutting off and checking for leaks. Measured per installation disconnected.
cadenas.Desconexión de la instalación eléctrica: Disconnection of the existing electrical installation before work starts, by cutting the supply and making it safe. Includes verifying that the circuit is dead and locking it out. Measured per installation disconnected.
cadenas.Desinfección de zonas húmedas (baños, co: Disinfection of wet areas (bathrooms, kitchen) on completion of the works, with disinfectant products.
cadenas.Desmontaje de alféizar o repisa de venta: Removal of a window sill or ledge.
Removal of a metal sill rail.
cadenas.Desmontaje de antepecho o brocal de meta: Removal of a metal sub sill to a window. Includes removing the element. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de aparato sanitario existent: Removal of an existing plumbing fixture, whether a toilet, lavatory, bidet or sink, together with its faucet and connection fittings. Includes closing the stop valve beforehand and emptying the fixture, disconnecting the water supplies and the waste, temporarily capping the outlets to prevent odours and debris getting in, removing the fixture to the stockpile and cleaning the area. Where the client wishes to keep the fixture, it is removed carefully and stored protected. It does not include cartage to a disposal site. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de aparato sanitario y su gri: Removal of a plumbing fixture and its faucet.
cadenas.Desmontaje de bajante de aguas lluvias c: Removal of a rainwater downpipe with its brackets.
cadenas.Desmontaje de bajante de aguas lluvias,: Removal of a rainwater downpipe, surface or concealed, including the brackets, the bends and the connection fittings, by hand from scaffold. Includes barring off the area below, cutting the downpipe into manageable lengths, removing the brackets anchored to the facade, making good the anchor holes, temporarily capping the connection to the system that remains and removing the material. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually removed.
Removal of a rainwater downpipe. Includes removing the downpipe and its brackets. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de bajante o canalón de facha: Removal of a downpipe or gutter from the facade, taking down the element. Includes removing the downpipe or gutter and its brackets. Measured per meter removed.
Removal of a facade downpipe or gutter.
cadenas.Desmontaje de bandeja portacables eléctr: Removal of an electrical cable tray. Includes removing the tray and its supports. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de baranda metálica de balcón: Removal of a metal guardrail from a balcony or stair. Includes cutting the fixings and taking it down. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de baranda o antepecho metáli: Removal of a metal guardrail or rail to a balcony, terrace or external stair, by oxy-fuel cutting or unbolting according to the anchorage, with the element supported beforehand. Includes installing temporary edge protection before the permanent guardrail is removed, an unavoidable safety requirement where an accessible void is left, cutting the anchors flush with the substrate, making good the anchor holes, lowering the material and stockpiling it sorted as scrap. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de baranda o pasamanos de bal: Removal of a balcony guardrail or handrail.
cadenas.Desmontaje de barra de cocina o mostrado: Removal of a kitchen bar or counter. Includes removing the bar and its supports. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de caballete o cumbrera de te: Removal of a ridge cap or ridge from the roof. Includes removing the element. Measured per meter removed.
Removal of a roller shutter box.
cadenas.Desmontaje de caja o cajón de persiana,: Removal of a roller shutter box, taking out the mechanism. Includes removing the box and the mechanism. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de calentador de agua de paso: Removal of an instantaneous water heater, with disconnection. Includes disconnection and removal. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de calentador de agua eléctri: Removal of an electric or gas water heater, including its anchorage brackets and the inlet and outlet connections. Includes cutting the electrical or gas supply beforehand and checking it with a detector, draining the tank completely before releasing it from its brackets because of the weight it holds, disconnecting the pipework and capping it, removing the anchorage to the wall, making good the holes and lowering the unit to the stockpile. Where the client wishes to keep the unit, it is removed carefully and stored protected. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a tankless water heater.
cadenas.Desmontaje de campana de cocina empotrad: Removal of a built-in kitchen range hood, with disconnection. Includes disconnection and removal. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de campana extractora de coci: Removal of a kitchen range hood, with disconnection. Includes disconnection and removal. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of an external drainage channel.
Removal of an external drainage channel. Includes removing the channel and its grate. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de canal o canalón de recogid: Removal of a rainwater gutter, including the brackets, the unions and the special fittings, by hand from scaffold. Includes barring off the area below, taking it down in lengths with each one supported first, removing the hooks and anchors to the eaves, making good the fixing points, lowering the material and sorting it for recycling. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de canaleta o rejilla de dren: Removal of a drainage channel or grate. Includes removing the element. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de canalización eléctrica vis: Removal of surface electrical conduit or trunking. Includes removing the conduit. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de canalón de cubierta, con r: Removal of a gutter from the roof, taking down the brackets. Includes removing the gutter. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of a gutter from the roof, taking down the element and its brackets. Includes removing the gutter. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de celosía o cercha metálica,: Removal of a metal lattice or truss, with the connections cut and lowering under control. Includes removal and lowering by crane. Measured per meter removed.
Dismantling of a steel lattice or truss.
cadenas.Desmontaje de celosía o romanilla de fac: Removal of a facade louver screen, taking down the element. Includes removing the screen and its fixings. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de celosía o romanilla de ven: Removal of a ventilation louver screen. Includes taking down the screen and its fixings. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a lattice or metal grille.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cerca de malla ciclónica o: Removal of a chain link or welded mesh fence, including the support tubes or posts, the straining wires, the barbed wire topping and the concrete footings to the posts. Carried out by hand with an angle grinder and an electric breaker. Includes releasing the tension in the mesh beforehand, cutting it and rolling it into manageable lengths, extracting the posts with the demolition of their concrete footings, backfilling the resulting holes, sorting the recoverable material and removing it. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually removed.
Removal of a chain link or metal fence. Includes removing the mesh and the posts. Measured per meter removed.
Removal of a wire mesh fence.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cerramiento de fachada for: Removal of a facade enclosure of metal sheeting, sandwich panels or similar material, together with the support framing, by hand with a screwdriver from scaffold. Includes barring off the area at the foot of the facade, removing the sheets in order and preventing the wind taking control of them, taking down the framing and the fixings, sorting the recoverable material, lowering to stockpile level and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cerramiento ligero de lámi: Removal of lightweight metal sheet cladding.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cielo raso de láminas de P: Removal of a PVC or aluminum sheet ceiling.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cielo raso de machihembrad: Removal of a tongued and grooved lumber ceiling.

Removal of a tongue and groove or wood strip ceiling, together with the battens and the support structure fixed to the slab, by hand with a crowbar and a bar. Includes disconnecting the light fixtures beforehand, protecting the floor and the furniture, drawing out the nails and screws left in the structure, removing the material in bundles to the stockpile, sorting the pieces worth keeping and clearing the area. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cielo raso desmontable de: Removal of a mineral fiber suspended ceiling.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cielo raso formado por lám: Removal of a ceiling of PVC, aluminum or similar sheets, together with its support profiles and perimeter trims, by hand. Includes disconnecting the light fixtures and grilles beforehand, protecting the floor, unclipping the sheets in order so that they can be recovered if the client wishes, dismantling the framing, removing the material to the stockpile and clearing the area. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cielo raso registrable exi: Removal of an existing suspended ceiling of panels laid on an exposed grid, by hand. Being a demountable system the operation is clean and quick and much of the material can be recovered. Includes lifting the panels out in order, dismantling the grid and the hanger wires, sorting the pieces into reusable and waste, storing protected those the client wishes to keep and clearing the area. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de claraboya o domo de cubier: Removal of a rooflight or dome from the roof. Includes removing the dome and its fixings. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a skylight or dome.
cadenas.Desmontaje de closet empotrado, con desm: Removal of a built-in closet, taking down the panels and doors. Includes removing the closet. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a closet or built-in unit.
cadenas.Desmontaje de closet, alacena o mueble e: Removal of a closet, pantry or fitted cabinet, including the doors, the shelves, the internal carcass and the battens fixing it to the wall, by hand with a screwdriver. Includes emptying the contents beforehand where the client has not removed them, dismantling in order from the doors back to the carcass, extracting plugs and screws from the wall, making good the anchor holes, sorting the pieces worth keeping and removing the material. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area of cabinet front actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cocina o estufa empotrada,: Removal of a built-in range or cooker, with disconnection. Includes disconnection and removal. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de correa o viga metálica de: Removal of a steel purlin or beam from the structure, with the connections cut. Includes removal by cutting and lowering under control. Measured per meter removed.
Removal of a steel purlin or beam.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cortinero o riel de cortin: Removal of a curtain track or pole. Includes removing the track and its brackets. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cubierta de lámina de zinc: Removal of a zinc or fiber cement sheet roof covering. Includes removing the sheets. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of a corrugated galvanized sheet roof.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cubierta de lámina metálic: Removal of a metal or fiber cement sheet roof.

Stripping a roof covering of metal sheet, fiber cement sheet, zinc or fiber cement, including the hooks, screws and fixings to the structure, by hand from scaffold and on a lifeline.
