Where the sheet is old fiber cement, the possible presence of asbestos must be checked, in which case the removal falls outside this item and requires a licensed contractor. Includes stripping in order with the sheets held secure against the wind, lowering under control, sorting the material and stockpiling it. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually stripped.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cubierta de panel sándwich: Removal of a sandwich panel roof.
Removal of a sandwich panel roof covering. Includes removing the panels and their fixings. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cubierta de policarbonato: Removal of a polycarbonate or acrylic roof covering. Includes removing the sheets and their fixings. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cubierta de teja criolla,: Stripping a roof covering of barrel tiles, plain tiles or similar, including the fixing mortar and the ridge caps, by hand from scaffold and on a lifeline. Includes checking the condition of the supporting structure beforehand before anyone walks on it, stripping in order from the ridge down to the eaves, lowering the tiles by mechanical means rather than throwing them down, sorting the units worth keeping and stockpiling the material. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually stripped.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cumbrera o remate de cubie: Removal of a ridge cap or roof trim. Includes removing the trim and its fixings. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de cumbrera o remate de techo: Removal of a ridge or roof trim.
cadenas.Desmontaje de enchapado de madera o mach: Removal of lumber or tongued and grooved wall cladding.
cadenas.Desmontaje de encofrado perdido en funda: Removal of permanent formwork in a foundation.
cadenas.Desmontaje de equipo de aire acondiciona: Removal of a split air conditioning unit, comprising the indoor evaporator unit, the outdoor condensing unit, the refrigerant pipework and the drain. Includes recovering the refrigerant gas beforehand with specific equipment, an operation required by environmental regulations since it must not be released to the atmosphere, isolating and proving the electrical supply dead, removing both units and their brackets, taking out the pipework and the drain, making good the penetrations and lowering the equipment. Where the client wishes to keep the unit, it is removed carefully and stored protected. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a split air conditioning unit.
cadenas.Desmontaje de espejo empotrado o fijado: Removal of a recessed or wall fixed mirror. Includes removing the mirror. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de estante o repisa fija. Inc: Removal of a shelf or fixed shelf unit. Includes removing the shelf and its supports. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de estructura de madera de en: Dismantling of a wood floor or roof structure of beams, joists and boarding, by hand with a saw, with shoring beforehand. Includes inspecting the condition of the wood beforehand to anticipate breakage through rot or wood-boring insect attack, the temporary shoring, dismantling in order from the boarding back to the main beams, drawing the nails and hardware, sorting the pieces worth keeping where the client wishes to keep them, lowering the material and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually dismantled.
cadenas.Desmontaje de estructura metálica de ace: Dismantling of a structural steelwork frame of rolled or built-up sections, by oxy-fuel cutting and unbolting according to the type of connection, with the elements that remain shored beforehand. Includes studying the sequence of dismantling to keep the assembly stable at all times, slinging and supporting the members before releasing them, cutting into transportable lengths, lowering to stockpile level and sorting the steel for sale or management as scrap, whose recovery value can be credited to the client. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the weight actually dismantled.
cadenas.Desmontaje de extractor de baño, con des: Removal of a bathroom extractor fan, with disconnection. Includes disconnection and removal. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a bathroom extractor fan.
cadenas.Desmontaje de fregadero de cocina con su: Removal of a kitchen sink with its faucet and connection fittings. Includes closing the stop valves beforehand, disconnecting the hot and cold supplies, taking off the trap and the waste and catching the water held in them, cutting the perimeter seal to the countertop, lifting out the unit and temporarily capping the outlets to prevent odours and debris getting in. Where the client wishes to keep the unit, it is removed carefully and stored protected. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a kitchen sink and its faucet.
Removal of a bathroom or kitchen faucet. Includes removing the faucet. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de impermeabilización de cubi: Removal of the waterproofing from a roof deck.
Removal of roof waterproofing. Includes removing the membrane. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de instalación eléctrica exis: Removal of an existing electrical installation, comprising the conduit, the cable, the boxes and the accessories, surface or concealed. Includes isolating at the panel beforehand and proving dead with a tester before touching any point, an unavoidable safety requirement, cutting out the concealed runs, drawing out the cabling and the conduit, removing the boxes and accessories, sorting the copper for recovery and making good the chases. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length of conduit actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de interruptor diferencial o: Removal of a ground-fault circuit interrupter or protective devices from the panel. Includes removing the device. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a ground-fault circuit interrupter.
cadenas.Desmontaje de la estructura de soporte d: Removal of the roof support structure, of purlins, trusses or wood or metal sections, once the roof covering has been stripped. Carried out with a saw, by oxy-fuel cutting or by unbolting according to the material, with shoring beforehand and the members slung before they are released. Includes studying the sequence of removal to keep the assembly stable, supporting each member before cutting, lowering by mechanical means, sorting the recoverable material and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area of roof whose structure is removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de lavadora o secadora empotr: Removal of a built-in washing machine or dryer, with disconnection. Includes disconnection and removing the appliance. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a washing machine or dryer.
cadenas.Desmontaje de letrero, rótulo o publicid: Removal of a sign, nameplate or advertisement from the facade, taking out the fixings. Includes removing the element and its supports. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de losa colaborante metálica: Removal of metal deck flooring, with the fixings cut. Includes cutting the fixings and taking the sheets down. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of a composite metal deck.
cadenas.Desmontaje de luminaria de techo o pared: Removal of a ceiling or wall light fixture, recessed, surface mounted or suspended, including its supports and accessories. Includes isolating the circuit beforehand and proving it dead, disconnecting and temporarily insulating the conductors that remain, taking down the body of the fixture, removing the lamps for separate management where they are fluorescent or discharge lamps because of their mercury content, and making good the point where required. Where the client wishes to keep the unit, it is removed carefully and stored protected. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de lámpara o luminaria de tec: Removal of a ceiling light or fixture. Includes removing the fixture. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mampara de baño de vidrio: Removal of a tempered glass bath screen. Includes removing the glass and the profiles. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de marco de puerta de madera: Removal of a wood or metal door frame, without damaging the opening. Includes taking out the frame and cleaning the opening. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de marquesina de fachada, con: Removal of a canopy from the facade, cutting the fixings and lowering under control. Includes cutting the fixings and lowering. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mesón de cocina y su salpi: Removal of a kitchen countertop and its backsplash.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mesón o tope de cocina, se: Removal of a kitchen countertop, whether of granite, quartz, concrete or laminate, together with its backsplash and the supporting structure. Carried out by hand with an angle grinder and an electric breaker according to the material. Includes removing the sink and the cooktop beforehand where they remain, cutting the perimeter seal, holding the slab with two operatives given its weight, cutting it into manageable lengths where it cannot be taken out whole, hacking out the masonry supports, making good the wall and removing the material. Where the client wishes to keep the element, it is taken down carefully and stored protected. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length of countertop actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mobiliario de baño fijo, c: Removal of fixed bathroom furniture, taking out the accessories. Includes removing the furniture. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mobiliario fijo no clasifi: Removal of fixed furniture not classified in the items above, such as masonry shelves, benches, bars, counters or shelving anchored to the wall. Carried out by hand with a screwdriver, angle grinder and electric breaker according to the material and the type of anchorage. Includes emptying beforehand, supporting the element before the last anchor is released, extracting the fixings, hacking out the masonry supports where present, making good the holes and removing the sorted material. Where the client wishes to keep the element, it is taken down carefully and stored protected. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area of front actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de moldura decorativa corrida: Removal of a decorative molding run in plaster, polystyrene or polyurethane, at the junction of wall and ceiling or as a decorative feature on a wall, by hand with a scraper and chisel. Includes protecting the surroundings, cutting the joint line beforehand to avoid dragging the stucco off, scraping off the filler or adhesive residue, locally making good the damage caused, removing the material to the stockpile and clearing up. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de moldura decorativa de yeso: Removal of a decorative plaster or polystyrene molding.
Removal of a decorative molding in plaster or polystyrene. Includes removing the molding and cleaning up. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mosquitero de ventana o pu: Removal of an insect screen from a window or door. Includes taking down the frame and the mesh. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mueble de baño con su lava: Removal of a bathroom vanity unit with its integrated basin, mirror and accessories such as towel rails, soap dishes and toilet paper holders. Carried out by hand with a screwdriver. Includes closing the stop valves beforehand, disconnecting the water supplies and the waste and catching the water held in the trap, cutting the perimeter seal, taking down the unit and the mirror with each supported first, extracting the anchors, making good the holes and removing the material. Where the client wishes to keep the element, it is taken down carefully and stored protected. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured per set actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mueble de baño empotrado,: Removal of a built-in bathroom cabinet, taking out the accessories. Includes removing the unit. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a built-in bathroom unit.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mueble de baño y sus acces: Removal of a bathroom unit and its accessories.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mueble de cocina alto o ba: Removal of a wall or base kitchen cabinet, including the doors, the shelves, the drawers and the hardware fixing it to the wall. Carried out by hand with a screwdriver. Includes emptying the contents beforehand where the client has not removed them, disconnecting the services that pass through the unit, dismantling in order from the doors back to the carcass, extracting plugs and screws from the wall, making good the anchor holes and sorting the pieces worth keeping. Where the client wishes to keep the element, it is taken down carefully and stored protected. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length of cabinet front actually removed.
Removal of a wall or base kitchen cabinet.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mueble de cocina alto, con: Removal of a wall kitchen cabinet, taking out the fixings. Includes removing the unit. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a wall kitchen cabinet.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mueble de cocina con piedr: Removal of a kitchen cabinet with a stone top.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mueble de cocina con su me: Removal of a kitchen cabinet with its countertop and backsplash. Includes removing the unit and the countertop. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de mueble de lavadero, con de: Removal of a utility room unit, with disconnection. Includes disconnection and removal. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of a laundry room unit.
Removal of a glass curtain wall.
cadenas.Desmontaje de muro cortina o cerramiento: Removal of a curtain wall or glazed screen to the facade, taking out the glass and the framing. Includes removing the glass and dismantling the framing. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de panel sándwich de fachada,: Removal of sandwich panels from a facade, taking down the panels. Includes removing the panels and the fixings. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of a facade sandwich panel.
cadenas.Desmontaje de pasamanos de escalera, sea: Removal of a stair handrail, whether of wood, metal or masonry, together with its brackets and anchors to the wall or to the guardrail. Carried out by hand with a screwdriver and angle grinder according to the type of fixing. Includes supporting the element during removal, cutting or extracting the anchors, making good the holes left in the wall, sorting the recoverable material and removing it to the stockpile. Where the client wishes to keep the element, it is taken down carefully and stored protected, which reduces output and should be noted in the price. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de pasamanos metálico de esca: Removal of a metal stair handrail. Includes cutting the fixings and taking it down. Measured per meter removed.
Removal of a fixed coat rack or hook.
cadenas.Desmontaje de perchero o gancho fijo. In: Removal of a coat hook or fixed hook. Includes removing the accessory. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de persiana enrollable con su: Removal of a roller shutter with its box and mechanism. Includes taking down the shutter and the box. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de persiana enrollable de fac: Removal of a roller shutter from the facade, taking out the box and the mechanism. Includes removing the shutter and the box. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de piso técnico registrable e: Removal of an existing raised access floor of panels bearing on adjustable pedestals, by hand. Being a demountable system the operation is clean and the material can be recovered. Includes lifting the panels out in order with a suction lifter, dismantling the pedestals and the stringers, sorting the pieces into reusable and waste, storing protected those the client wishes to keep, removing the rest in sacks and cleaning the resulting slab. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually removed.
Removal of a raised access floor.
Removal of a toilet roll holder or towel rail.
cadenas.Desmontaje de portarrollo, toallero o ac: Removal of a toilet paper holder, towel rail or fixed bathroom accessory. Includes removing the accessory. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de portón corredizo con su ri: Removal of a sliding gate with its track and carriers. Includes taking down the gate and the track. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of an external access gate. Includes removing the gate and its hardware. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de publicidad o letrero de fa: Removal of an advertising sign from a facade.
cadenas.Desmontaje de puerta blindada con su mar: Removal of a security door with its frame. Includes taking out the door and the frame. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de puerta de paso interior, i: Removal of an internal passage door, including the leaf, the frame, the architraves and the hardware, by hand. Includes taking the leaf off its hinges first, drawing or cutting the fixings of the frame to the opening, removing the architraves taking care not to damage the stucco, hacking off the remains of fixing foam or mortar and removing the material to the stockpile. Where the client wishes to keep the element, it is taken down carefully and stored protected, which reduces output and should be noted in the price. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de puerta exterior o metálica: Removal of an exterior or metal door and frame.
cadenas.Desmontaje de puerta exterior, de seguri: Removal of an external, security or metal door, including the leaf, the frame and the hardware, by oxy-fuel cutting or angle grinder at the built-in anchors. Given its weight it needs two operatives to hold the leaf while the frame is released. Includes supporting the assembly beforehand, cutting the anchors, hacking out and making good the holes left in the wall, removing the material to the stockpile and sorting it as scrap. Where the client wishes to keep the element, it is taken down carefully and stored protected, which reduces output and should be noted in the price. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de puerta interior con su mar: Removal of an interior door and frame.
cadenas.Desmontaje de puerta interior corrediza: Removal of an internal sliding door with its track and hardware. Includes taking down the leaves, the track and the hardware. Measured per unit removed.
Removal of an interior sliding door.
cadenas.Desmontaje de puerta plegable con su rie: Removal of a folding door with its track and panels. Includes taking down the panels and the track. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de red de tuberías de agua o: Removal of a water or drainage pipework system.
cadenas.Desmontaje de red eléctrica y sus mecani: Removal of the electrical installation and its accessories.
cadenas.Desmontaje de red existente de tuberías: Removal of an existing water or waste pipework system, surface or concealed, including its fittings and supports. Includes closing down and checking beforehand that the system is out of service and drained, cutting out the wall where the runs are concealed, cutting and drawing out the pipework in manageable lengths, capping the branches that remain live, removing the material sorted as PVC, galvanized iron or copper, and making good the chases. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the length actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de reja de protección de vent: Removal of a protective grille from a window or door. Includes taking down the grille and its anchors. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de reja de protección en fach: Removal of a protective grille on a facade.
cadenas.Desmontaje de reja o protector metálico: Removal of a metal grille or guard to a window or door on the facade, by oxy-fuel cutting or angle grinder at the anchors built into the wall. Includes supporting the grille before the last anchor is released to prevent it falling, cutting the fixings, hacking out and making good the anchor holes left in the wall, lowering the element and stockpiling it sorted as scrap. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
Removal of an interior grille or protective guard.
cadenas.Desmontaje de reja, protector metálico o: Removal of a grille, metal guard or roller shutter inside the building, by oxy-fuel cutting or angle grinder at its anchors. Includes supporting the element before releasing the last fixing, cutting the anchors flush, hacking out and making good the holes left in the wall, removing the material to the stockpile and sorting it as scrap, whose recovery value can be credited to the client. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de rejilla de ventilación. In: Removal of a ventilation grille. Includes removing the grille. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de remate o tapajuntas metáli: Removal of a metal trim or cover strip. Includes removing the trim and its fixings. Measured per meter removed.
Removal of a trim or cover flashing.
cadenas.Desmontaje de repisa o estante de cocina: Removal of a kitchen shelf or shelf unit. Includes removing the shelf. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de revestimiento de fachada v: Removal of a rainscreen facade cladding, taking down the panels and the support frame. Includes removing the panels and dismantling the frame. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of a ventilated facade cladding.
cadenas.Desmontaje de revestimiento de láminas o: Removal of sheet or panel wall cladding.
cadenas.Desmontaje de revestimiento de madera ex: Removal of existing wood panelling to a wall, whether tongue and groove boarding, strips or panels, together with the battens fixed to the wall, by hand with a crowbar and a bar. Includes extracting the nails, screws and plugs left in the wall, removing the material in sacks or bundles to the stockpile, sorting the pieces worth keeping where the client wishes to keep them, and cleaning the resulting face. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de revestimiento de pared for: Removal of a wall covering of PVC, aluminum, melamine or similar sheets or panels, together with its support frame or battens, by hand. Includes removing the trim and the corner pieces, extracting the fixings left in the wall, locally making good the anchor holes, removing the material to the stockpile and cleaning the area. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
cadenas.Desmontaje de revestimiento de piedra en: Removal of stone cladding from a facade.

cadenas.Enchapado cerámico o de porcelanato en l: Ceramic or porcelain tiling in the shower area, laid over the previous waterproofing with a high performance adhesive and grouted with a mortar suitable for frequent immersion. The point of failure is not the tile but the junctions: the seal at the wall to wall and wall to floor corners must be flexible and not rigid mortar, because that is where movement opens the joint and lets the water in. Includes checking the waterproofing, setting out the courses starting from the most visible point, back buttering, the cuts around the taps and the soap dish, grouting and the flexible sealing of every corner. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².

Tiling of a shower niche or shelf.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento con gres porcelán: Tiling of a substrate with high strength technical porcelain stoneware, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter tiled.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento con mosaico vítre: Tiling of a substrate with glass mosaic on a mesh backing, in a thin bed. Includes preparing the substrate, fixing the mosaic and grouting. Measured per square meter tiled.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento con pieza cerámic: Tiling of a substrate with ceramic tile laid in a herringbone pattern, in a thin bed. Includes setting out the pattern, laying with cut pieces and grouting. Measured per square meter tiled.
Tiling of a substrate with ceramic or porcelain tile with a minimal joint, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter tiled.
Tiling of a substrate with ceramic tile and a decorative colored joint, in a thin bed. Includes laying and grouting with a colored grout. Measured per square meter tiled.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento con pieza de form: Tiling of a substrate with large format tile, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter tiled.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento con pieza de pied: Cladding of a substrate with natural stone with a tight joint and no visible joint. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and sealing the joint. Measured per square meter tiled.
Cladding of a substrate with natural stone laid with a wide mortar joint. Includes preparing the substrate, fixing and the wide grouting. Measured per square meter clad.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento con placas de már: Cladding of a substrate with polished marble slabs, in a thin bed. Includes preparing the substrate, fixing the slabs and grouting. Measured per square meter clad.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento interior con piez: Interior wall tiling with ceramic or porcelain tile, thin-set.
cadenas.Enchapado de paramento interior en baños: Tiling of an interior substrate in bathrooms, kitchens and wet areas with ceramic or rectified porcelain tile, over a substrate previously plastered and made level. Laid in a thin bed with an improved cementitious adhesive C2 TE with reduced slip applied with a notched trowel, leveled with spacers and wedges, and grouted with a CG2 mortar. Includes setting out the courses to avoid cut tiles in visible areas, cuts and holes for the passage of services and fittings, resolving the junctions and corners, and the final cleaning. The tile is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
Wall tiling with a minimal joint.

cadenas.Enchapado de piedra con junta ancha de m: Stone cladding with a wide mortar joint.
Stone cladding with a dry joint.
cadenas.Enchapado de piedra en fachada ventilada: Stone cladding on a ventilated facade.
cadenas.Enchapado de piedra natural con anclaje: Natural stone cladding with mechanical anchors.

cadenas.Enchapado de zona de ducha sobre imperme: Tiling of a shower area over the waterproofing.
cadenas.Enchapado del frente de bañera con pieza: Tiling of the bath front with ceramic or porcelain tile, leaving an access panel. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter tiled.
cadenas.Enchapado del salpicadero de cocina entr: Tiling of the kitchen backsplash between the countertop and the wall cabinets, with ceramic or porcelain tile. Includes the preparation, laying and grouting of the band. Measured per square meter tiled.
cadenas.Encofrado a dos caras de muro de concret: Double faced formwork to a concrete wall in lumber. Includes erection and stripping. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado a dos caras de muro de contenc: Double faced formwork to a retaining wall using wood panels with through ties, shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out, erecting and plumbing the first face, placing the ties and spacers that fix the thickness, closing the second face after the cage has been checked, bracing against the thrust of the wet concrete, which on a tall wall is considerable, applying release agent, stripping and making good the tie holes. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete, counting both faces.
Double-face formwork to a retaining wall.
Double faced formwork to a retaining wall. Includes erection and dismantling. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado a dos caras de pantalla estruc: Double-face formwork to a structural wall.
cadenas.Encofrado a dos caras de pantalla o muro: Double faced formwork to a structural wall using lumber panels with through ties, shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out, erecting and plumbing the first face, placing the ties and thickness spacers, closing the second face after the cage has been checked, bracing against the thrust of the wet concrete, applying release agent, stripping and making good the tie holes. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete, counting both faces.
Edge formwork to a concrete slab. Includes erecting the side formwork. Measured per meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado de columna mediante paneles de: Formwork to a column using lumber panels with clamps, shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out from the level, erecting the panels around the cage, plumbing in both directions and bracing, checking the section size and the cover, applying release agent, providing a clean-out opening at the base, stripping once the strength has been reached and cleaning and stacking the panels for reuse. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado de escalera de concreto armado: Formwork to a reinforced concrete stair, comprising the soffit of the inclined slab on shores, the closing sides and the riser boards that form the steps, and its subsequent stripping. It is one of the most laborious formwork items because of the inclined geometry and the setting out of the going and the rise, which must be exact and constant because any difference between steps is felt when walking and compromises safety. Includes setting out, erecting and leveling the soffit, the sides, the riser boards, the bracing, the release agent, stripping and cleaning the material. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
Formwork to a reinforced concrete stair.
cadenas.Encofrado de las caras laterales de viga: Formwork to the sides of a tie beam using wood panels with shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out and erecting the panels, checking the alignment, plumb and section before the pour, the bracing that stops it opening under the thrust of the concrete, applying release agent, stripping once the necessary strength has been reached and cleaning and stacking the panels for reuse. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado de las caras laterales de zapa: Formwork to the sides of a footing using wood panels with shores and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out and erecting the panels, checking the squareness, plumb and dimensions before the pour, the shoring and bracing that stops the formwork opening under the thrust of the wet concrete, applying release agent, careful stripping once the necessary strength has been reached, and cleaning and stacking the panels for reuse. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado de losa con sistema modular de: Formwork to a slab with a modular system of shores and steel decking. Includes erecting the system. Measured per square meter formed.
Formwork to a slab with a modular system.
cadenas.Encofrado de losa maciza mediante tabler: Formwork to a solid slab using lumber decking on sole plates and steel shores, leveled and with camber, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out the soffit level, erecting the grid of shores at the spacing indicated, placing the sole plates and the decking, leveling the assembly with the camber specified, sealing the joints of the decking to prevent loss of grout, applying release agent, staged stripping keeping the safety shores in place until the specified strength is reached, and cleaning and stacking the material. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado de losa maciza sobre puntales: Formwork to a solid slab on shores in lumber. Includes erecting the shores and the decking. Measured per square meter formed.
Formwork to a solid slab on shores.
cadenas.Encofrado de muro de contención a dos ca: Double-face formwork to a retaining wall.
cadenas.Encofrado de viga mediante fondo y later: Formwork to a beam with a lumber soffit and sides on shores, with its bracing, and its subsequent stripping. It is the most laborious formwork in the structure because of the shoring and the leveling of the soffit. Includes setting out the soffit level, erecting and leveling the soffit on shores with the camber specified, erecting and plumbing the sides, checking the section and alignment, applying release agent, staged stripping taking down the sides first and keeping the soffit and the shores in place until the specified strength is reached, and cleaning and stacking the material. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado del borde perimetral de losa d: Formwork to the perimeter edge of a mat foundation using wood boards with stakes and bracing, and its subsequent stripping. Includes setting out the perimeter, erecting the boards to the exact level of the top of the slab, fixing and bracing them against the thrust of the concrete, applying release agent, stripping and cleaning and stacking the material. Measured by the area of formwork in contact with the concrete.
cadenas.Encofrado metálico modular de columna. I: Modular steel formwork to a column. Includes erection, stripping and cleaning. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado metálico modular de muro. Incl: Modular steel formwork to a wall. Includes erection and stripping. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado perimetral de losa de fundació: Perimeter formwork to a foundation slab.
Perimeter formwork to a mat foundation. Includes erection and dismantling. Measured per meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado y desencofrado de cabezal de p: Formwork and stripping of a pile cap. Includes erection and dismantling. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado y desencofrado de columna de c: Formwork and stripping of a concrete column in lumber. Includes erection, stripping and cleaning. Measured per square meter formed.
Formwork and stripping to a column.
cadenas.Encofrado y desencofrado de escalera de: Formwork and stripping of a reinforced concrete stair. Includes erecting the formwork. Measured per square meter formed.
Formwork and stripping of a concrete stair in lumber. Includes erecting the formwork to the treads and risers. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado y desencofrado de viga de conc: Formwork and stripping of a concrete beam in lumber. Includes erection and stripping. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado y desencofrado de viga de fund: Formwork and stripping of a grade beam. Includes erection and dismantling. Measured per square meter formed.
cadenas.Encofrado y desencofrado de viga de rios: Formwork and stripping to a tie beam.
Formwork and stripping of a tie beam. Includes erection and dismantling. Measured per square meter formed.
Formwork and stripping to a beam.
Formwork and stripping to a footing.
cadenas.Encofrado y desencofrado de zapata. Incl: Formwork and stripping of a footing. Includes erection and dismantling. Measured per square meter formed.
Junction of a roof deck with a parapet or wall.
cadenas.Endurecedor superficial y sellado de pis: Surface hardener and sealing of a concrete floor.
cadenas.Enlucido de yeso con acabado espatulado: Gypsum skim coat with a fine troweled finish, for substrates requiring maximum smoothness. Includes applying the compound and the troweling. Measured per square meter skim coated.
Gypsum skim coat with a troweled finish.
cadenas.Enlucido de yeso sobre muro de ladrillo,: Gypsum skim coat over a brick wall, with screeds and a fine finish. Includes wetting the substrate, the screeds and the finishing. Measured per square meter skim coated.
Gypsum skim coat on a brick wall.
cadenas.Enlucido de yeso sobre paramento de bloq: Gypsum skim coat over a block substrate, with screeds and a fine finish. Includes preparation of the substrate, the screeds and the finishing. Measured per square meter skim coated.
