cadenas.Ensayo de impermeabilización de muro ent: Waterproofing test of a buried wall.
cadenas.Ensayo de líquidos penetrantes para dete: Dye penetrant testing to detect surface cracks in welding, with a report.
cadenas.Ensayo de partículas magnéticas para det: Magnetic particle testing to detect discontinuities in steel welding, with a report.
cadenas.Ensayo de resistencia a compresión de bl: Compression strength test of a masonry block, with the issue of a report.
cadenas.Ensayo de resistencia a compresión de pr: Compression strength test of a concrete test cylinder in the laboratory, with the issue of a report.
cadenas.Ensayo de resistencia de piso de concret: Strength testing of a concrete floor.
cadenas.Ensayo de resistencia del mortero de peg: Strength test of masonry bedding mortar, including sampling and laboratory testing.
cadenas.Ensayo de tracción y doblado de muestra: Tensile and bend test of a sample of reinforcing steel, to verify yield strength and ductility.
cadenas.Ensayo esclerométrico en elementos de co: Rebound hammer testing of concrete elements to estimate strength, with a report.
cadenas.Ensayo granulométrico de agregados (aren: Sieve analysis of aggregates (sand, gravel) to verify their suitability in the concrete mix.
cadenas.Ensayo no destructivo de la resistencia: Non-destructive testing of the strength of hardened concrete with a rebound hammer, with a report.
cadenas.Ensayo radiográfico de soldaduras de alt: Radiographic testing of high-integrity welds to verify internal quality, with a report.
cadenas.Ensayo ultrasónico de soldaduras estruct: Ultrasonic testing of structural welds to detect internal defects, with a report.
cadenas.Entibado de las paredes de zanja mediant: Trench sheeting to the sides of the excavation with lumber planks and struts, to support the ground and allow safe work inside. It is mandatory from the depth at which the ground stops being self-supporting, and its absence is the main cause of serious accidents in trenches. Includes installing the sheeting as the excavation advances and never afterwards, placing the planks and struts with the wedging required, daily inspection of the assembly and after every rainfall, and staged removal as the backfill proceeds. Measured by the area of trench face actually sheeted.
cadenas.Entibado de zanja con tablones y puntale: Trench sheeting with planks and struts, to prevent collapse during excavation.
cadenas.Entrepaños y organizadores interiores de: Shelves and interior organizers for a closet.
Wood intermediate floor with OSB decking.
Recreational equipment for a common area.
cadenas.Equipo de protección para trabajo en alt: Protective equipment for work at height.
cadenas.Escalera exterior de concreto armado con: External reinforced concrete stair with a non-slip finish, on ground or on a structure, with its strip footing. Includes setting out and checking that the going and the rise stay constant over the whole flight, the footing, the reinforcement, the soffit and riser formwork, pouring from the bottom up with a dry mix, floating the treads to a non-slip finish, the fall outwards on each tread so that they do not hold water, curing and striking. Measured by the developed area of treads and risers.
cadenas.Escalera exterior de concreto con pasama: Exterior concrete stair with a handrail.
cadenas.Esmalte sintético sobre carpintería metá: Synthetic enamel paint on metal or wood work, two coats.
Synthetic enamel paint on exterior wood.
cadenas.Estabilización de fondo con material gra: Stabilization of the bottom with granular material.
cadenas.Estabilización de fondo de excavación co: Stabilization of the bottom of an excavation with a layer of stone. Includes placing and compaction. Measured per square meter stabilized.
Stabilization of the bottom of an excavation with granular material. Includes placing and compaction. Measured per square meter stabilized.
Stabilization of the bottom of an excavation.
cadenas.Estabilización de muro con arriostramien: Stabilizing a wall with temporary steel bracing. Includes installing the bracing. Measured per square meter stabilized.
cadenas.Estabilización de talud con malla metáli: Stabilization of a slope with mesh. Includes placing the mesh. Measured per square meter stabilized.
Stabilization of a slope with mesh.
cadenas.Estructura de madera para cubierta con p: Timber roof structure with rafters, ties and purlins, with connector hardware and preservative treatment. Includes assembly and erection.
cadenas.Estructura de paneles solares sobre tech: Support structure for solar panels on a pitched roof.
cadenas.Estructura ligera de apoyo para cubierta: Lightweight support structure for a translucent roof.
cadenas.Estructura metálica de cerchas y correas: Metal roof structure of trusses and purlins for a gable roof, in steel sections, welded and painted. Includes shop fabrication and erection on site.
cadenas.Estructura metálica ligera de perfiles p: Lightweight metal framing to support a translucent roof covering, with anti-corrosion paint and fixings. Includes assembly and erection.
cadenas.Estructura metálica menor para marquesin: Light structural steelwork for a canopy.
cadenas.Estructura metálica para entrepiso liger: Steelwork for a lightweight intermediate floor.
Fine skim coat of compound over plaster.
cadenas.Estuco veneciano o acabado decorativo mi: Venetian plaster or decorative mineral finish.
cadenas.Estudio de viabilidad de incorporación d: Feasibility study for the incorporation of renewable energy, with analysis of solar radiation and consumption.
cadenas.Evaluación energética de la vivienda, co: Energy assessment of the dwelling, with inspection of the thermal envelope, services and consumption, and the issue of a report.
cadenas.Excavación a cielo abierto con formación: Open-cut excavation with the formation of battered sides. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de explanada para nivelación: Excavation to formation level for leveling the site. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de pozo para fundación aislad: Excavation of a pit for a pad foundation. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
Excavation of a pit for a foundation.
Excavation for a buried inspection chamber.
cadenas.Excavación de registro o tanquilla enter: Excavation for a buried inspection chamber. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per unit excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de sótano, con retirada de ti: Excavation for a basement, including removal of the spoil. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de zanja con entibado de made: Excavation of a trench with lumber sheeting. Includes excavation and sheeting. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
Excavation of a trench with sheeting.
cadenas.Excavación de zanja para cable de datos: Excavation of a trench for a data or telecommunications cable. Includes excavation. Measured per meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de zanja para canalización el: Excavation of a trench for an electrical conduit. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de zanja para fundación corri: Excavation of a trench for a strip footing. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de zanja para tubería de agua: Excavation of a trench for a water pipe. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación de zanja para tubería de dren: Excavation of a trench for a drainage pipe. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per meter excavated.
Excavation of a trench for a gas pipe. Includes excavation and trimming. Measured per meter excavated.
Excavation in hard material or rock.
cadenas.Excavación en terreno con presencia de a: Excavation in water-bearing ground, including dewatering. Includes excavation and dewatering. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación en terreno de alta compacidad: Excavation in ground of high compaction, cemented material or rock, with a hydraulic breaker mounted on a backhoe, with a hand-held pneumatic breaker for the corners. It applies where the output of conventional excavation falls below what is acceptable, a circumstance that must be recorded on site to justify the change of item. Includes breaking up the material, extracting and stockpiling it, trimming the sides and bottom, and controlling vibration where there are adjoining buildings. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación localizada a mano en interior: Localized hand excavation indoors. Includes excavation and removal. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación manual en el interior de una: Hand excavation inside an existing building, for reducing levels, constructing strengthening foundations or running buried services. Output is far lower than for open-cut excavation because of the lack of room to manoeuvre, the impossibility of using plant and the need to carry the material out by hand through the building. Includes setting out, protecting the circulation areas, excavating in layers with pick and shovel, bagging the material and carrying it to the external stockpile. Disposal is not included.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja de sección re: Hand excavation of a narrow trench for laying water pipes, drains or buried electrical conduits, to the fall required by the service. It is done by hand precisely because in built-up areas the risk of striking an existing service makes the machine inadvisable. Includes setting out the line, excavating in layers under continuous watch, stockpiling the material alongside the trench, trimming the bottom to the required fall and keeping the trench signed while it remains open. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja o pozo para f: Hand excavation of a trench or pit for foundations, in ground of medium consistency, to the level and to the design dimensions. It is the usual solution on refurbishment work and extensions where plant cannot get in or the volume does not justify it. Includes setting out the trench, excavating in layers with pick and shovel, stockpiling the material far enough back from the edge not to overload it, trimming the sides and bottom, and getting the material out to the loading point. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja para fundacio: Hand excavation of a foundation trench.
cadenas.Excavación manual en zanja para instalac: Hand excavation of a trench for buried services.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada a cielo abierto co: Mechanical open-cut excavation with the material cast to one side. Includes excavation and stockpiling of the material removed. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada a cielo abierto en: Mechanical open-cut excavation in soft ground. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
Mechanical open-cut excavation in hard ground. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada a cielo abierto pa: Mechanical open-cut excavation for general bulk excavation, reducing levels or forming a platform, with a backhoe or skid steer loader, in ground of medium consistency. Includes setting out and marking the final level, excavating in layers, stockpiling the material on site or loading it directly onto a truck, hand trimming of the edges and slopes, and survey control of the level achieved. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design levels.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada en zanja o pozo pa: Mechanical excavation of a trench or pit for foundations with a backhoe, in ground of medium consistency, to the level and to the design dimensions. Includes setting out, excavation by machine, stockpiling the material far enough back from the edge, hand trimming of the sides and bottom that the machine cannot achieve, and watching during excavation so that work stops if unforeseen buried services are found. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación mecanizada en zanja para fund: Mechanical excavation of a foundation trench.
cadenas.Excavación para cimientos de edificación: Excavation for the foundations of a building.
Excavation for the footings of a building. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
cadenas.Excavación para el alojamiento de tanque: Excavation to receive a septic tank, catch basin, buried water tank or similar, to the design dimensions plus the working space needed for installation and subsequent backfilling around it. Includes setting out, excavation by mechanical means with hand trimming, trimming the bottom to the exact bearing level, checking the stability of the sides and sheeting them where the depth requires it, and signing and covering the void while it remains open. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Excavación para piscina o tanque enterra: Excavation for a swimming pool or buried tank. Includes excavation and stockpiling. Measured per cubic meter excavated.
Excavation for a swimming pool or tank.
cadenas.Excavación para tanque séptico, sumidero: Excavation for a septic tank, catch basin or buried tank.
CO2 fire extinguisher for an electrical panel.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de alacena o a: Manufacture and installation of a melamine storage cupboard, with doors and shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de alacena o d: Manufacture and installation of a full height kitchen pantry, with its shelves, drawers or pull-out system. Includes measuring on site, preparing the cutting list and cutting with edge banding, assembling and anchoring the carcass to the wall and to the floor, leveling, fitting the shelves and the pull-out systems with their runners, fitting the doors and adjusting them and the trim at the top against the ceiling. Measured by the length of pantry front.
Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen pantry, with shelves and doors. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de asiento o b: Manufacture and installation of fixed seating or a bench in melamine or wood, fixed. Includes cutting list and fixing.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de barra de ba: Manufacture and installation of a bar or cafeteria counter in melamine or wood, with a countertop. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de closet de v: Manufacture and installation of a melamine walk-in closet with drawer units, hanging rails and shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de closet empo: Manufacture and installation of a built-in closet to measure in melamine, with doors, shelves and a hanging rail. Includes cutting list and assembly.

Manufacture and installation of a built-in closet to measure in melamine board, with its carcass, shelves, hanging rails and drawers, to the cutting list agreed. Includes measuring on site and checking the opening for plumb and square, preparing the cutting list and cutting the boards with edge banding, erecting the carcass level and plumb on shims, taking up the irregularities of the wall with a scribe, fitting the shelves, rails and drawers with their slides and the final adjustment. Measured by the area of closet front.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de gabinete al: Manufacture and installation of a moisture resistant melamine bathroom wall cabinet, with doors and shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de isla o pení: Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen island or peninsula, with countertop and drawers. Includes assembly, leveling and fixing.

Manufacture and installation of a kitchen island or peninsula, with its carcass, cabinets to one or both faces, and provision for services. Includes prior coordination of the water, waste and electrical points that have to fall within the island and are installed before the floor, a point which if overlooked means breaking out the finished floor, anchoring the carcass to the floor so that it cannot move, assembling and leveling the units, fitting the doors and drawers and the end panels. The countertop is not included. Measured by the length of island.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mostrador d: Manufacture and installation of a reception counter in melamine or wood, with a countertop. Includes cutting list and assembly.
Manufacture and installation of a commercial display counter, in melamine with glass. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble alto: Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen wall cabinet, with doors and shelves. Includes cutting list, assembly and fixing to the wall.

Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen wall cabinet, with its carcass, doors and shelves, hung from the wall. Includes checking that the wall can carry the load, since a loaded wall cabinet is heavy and on a gypsum board partition needs internal strengthening beforehand, setting out the working height in coordination with the countertop and backsplash, fitting the hanging rail or brackets, assembling and hanging the units, leveling and joining them, fitting the doors on adjustable hinges and adjusting the fronts. Measured by the length of cabinet front.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble bajo: Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen base cabinet with an opening for the sink. Includes cutting list, assembly and the cut-out for the sink.
Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen base cabinet, with doors, drawers and plinth. Includes measuring, cutting list, assembly, leveling and adjustment of the fronts.

Manufacture and installation of a melamine kitchen base cabinet, with its carcass, doors, drawers, shelves and plinth. Includes measuring on site and checking plumb and square, preparing the cutting list and cutting with edge banding, allowing for the openings and cut-outs for pipework and electrical outlets before assembly, assembling the units, leveling on adjustable legs, joining the units together, fitting the doors and drawers with their slides and adjusting the fronts until the reveals are even. Measured by the length of cabinet front.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de b: Manufacture and installation of a moisture resistant melamine bathroom vanity unit with an opening for the basin. Includes cutting list, assembly and fixing.
Manufacture and installation of a wall hung bathroom vanity unit, fixed to the wall on brackets. Includes assembly and fixing.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de d: Manufacture and installation of a melamine pantry unit with drawers and adjustable shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
Manufacture and installation of a melamine bedroom unit to measure (chest of drawers), with drawers and pulls. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de e: Manufacture and installation of a melamine corner kitchen cabinet, with access to the back of the corner. Includes cutting list and assembly.
Manufacture and installation of external furniture to measure in treated lumber. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de l: Manufacture and installation of a moisture resistant melamine laundry unit with an opening for the sink. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de r: Manufacture and installation of a melamine reception unit, with a countertop and fronts. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de v: Manufacture and installation of a glazed display cabinet with doors. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble de á: Manufacture and installation of a melamine unit for a common area, with seating or a work surface. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de mueble fijo: Manufacture and installation of a fixed cabinet to measure in melamine or wood, to the cutting list agreed with the client, for entrance halls, living rooms, desks or other uses. Includes measuring on site, preparing the cutting list and cutting with edge banding, assembling the carcass, anchoring and leveling it to the wall and to the floor, fitting the doors, drawers and shelves with their hardware, adjusting the fronts and finishing with a scribe that takes up the irregularities of the wall. Measured by the area of cabinet front.
Manufacture and installation of a fixed cabinet to measure in melamine, with doors and shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portillo pe: Manufacture and installation of a metal pedestrian gate in the boundary, with a frame and a lock. Includes assembly and the lock.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portón corr: Manufacture and installation of a sliding access gate, with a track and carriers. Includes assembly and painting. The gate is selected by the client.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portón de a: Manufacture and installation of a metal vehicular access gate, with a frame, hinges and paint. Includes assembly and painting. The gate is selected by the client.

Manufacture and installation of a vehicular access gate, hinged or sliding, with its frame, facing, hardware and anchors. Includes fabricating the reinforced frame sized for the opening, the anti-corrosion treatment, constructing or checking the piers or the track according to the type of opening, assembly and leveling, adjusting the travel and the stops, fitting the lock or latch and providing the electrical conduit if it is to be motorized. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portón de m: Manufacture and installation of a wire mesh access gate, with a frame and hinges. Includes assembly. The gate is selected by the client.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de portón peat: Manufacture and installation of a metal pedestrian gate, with a frame and a lock. Includes assembly and painting. The gate is selected by the client.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de repisa o es: Manufacture and installation of a fixed shelf or shelving unit in melamine or wood, with its supports anchored to the wall. Includes setting out the height and the spacing of the supports according to the thickness of the board and the load expected, since a shelf with supports too far apart sags permanently, anchoring the supports with the system suited to the type of wall, cutting and edging the board, placing and leveling it and finishing the exposed edges. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de verja metál: Manufacture and installation of a metal railing for the boundary, with bars and a frame, painted. Includes assembly and painting.
cadenas.Fabricación e instalación de zapatero em: Manufacture and installation of a built-in melamine shoe cabinet, with sloping shelves. Includes cutting list and assembly.
cadenas.Fabricación o suministro e instalación d: Manufacture or supply and installation of a bathroom vanity unit with an integrated or overmount basin, wall hung or floor standing. Includes checking the strengthening of the wall for wall hung units, which carry the weight of the unit plus that of the basin when full, setting out the working height, allowing for the cut-outs for the waste and the supplies, anchoring, leveling, fitting the doors and drawers with adjustment and sealing the perimeter against the wall. The unit and the basin are selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de puerta abati: Manufacture and installation of a hinged closet door, with hinges and a pull. Includes assembly and adjustment.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de puerta corre: Manufacture and installation of a sliding closet door, with top and bottom tracks and carriers. Includes assembly and adjustment.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de puerta de cl: Manufacture and installation of a closet door with an integrated mirror, hinged or sliding. Includes assembly and adjustment.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de repisa o est: Manufacture and installation of a fixed shelf or shelving unit, in melamine or wood, fixed to the wall. Includes cutting and fixing.
cadenas.Fabricación y colocación de tapa de mesó: Manufacture and installation of a wood or melamine countertop, with edge banding. Includes cutting list and fixing.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de baranda metálic: Manufacture and installation of a metal guardrail to a balcony, terrace or stair, with its handrail, posts and bars, anchored to the floor or to the edge of the slab. The height and the spacing of the bars are not free design choices: they answer to safety criteria against falling and against a child passing between them. Includes fabrication, the anti-corrosion treatment, setting out and mechanically anchoring the posts, making good the anchors, checking the stiffness of the assembly against horizontal thrust and the finish. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de entrepaños, caj: Manufacture and fitting of melamine closet shelves, drawer units, shoe storage and internal organizers, with their supports and hardware. Includes preparing the cutting list to the layout agreed, cutting and edging, setting out the working heights, fitting the supports and shelves level, fitting the drawers on their slides and adjusting the fronts. Measured by the length of shelf or organizer actually installed.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de estructura metá: Manufacture and installation of minor metalwork, such as canopies, pergolas, equipment supports and ancillary structures, with its anti-corrosion treatment. Includes setting out, cutting and assembling the sections, welding the joints and cleaning off the slag, the anti-corrosion treatment, hoisting and erection, anchoring to the support and the geometric check. Measured by the weight actually erected.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de portón de reja: Manufacture and installation of a hinged grille gate for pedestrian or vehicular access, with its frame, reinforced hinges, latch and lock. Includes fabricating the frame and the surround, the anti-corrosion treatment, fixing the surround anchored to the piers, hanging it on hinges sized for the weight, adjusting the level so that the gate neither swings open nor shuts by itself, fitting the latch and the lock and the finish. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de pérgola de made: Manufacture and assembly of an external pergola in treated lumber, with its posts, beams, purlins and anchors to the base. In a tropical climate the point of failure is always where the post meets the floor: lumber in direct contact with concrete takes up moisture by capillary action and rots from the bottom up, so it must stand on a metal shoe that holds it clear of the floor. Includes forming the anchorage blocks, fitting the post shoes, cutting and shaping the members, erecting the structure with temporary supports, fixing with the hardware and applying preservative to every face and every end grain. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Fabricación y montaje de reja de protecc: Manufacture and installation of a metal security grille with its frame and bars, anchored to the wall. Includes setting out and measuring on site, fabricating the frame with its bars at the spacing agreed, the anti-corrosion treatment, offering up and mechanical anchoring to the wall with cast-in bolts or resin, making good the anchor points and applying the primer and the finish. In bedrooms at least one panel should be openable from the inside as an emergency exit. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Fachada de bloque de concreto con acabad: Concrete blockwork facade with an exposed finish.
Face brick facade with a cavity.
cadenas.Fachada de ladrillo visto con juntas col: Face brick facade with colored mortar joints.
cadenas.Fachada ligera de placa de cemento con a: Lightweight cement board facade with insulation.
cadenas.Fachada ventilada con subestructura y ai: Ventilated facade with a substructure and insulation.
cadenas.Formación al personal en el manejo segur: Training for personnel in the safe use of site equipment and tools.
Formation of an internal roller shutter box. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Formación de cajón o falso pilar de plac: Formation of a boxed section or false pier in gypsum board to conceal services inside the lining. Includes the framework of the boxed section, the board and the joint treatment. Measured per meter of boxed section.
cadenas.Formación de cajón para instalaciones en: Formation of a service void in a wall lining.
cadenas.Formación de cajón para ocultar instalac: Formation of a service duct to conceal services. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Formación de cajón para persiana con reg: Formation of a roller shutter box with an access panel. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Formación de cornisa perimetral con perf: Formation of a perimeter cornice with a specific profile to house an LED strip for indirect lighting, mounted on the ceiling. Includes setting out the height and the gap to the soffit, which determines the spread of the beam and therefore the lighting effect achieved, installing the profile, finishing the joints, providing for the cable run and for the position of the driver at an accessible point, and leaving the finish ready to paint. Does not include the LED strip. Measured by the length actually completed.
cadenas.Formación de cortinero empotrado en el c: Formation of a recessed curtain track in the ceiling, with its recess, structural reinforcement and rail. It is a detail that has to be decided before the ceiling is closed and that does not admit later improvisation: resolving it afterwards means opening the finished ceiling. Includes the prior coordination of the width of the recess with the curtain system, the reinforcement of the framework along the line of the rail to carry the weight of the curtain, lining the recess, finishing the arrises, installing the rail and going over it to leave it ready to paint. Measured by the length actually completed.
cadenas.Formación de cumbrera y limatesa en cubi: Formation of the ridge and hips on a tiled roof with purpose-made units bedded in mortar, to close the slope weathertight. Includes bedding and sealing.
cadenas.Formación de cumbrera, limatesa o remate: Formation of a ridge, hip or verge on a tiled roof, with purpose-made units bedded in mortar and sealed. It is the line through which water gets in when it is badly detailed, and also the first the wind lifts. Includes setting out, leveling the ridge line, laying the units lapping against the prevailing wind, bedding in mortar and sealing the junctions. Measured by the length actually constructed.
cadenas.Formación de falso pilar de placa de yes: Formation of a false column in gypsum board. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Formación de foso o cajón perimetral en: Formation of a recessed pocket or perimeter box section in a gypsum board ceiling to house curtains, blinds or concealed lighting. Includes setting out the line and the depth of the pocket coordinated with the width of the curtain system, installing the reinforcing framework, lining it with board on the three faces, the joint and arris treatment with corner bead, sanding and forming an access opening for the mechanism. Measured by the length actually completed.
cadenas.Formación de jambas y mochetas de vano c: Formation of the jambs and reveals of an opening in mortar.
Formation of the jambs and reveals of an opening in mortar. Includes setting out and forming the reveals. Measured per meter constructed.
Formation of the jambs and reveals of an opening.
cadenas.Formación de media caña de mortero en el: Forming a mortar cove at the junction of the wall and the floor, to remove the internal arris in kitchens, service areas and premises with demanding hygiene requirements. The sharp arris is where dirt builds up and where cleaning water gets in under the covering; the cove removes it and allows continuous sweeping. Includes cleaning and wetting, laying the mortar with a waterproofing admixture, shaping it with a template and floating, leaving the surface ready to receive the covering or the sealer. Measured by the length actually completed.
cadenas.Formación de pendientes con concreto lig: Formation of falls in low strength lightweight concrete on a flat roof, to create the drop towards the roof drains or channels. Includes the perimeter formwork, spreading and screeding to rails and curing the surface.
cadenas.Formación de pendientes en cubierta plan: Formation of falls on a flat roof with a lightweight mortar fill, to the varying thickness needed to direct water to the roof drains at the minimum gradient specified. It is the layer that decides whether the roof drains or ponds, and the commonest mistake is to leave too little fall or to create back falls next to the parapets. Includes setting out the hip lines and the low points at the drains, placing screed rails, spreading and screeding the mortar, floating and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Formación de pendientes sobre base de cu: Screed to falls over the roof deck in cement mortar lightweightened with expanded clay or polystyrene, to direct water to the drainage points. Includes setting out screed rails, laying the fill to increasing thicknesses and the final floating of the surface.
cadenas.Formación del alero y del remate del bor: Formation of the eaves and the edge trim of the roof, with the closing unit, drip edge and sealant. The drip edge is what breaks the water away from the wall: without it the water runs round the edge by capillary action and down the facade, leaving the characteristic staining below badly detailed eaves. Includes setting out, placing the trim with its projection, forming the drip, sealing the junction with the roof and with the wall and fixing. Measured by the length actually constructed.
cadenas.Formación del brocal o antepecho de vent: Formation of the sub sill or apron to a window in a masonry wall, with its top finished with a fall to the outside that sheds rainwater. That fall and the drip beneath are what stop water running down the facade and ending up penetrating below the window, a very common defect where the sill is built flat. Includes setting out the level, building the masonry of the apron, forming the fall and the drip, and bedding the side bearings solid. It does not include the finish sill. Measured by the length actually constructed.
Training in the use of equipment.
cadenas.Formación específica al personal para tr: Specific training for personnel in work at height, with practical use of PPE.
cadenas.Formación específica en trabajos en altu: Specific training for work at height.
cadenas.Formación y remate del umbral de paso en: Formation and finishing of the threshold between rooms with floors of different materials or levels, resolving the transition without a dangerous step. An unresolved difference in level of more than a centimeter is a trip hazard, and at entrances and in bathrooms it is also a barrier. Includes setting out, making the substrate level with mortar to form the transition ramp where the difference requires it, fitting the threshold piece or profile, sealing the edges and checking that no sharp edge is left. Measured by the length actually completed.
cadenas.Formación y repaso de las jambas y moche: Formation and making good of the jambs and reveals of a door or window opening, leaving them plumb, square and at the exact dimensions to receive the joinery. It is the operation that decides whether the joinery goes in without forcing it: an opening out of square has to be rebuilt or resolved with packings and sealants that show. Includes hacking back the excesses, making good and leveling the deficient areas with mortar, checking plumb, squareness and diagonals, and finishing the surface ready to stucco. Measured by the length of jamb actually constructed.
Boxing in of a downpipe with cement board.
Boxing in a downpipe with cement board. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per square meter boxed in.
cadenas.Forrado de conducto de climatización con: Boxing in an HVAC duct with gypsum board. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per meter boxed in.
cadenas.Forrado de montante de instalaciones con: Boxing in a services riser with board. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per meter boxed in.
Boxing in of a service riser.
Boxing in of pipework with gypsum board.
cadenas.Forrado de tubería o bajante con placa d: Boxing in a pipe or downpipe with gypsum board. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per meter boxed in.
Boxing in of a beam with gypsum board.
cadenas.Forrado de viga con placa de yeso. Inclu: Boxing in a beam with gypsum board. Includes the framing and the board. Measured per square meter boxed in.
cadenas.Forro de paramento interior con machihem: Lining of an interior substrate with tongue and groove wood boarding mounted on battens fixed to the wall, with a ventilation cavity behind. The cavity and the preservative treatment are what stop the wood rotting from the damp the wall may transmit, the usual problem when tongue and groove is nailed straight against the substrate. Includes setting out, assembling and leveling the battens, applying the preservative to every face and to the end grain, fixing the tongue and groove with a driven fit, the perimeter trim with moldings and the final sanding. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Forro de pared con machihembrado de made: Wall lining with tongued and grooved boarding.
cadenas.Forro de placa de cemento como soporte d: Cement board lining as a tiling substrate in a shower area.
Cement board sheathing on a facade.
cadenas.Forro de placa de cemento reforzada con: Lining of fiber cement board on a facade, on a framework, as a lightweight enclosure. Includes the framework, the board and sealing the joints. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
Lining of fiber cement board on a framework, for exterior or exposed substrates. Includes the framework, the board and sealing the joints. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Forro de placa de cemento sobre estructu: Cement board lining on a frame in a wet area.
cadenas.Forro de placa de yeso con registro de a: Plasterboard lining with an access panel.
cadenas.Forro de placa de yeso laminado con regi: Lining of gypsum board with an access panel for the inspection of concealed services. Includes the framework, the board, the access panel and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Forro de placa de yeso laminado sobre es: Lining of gypsum board on a metal framework for a party wall, without direct contact with the adjoining wall. Includes the framework, the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Forro de placa de yeso sobre estructura: Plasterboard lining on a frame at a party wall.
cadenas.Forro de placa de yeso sobre rastreles p: Plasterboard lining on battens, forming a service void.
cadenas.Forro ignífugo de conducto de instalacio: Fire-rated enclosure of a service duct.
cadenas.Forro ignífugo de placa de yeso para pro: Fire-rated gypsum board enclosure to protect services.
cadenas.Forro ignífugo de placa de yeso resisten: Fire resistant lining of fire rated gypsum board for the protection of ducts and vertical services. Includes the framework, the fire rated board and sealing the penetrations. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Foso o cajón de cortina en cielo raso de: Curtain recess in a gypsum board ceiling.
Cement plaster with reinforcement mesh on the facade.
cadenas.Friso de mortero aplicado mediante máqui: Mortar stucco applied by a spraying machine, screeded and floated. Mechanical spraying multiplies the output compared with laying by hand and improves the compaction and the adhesion of the mortar against the substrate, so it pays off from medium sized areas upwards. Includes cleaning and wetting the substrate, placing screeds and corner beads, continuous mixing and pumping, spraying in bands, ruling off, floating and curing. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
Colored cement plaster on a surface.
cadenas.Friso de mortero con hidrófugo en parame: Water-repellent cement plaster on exterior surfaces.
cadenas.Friso de mortero de cemento y arena cern: Cement and screened sand stucco over an interior block or brick substrate, 1.5 cm average thickness, screeded and finished with a trowel. Includes cleaning and wetting the substrate beforehand, placing screeds and corner beads at corners and junctions, reinforcing mesh at changes of material, laying and ruling off the mortar, and a floated finish leaving the surface flat and plumb, ready to receive paint or ceramic tiling. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Friso de mortero de cemento y arena con: Cement and sand stucco with an integral waterproofing admixture, 2 cm average thickness, screeded and floated over an exterior block or brick substrate. The waterproofing admixture reduces the capillary absorption of the mortar, which is the route by which driving rain ends up appearing as damp on the inner face. Includes working from scaffolding, cleaning and wetting the substrate, placing screeds and corner beads, the reinforcing mesh at the junctions between different materials, laying and ruling off the mortar in two coats, the final floating and curing over the first few days, without which exterior stucco cracks through shrinkage. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Friso de mortero en zonas estrechas y mo: Cement plaster in narrow areas and reveals.
cadenas.Friso de mortero maestreado sobre parame: Screeded cement plaster on interior surfaces, 1.5 cm thick.
cadenas.Friso de mortero sobre bloque de concret: Cement plaster on a concrete block wall.
Cement plaster on a stone wall.
cadenas.Friso de nivelación de columnas y vigas: Leveling stucco on concrete columns and beams to make their surface even prior to the finish. Includes applying the mortar and finishing the arrises. Measured per meter made level.
Leveling plaster on columns and beams.
cadenas.Friso de pasta de yeso de 1,2 cm de espe: Gypsum plaster of 1.2 cm average thickness applied over an interior masonry substrate, screeded and finished with a trowel. Compared with mortar stucco it offers a smoother finish and a markedly higher output, but it does not tolerate moisture, so it is ruled out in bathrooms, exposed kitchens and walls in contact with the exterior. Includes cleaning the substrate, placing screeds and corner beads, mixing the compound in quantities matched to the working time, laying and ruling off, and finishing with a trowel until the surface is ready to paint. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Friso de yeso en techo interior, con mae: Gypsum plaster on an interior ceiling, with screeds and a fine finish. Includes applying the gypsum compound and the finishing. Measured per square meter plastered.
cadenas.Friso decorativo de media pared con mold: Decorative chair rail frieze with a molding or profile, as a transition element between finishes. Includes fixing the profile and finishing the joint. Measured per meter of frieze.
cadenas.Friso impermeabilizante en muro de conte: Waterproofing stucco on a retaining wall.
Textured rustic stucco on the facade.
cadenas.Gancho o anclaje de seguridad en cubiert: Safety hook or anchor on a roof.
Management of waste oils and lubricants.
cadenas.Habilitación de control de accesos a la: Provision of access control to the site, with a register of personnel entering.
cadenas.Habilitación de una zona cerrada dentro: Fitting out an enclosed area within the site for storing materials and keeping tools, either by building an enclosure in sheet wood on a frame with a door and lock, or by adapting an existing room. Includes building the enclosure and fitting the door with a lock, protecting the floor of the storage area, providing shelving or pallets to keep materials off the ground, keeping it tidy throughout the period, and dismantling it when the works finish. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Habilitación de zona de acopio de cartón: Provision of a cardboard and packaging storage area for recycling, with floor protection and signage.
cadenas.Habilitación de zona de acopio de chatar: Provision of a scrap metal storage area, delimited and signposted, for sale or delivery to a licensed waste carrier.
cadenas.Habilitación de zona de acopio de madera: Provision of a lumber and pallet storage area for reuse or recycling, delimited and signposted.
cadenas.Habilitación de zona de acopio y clasifi: Provision of a waste storage and sorting area on site, delimited, signposted and separated by type of material. Sorting at source is not only an environmental requirement: it recovers the value of the scrap and the cardboard, and it cuts the cost of disposal by reducing the volume of mixed waste going to landfill. Includes delimiting the area, protecting the floor, placing the containers or sacks by type of waste, signage and keeping the area tidy during the works. Measured by the area of the space provided.
cadenas.Habilitación de zona de lavado de herram: Fitting out an area for washing tools. Includes the water connection and marking out the area. Measured per area fitted out.
cadenas.Habilitación y mantenimiento de la zona: Provision and maintenance of the changing and canteen area for site personnel, with its basic furniture, for one month. Includes fitting out the space, providing a table, seating, lockers or coat hooks and a drinking water point, periodic cleaning and keeping the area tidy. Measured per month provided.
cadenas.Herraje de unión de estructura de madera: Connector hardware for a wood structure.
cadenas.Herraje o conector metálico para unión d: Metal connector or hardware for wood structural joints.
Siloxane water-repellent treatment of a facade.
Water-repellent treatment of a tile roof.
cadenas.Hidrofugación de fachada de piedra o lad: Water-repellent treatment of a stone or brick facade.
Water-repellent treatment of a concrete surface.
cadenas.Hidrolavado previo y dos manos de pintur: Previous pressure washing and two coats of exterior paint on a facade. Includes the cleaning with a pressure washer, the preparation and the two coats. Measured per square meter painted.
cadenas.Identificación y etiquetado de contenedo: Identification and labeling of waste containers.
LED lighting with an occupancy sensor.
Exterior LED lighting with a photocell.
cadenas.Iluminación provisional de los frentes d: Temporary lighting of the work faces using site floodlights on stands or suspended, fed from the temporary panel, providing the light level needed to work safely and to a good finish. Includes distributing the lighting points among the active work faces, running the cable, fixing the floodlights clear of walkways and of the line of throw of materials, repositioning them as the works progress, replacing lamps, and dismantling at the end. Measured over the area of the works actually lit.
cadenas.Iluminación provisional de obra, con ref: Temporary site lighting with floodlights. Includes installing the floodlights. Measured per point installed.
cadenas.Impartición de charla de inducción en se: Delivery of the safety induction to personnel entering the site.
cadenas.Impermeabilización con acrílico elastomé: Waterproofing with an elastomeric acrylic and mesh.
cadenas.Impermeabilización con membrana cementos: Waterproofing with a flexible cementitious membrane.
cadenas.Impermeabilización con membrana líquida: Waterproofing with a high elasticity liquid polyurethane membrane, applied in two coats over a primer, forming a continuous seamless layer. Against acrylic it offers greater elasticity, better resistance to permanent ponding and a longer service life, at a higher cost. Includes preparing and repairing the substrate, priming, reinforcing the junctions and penetrations with a strip, applying the coats crosswise respecting the consumption and the time between coats, and protecting it from traffic until fully cured. Measured by the area actually constructed.
Waterproofing with a liquid polyurethane membrane.
cadenas.Impermeabilización con mortero cementoso: Waterproofing with a two-component flexible cementitious mortar applied in two cross coats by brush or trowel. Unlike bituminous and polyurethane systems, it can stay in permanent contact with water and receive tiling directly on top, which is why it is the system for tanks, planters and wet areas beneath ceramic tile. Includes pre-saturating the substrate, reinforcing the junctions and corners with an elastic strip, applying the two cross coats and the watertightness test. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Impermeabilización de balcón con acrílic: Waterproofing of a balcony with elastomeric acrylic and mesh. Includes preparing the substrate and applying the acrylic. Measured per square meter waterproofed.

The critical point is the junction of the floor with the wall and the collar of the drain: that is where 90 % of the bathrooms that leak to the floor below fail. Includes saturating the substrate, reinforcing every junction with a strip, treating the drain with its collar, the two cross coats and the ponding test before tiling. Includes mounting the assembly on an anti-vibration base, the connections with unions, mounting the pressure gauge and the pressure switch, charging the air in the tank to the precharge pressure corresponding to the cut-in pressure, a step that is frequently skipped and that causes continuous starting which burns out the pump, setting the cut-in and cut-out pressures and the full cycle test. The equipment is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per system installed and tested.

Includes mounting the board, connecting the three lines of mains, backup and load, verifying the mechanical or electrical interlock, programming the timings on automatic units and the full transfer and retransfer test. Measured per board installed and tested.

The tank is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per unit installed.

cadenas.Instalación de trampa de grasa prefabric: Installation of a prefabricated grease interceptor in the kitchen drainage, with its inlet and outlet connections and its removable cover. Its function is to hold back the fats before they reach the system, where they solidify and end up blocking the sewer. Includes excavation or preparing the housing, leveling the unit, connecting the inlet and the outlet respecting the levels and the drop between them, bedding the perimeter, placing the cover so that it stays accessible for periodic cleaning, and the flow test. Includes setting out, cutting, cleaning and solvent cementing the joints, fittings such as bends, wyes and traps, fixing with pipe clips or bearing on a bed according to the run, and testing the system for watertightness. It does not include cutting chases or the civil work for the trench, which are priced separately. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Instalación de tubería de polipropileno: Installation of 20 mm polypropylene PPR pipework for hot or cold water distribution, concealed in the wall. Includes setting out the run, cutting the chase with an electric wall chaser with dust extraction, laying the pipework with heat fusion joints, fittings and specials, fixing with pipe clips, pressure testing for watertightness and filling the chase with a repair mortar, leaving the face ready for its finish. It does not include the final finish to the wall. Measured by the length actually installed.

cadenas.Instalación de videoportero o citófono,: Installation of a video or audio door entry system, with its external door panel, internal monitor, power supply and cabling. Includes the field layout of the height of the external panel and of the camera so that it frames the visitor correctly, recessing the panel back box, running the cabling in independent containment, mounting the monitor, connecting the power supply and the electric lock release if there is one, and commissioning with a test of the picture, the audio and the release. The equipment is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per system installed.
Video intercom or door entry intercom installation.

cadenas.Instalación del contador de descargas co: Installation of the lightning strike counter with its test control, inserted in the down conductor of the protection system. Includes cutting the conductor, mounting the counter in an accessible box or on a support, connecting the lengths of down conductor and fixing the assembly at a height accessible for inspection. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Instalación eléctrica provisional para e: Temporary electrical installation to supply the works, made up of a distribution panel with a ground-fault circuit interrupter and circuit breakers, power outlets, and heavy-duty rubber cable run to the work faces. Includes connecting to the authorized supply point, mounting and fixing the panel somewhere protected and accessible, running the cable along routes that cross neither walkways nor wet areas, grounding the whole installation, testing that the ground-fault interrupter trips before the system is brought into service, maintaining it while the works last, and dismantling it at the end. Measured per installation actually carried out.

Injection of cracks in concrete with epoxy resin. Includes injection. Measured per meter injected.
cadenas.Inyección de resina en fisura para sella: Injection of resin into a crack to seal water ingress through a wall or slab. Includes preparing the crack, fitting the injection ports and injecting. Measured per meter injected.
