Satin wood stain for a pergola or exterior wood.
Taking up paving blocks for reuse.
cadenas.Levantado de pavimento de adoquín con re: Taking up paving of concrete pavers, recovering the units. Includes taking up, cleaning and stacking the units. Measured per square meter taken up.
cadenas.Levantado de pavimento exterior de adoqu: Taking up external paving of concrete pavers or stone setts, together with its sand bed, by hand with a crowbar and pick. Because the units are independent, taking them up allows a high proportion of the material to be recovered for reuse. Includes lifting in order from a free edge, cleaning the units and removing the sand and mortar bonded to them, sorting them into reusable and waste, palletising or stacking the recoverable ones, removing the sand bed and sweeping the base. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually taken up.
Taking up a parquet or wood floor.
cadenas.Levantado de piso existente de parquet o: Taking up an existing parquet or wood strip floor, including the battens or the adhesive fixing it to the base, by hand with a crowbar and scraper. Includes removing the skirtings beforehand, scraping off the adhesive remaining bonded to the base, drawing out the nails or screws left in the base, removing the material in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the resulting surface. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually taken up.
cadenas.Levantado de piso laminado flotante exis: Taking up an existing floating laminate floor, including the acoustic underlay and the perimeter skirtings, by hand. Being a floating click system the dismantling is quick and produces no heavy debris. Includes taking up the boards in order, removing the underlay and the perimeter profile, cleaning and vacuuming the resulting base and removing the material in sacks to the stockpile. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually taken up.
cadenas.Levantado de piso vinílico, linóleo o al: Taking up a vinyl, linoleum or carpet floor.
cadenas.Levantado de revestimiento de piso flexi: Taking up an existing resilient floor covering, whether vinyl sheet or tile, linoleum or carpet, including the adhesive fixing it to the base, by hand with a scraper and a stripping knife. Includes applying adhesive remover locally where the adhesive is strongly bonded, scraping until the base is clean and free of residue that would compromise the bond of the new finish, ventilating the room while the work is done, removing the material in sacks and the final clean. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually taken up.
cadenas.Levantado de rodapié existente de madera: Taking up an existing wood baseboard, by hand with a crowbar and scraper, taking care not to damage the stucco to the wall. Includes extracting the nails, screws or plugs left in the wall, removing the material in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the area. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the length actually taken up.
cadenas.Levantamiento de instalaciones existente: Survey of existing services (electrical, plumbing). Includes inspection and recording. Measured per square meter surveyed.
cadenas.Levantamiento de la envolvente térmica d: Survey of the thermal envelope of the dwelling, with measurement of areas and construction.
cadenas.Levantamiento de medidas del inmueble ex: Measured survey of the existing building.
cadenas.Levantamiento de patologías de paramento: Survey of defects in wall and ceiling surfaces (damp, cracking, delamination). Includes inspection and recording. Measured per square meter inspected.
Condition survey of defects in wall and ceiling surfaces.
cadenas.Levantamiento en sitio de las medidas de: Measured survey on site of the existing building, taking the dimensions of rooms, clear heights, openings and the position of visible services and structural elements, in order to produce the as-built drawing on which the refurbishment is designed. Includes measuring with a laser distance meter and tape, checking squareness and plumb, a dimensioned sketch drawn on site, photographic recording of every room and noting any visible defects. Measured over the floor area of the building actually surveyed.
cadenas.Levantamiento topográfico interior de la: Interior topographic survey of the works. Includes measurement and recording of levels. Measured per square meter surveyed.
cadenas.Lijado y acabado con barniz de poliureta: Sanding and finishing of a new or existing wood floor with polyurethane varnish, in three coats with sanding between coats. On existing floors this operation fully restores the appearance of the wood and avoids replacing it. Includes punching down any nails that stand proud and filling the joints and cracks with filler to match, sanding in passes of decreasing grit with a belt sander and an edger at the perimeters and in the corners, thorough vacuuming between passes because any particle ends up trapped under the varnish, applying the coats of varnish with a light sanding between them, and respecting the drying times before walking on it. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
Sanding and varnishing of a wood floor.
cadenas.Limpieza de aparatos sanitarios y grifer: Cleaning of plumbing fixtures and faucets on completion of the works, with descaling and polishing.
Cleaning of plumbing fixtures and faucets.
cadenas.Limpieza de canal de drenaje exterior co: Cleaning of an external drainage channel with removal of silt and checking the flow. Includes cleaning.
cadenas.Limpieza de canalones y bajantes con ret: Cleaning of gutters and downpipes with removal of silt and checking the discharge. Includes cleaning and the report.
cadenas.Limpieza de cubierta con agua a presión: Cleaning of a roof with a pressure washer to remove dirt, mold and silt, before waterproofing or painting. Includes pressure washing.
cadenas.Limpieza de cubierta con retirada de hoj: Cleaning of a roof with removal of leaves and silt and inspection of the drains and finishings, with a condition report. Includes cleaning the gutters and drains.
Cleaning of loose debris from floors.
cadenas.Limpieza de fachada con agua a baja pres: Cleaning of a facade with low pressure water. Includes cleaning in bands. Measured per square meter cleaned.
cadenas.Limpieza de fachada con cepillado en sec: Cleaning of a facade by dry brushing. Includes cleaning the surface. Measured per square meter cleaned.
cadenas.Limpieza de fachada con hidrolavado a pr: Cleaning of a facade by pressure washing. Includes cleaning in bands and protecting the joinery. Measured per square meter cleaned.
cadenas.Limpieza de fachada con hidrolavadora de: Cleaning of a facade with a pressure washer to remove dirt, pollution and efflorescence without damaging the substrate. Includes protecting the joinery and the accesses and the cleaning in bands. Measured per square meter cleaned.
cadenas.Limpieza de fachada con proyección de ar: Cleaning of a facade by sand or abrasive blasting. Includes protecting the surroundings and cleaning. Measured per square meter cleaned.
Cleaning of a face brick facade.
cadenas.Limpieza de fachada de ladrillo visto. I: Cleaning of a face brick facade. Includes cleaning and treatment. Measured per square meter cleaned.
cadenas.Limpieza de fachada mediante hidrolavado: Cleaning of a facade by pressure washing at a pressure regulated to the type of substrate, removing dust, soot and surface deposits. The pressure has to be matched to the material: the pressure that cleans sound concrete strips an aged stucco or opens the joint of a face brick, so it is always tried first on an inconspicuous area before starting on the field. Includes protecting the joinery, the fittings and the footway at the foot of the facade, barring off, washing in panels from the top down, rinsing and collecting the run-off. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Limpieza de paramento de ladrillo visto,: Cleaning of an exposed brick substrate, with brushing and washing to remove dirt and efflorescence. Includes cleaning in strips. Measured per square meter cleaned.
Cleaning of an exposed brick surface.
cadenas.Limpieza de paramento interior con agua: Cleaning of an interior substrate with pressurized water to remove dirt and debris before the finish. Includes protecting the surroundings and cleaning in strips. Measured per square meter cleaned.
cadenas.Limpieza de pisos al final de la obra co: Machine scrubbing of floors on completion of the works, to leave the finish ready for handover.
cadenas.Limpieza de restos de mortero y adhesivo: Cleaning of mortar and adhesive residue from surfaces during the works, by scraping and removal.
Cleaning of mortar and adhesive residue.
cadenas.Limpieza de serpentines y filtros del si: Cleaning of the coils and filters of the HVAC system, to maintain performance.
cadenas.Limpieza de terreno con escombros de dem: Clearing of a site with demolition debris.
cadenas.Limpieza de terreno con maleza alta y ve: Clearing of a site with tall undergrowth and dense vegetation. Includes mechanical clearing. Measured per square meter cleared.
Clearing of a site with tall undergrowth.
cadenas.Limpieza de terreno con restos de demoli: Clearing of a site with demolition debris. Includes removal and stockpiling. Measured per square meter cleared.
cadenas.Limpieza de vidrios, carpintería y herra: Cleaning of glazing, joinery and hardware on completion of the works, with suitable products and leaving no residue.
cadenas.Limpieza de zonas de paso y accesos de l: Cleaning of the circulation areas and accesses of the site, to keep them clear and safe.
Cleaning of circulation areas and accesses.
cadenas.Limpieza del escombro disperso en pisos: Cleaning of loose debris from floors after demolition and masonry work, by sweeping and removal.
cadenas.Limpieza diaria de las zonas de trabajo: Daily cleaning of the work areas during the works, with removal of waste and sweeping, to keep the site tidy and safe.
cadenas.Limpieza final de la obra terminada, dej: Final clean of the completed works, leaving the building ready for handover. Includes removal of waste and protection, sweeping and vacuuming of all surfaces, cleaning of floors with the product suited to each material, cleaning of plumbing fixtures, faucets and joinery, removal of labels and adhesive from glazing and appliances, cleaning of switch plates and light fixtures, and a final pass over paint and mortar splashes. Measured by the area of the building actually cleaned.
Final clean of the works ahead of handover.
cadenas.Limpieza final de obra previa a la entre: Final clean of the works ahead of handover, with sweeping, removal of waste and cleaning of all surfaces.
cadenas.Limpieza periódica de la obra durante su: Periodic cleaning of the site during the works, with daily removal of waste, sweeping of the work faces and maintenance of the circulation routes. On an occupied site it is not optional: common areas and rooms in use must be left passable and clean at the end of each working day, and that time is real even though nobody prices it. Includes sweeping and collecting waste, removal of light debris to the storage point, cleaning of the circulation routes and checking of the protection at the end of the day. Measured by the area of the site over the period of the works.
cadenas.Limpieza profunda de vidrios y acabados: Deep cleaning of glazing and delicate finishes.
cadenas.Limpieza profunda de vidrios, espejos, a: Deep cleaning of glazing, mirrors, polished finishes and delicate surfaces on completion of the works. It requires the product and technique specific to each material: an acid descaler used on marble or on anodized aluminum stains it irreversibly, and that damage appears on the very day of handover. Includes removal of mortar, sealant and adhesive residue with a plastic scraper, cleaning with the product compatible with each material, drying without leaving marks and a final check. Measured by the area actually treated.
cadenas.Limpieza química de fachada de piedra na: Chemical cleaning of a natural stone facade. Includes applying the product and rinsing. Measured per square meter cleaned.
Chemical cleaning of a stone facade.
cadenas.Limpieza química de fachada para elimina: Chemical cleaning of a facade to remove efflorescence, rust staining, mortar residue, graffiti or ingrained deposits, with the product specific to each type of stain and each substrate. The choice of product is what decides it: an acid cleaner on marble, polished granite or anodized aluminum causes irreversible damage worse than the original stain, so it is always tried first in a hidden area. Includes identifying the type of stain, the prior trial, protecting the surroundings, application with its contact time, brushing, neutralizing and rinsing thoroughly. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Limpieza química de fachada y eliminació: Chemical cleaning of a facade and removal of stains.
cadenas.Limpieza química de paramento de piedra: Chemical cleaning of a natural stone substrate to remove stains, efflorescence and pollution. Includes applying the product, the brushing and the rinsing without damaging the stone. Measured per square meter cleaned.
Chemical cleaning of a stone surface.
cadenas.Limpieza semanal general de la obra, con: Weekly general cleaning of the site, with sweeping, removal of light debris and tidying of materials.
cadenas.Limpieza y abrillantado de piso de grani: Cleaning and buffing of a granite floor, with mechanical polishing and protection. Includes the cleaning, the polishing and the buffing. Measured per square meter polished.
Cleaning and buffing of a terrazzo floor.
cadenas.Limpieza y desbroce de terreno en pendie: Clearing and grubbing of sloping ground. Includes clearing by hand and by machine. Measured per square meter cleared.
cadenas.Limpieza y desbroce manual del terreno,: Manual clearing and grubbing of the site, with removal of undergrowth, grass, shrubs and accumulated rubbish, leaving the surface clear for setting out. It is used on small plots or where access is restricted and plant cannot get in. Includes cutting the vegetation with a brush cutter, hand grubbing out surface roots, collecting and bagging the waste, moving it to the stockpile and a final sweep of the surface. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the area actually cleared.
Manual clearing and grubbing of the site.
cadenas.Limpieza y desbroce mecanizado del terre: Mechanical clearing and grubbing of the site with a backhoe or skid steer loader, with removal of undergrowth, shrubs, roots and surface debris, leaving the surface clear and roughly leveled. It pays off against hand clearing from medium areas upwards and where plant can get in. Includes barring off the working area, mechanical sweeping of the surface, heaping the material removed at the stockpile and hand trimming of the edges and corners the machine cannot reach. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the area actually cleared.
Mechanical clearing and grubbing of the site.
cadenas.Limpieza y mantenimiento de climatizació: Cleaning and maintenance of the HVAC system.
cadenas.Limpieza y mantenimiento de cubierta, co: Cleaning and maintenance of a roof, with removal of leaves, silt and vegetation, clearing of gutters and drains and a review of the general condition. It is the most cost-effective preventive work there is in a building: most roof leaks are not caused by a failure of the waterproofing but by a blocked drain that makes the water back up. Includes sweeping and removing waste, cleaning the gutters and downpipes, checking the discharge with water, visual inspection of the junctions and penetrations and a report of the repairs found necessary. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting voids over 1 m².
Cleaning and maintenance of a roof.
cadenas.Limpieza y mantenimiento de drenaje exte: Cleaning and maintenance of exterior drainage.
cadenas.Limpieza y mantenimiento del sistema de: Cleaning and maintenance of the HVAC system, including cleaning of the filters and coils.
cadenas.Limpieza y puesta en marcha de piscina,: Cleaning and commissioning of a swimming pool, with filling, chemical balancing and starting up the filtration. Includes filling and balancing.
Cleaning and commissioning of a swimming pool.
Cleaning and preparation of the foundation bearing surface.
cadenas.Limpieza y saneo del fondo de fundación: Cleaning and preparation of the bottom of the footing excavation before the pour. Includes cleaning. Measured per square meter prepared.
cadenas.Limpieza y tratamiento del acero de refu: Cleaning and treatment of corroded reinforcement exposed after the concrete has been cut out, by brushing to a suitable standard of cleanliness and applying a passivating coating with inhibitor. It is the step that decides whether the repair lasts: if the mortar is reinstated over rusted steel, corrosion continues underneath and blows the cover again within a few years. Includes exposing the steel around its whole perimeter leaving a gap behind the bar, removing the rust with a wire brush and by grinding, assessing the loss of section and notifying the designer if it exceeds what is permissible, and applying two coats of passivator. Measured by the area of element actually treated.
cadenas.Localización de tuberías, canalizaciones: Locating buried pipes, electrical conduit and embedded reinforcement with an electronic detector, without breaking out the face, and marking the runs on the surface. This is the prior step that prevents cutting into a live service when cutting chases or drilling, and lets the new services be laid out around the existing ones. Includes systematically scanning the surface, marking the runs detected, noting the estimated depths and drawing up a sketch of what was found. Measured over the area actually scanned.
Lightweight slab with EPS void formers.
cadenas.Losa de concreto aligerada con casetones: Lightweight concrete slab with waffle pods.
cadenas.Losa de concreto con acero de temperatur: Concrete slab with shrinkage and temperature reinforcement.
cadenas.Losa de entrepiso con lámina colaborante: Intermediate floor slab of galvanized metal deck on structural steelwork, with shrinkage mesh and a concrete topping. The deck acts at once as permanent formwork and as the bottom reinforcement, which removes the need for formwork and shoring over most spans and speeds the work up considerably. Includes laying and fixing the deck to the beams, welding the shear studs that make the steel and the concrete act compositely, closing the edges, the mesh, pouring and screeding the concrete and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Losa de entrepiso o techo formada por vi: Intermediate floor or roof slab of precast prestressed joists, void formers, a structural topping and shrinkage mesh. Because the joist acts as a structural element during erection, far less shoring is needed than for a traditional ribbed slab, which speeds up the work. Includes setting out and placing the joists on their bearings with the minimum bearing length required, intermediate shoring, placing the blocks, the hogging reinforcement over the supports, the mesh to the topping, pouring and vibrating, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the area of slab actually constructed.
Foundation slab lightened with EPS void formers.
cadenas.Losa de fundación con aditivo impermeabi: Foundation slab with a waterproofing admixture.
Roof slab on joists and filler blocks.
Solid slab with welded wire mesh.
cadenas.Losa mixta con lámina colaborante sobre: Composite slab with metal decking on a steel frame.
Ribbed slab with clay filler blocks.
Ribbed slab with polystyrene filler blocks.
cadenas.Losa nervada con bloques de arcilla de a: Ribbed slab with clay filler blocks.
cadenas.Losa nervada con bloques de poliestireno: Ribbed slab with polystyrene filler blocks.
cadenas.Losa nervada de entrepiso o techo formad: Ribbed intermediate floor or roof slab of reinforced concrete ribs with clay void formers, with its structural topping and shrinkage mesh. Includes formwork and shoring to the soffit, placing the void formers leaving the rib width specified, reinforcing the ribs with their top and bottom steel, placing the welded wire mesh of the structural topping, pouring and vibrating the concrete, screeding, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the area of slab actually constructed.

Ribbed intermediate floor or roof slab of reinforced concrete ribs with expanded polystyrene void formers, with its structural topping and shrinkage mesh. Against the clay block it reduces the self weight of the slab considerably, which shows up in the sizing of the beams, columns and foundations, and improves the thermal insulation. Includes formwork and shoring, placing the formers, reinforcing the ribs, the mesh to the structural topping, pouring and vibrating, screeding, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the area of slab actually constructed.
Drip line for a planting bed.
Irrigation line for a vertical garden.
cadenas.Machón o columna de confinamiento de con: Reinforced concrete confining pier cast within the panel of masonry, which together with the ring beam forms the confined masonry system. Its function is to give the wall capacity against seismic action, so it is not optional in the panels the design defines as confined. Includes the reinforcement with its longitudinal bars and stirrups, tying the starter bars to the footing and to the beam above, toothing or placing connectors at the edge of the masonry to guarantee the bond, the formwork, pouring with 210 kg/cm² concrete, vibrating and stripping. Measured by the length actually constructed.
cadenas.Machón o columna de confinamiento en par: Pier or confining column in a block wall.
Screed rails for the falls of a roof deck.
cadenas.Malla captadora de cubierta para protecc: Roof air-termination network for lightning protection.
cadenas.Malla electrosoldada de refuerzo en losa: Welded wire mesh reinforcement in a slab.
Welded wire mesh in a slab.
Welded wire mesh in a wall.
Welded wire mesh for a slab.
cadenas.Mampara de baño con perfil de acero inox: Bathroom screen with a stainless steel profile.
Office partition with a fabric panel.
cadenas.Mampostería estructural con bloque canal: Structural masonry with a bond beam block.
cadenas.Mantenimiento del sistema fotovoltaico,: Maintenance of the photovoltaic system, including cleaning of the panels and checking of connections.
cadenas.Mantenimiento preventivo de equipo de cl: Preventive maintenance of a split type air conditioning unit, with cleaning of the filters and coils, inspection of the condensate drain and checking of the operating parameters. A blocked drain is the most common cause of the fault the user perceives as the unit leaking water, and dirt on the coil is what drives up electricity consumption without the unit cooling any better. Includes removing and washing the filters, chemical cleaning of the coils of both units, clearing and disinfecting the drain, checking the pressures and the power consumption, and the condition report. Measured per unit maintained.
cadenas.Mantenimiento y limpieza de equipo de cl: Maintenance and cleaning of HVAC equipment.
Wood frame for an interior door.
Metal frame and subframe for an opening.
cadenas.Marquesina traslúcida de policarbonato s: Translucent polycarbonate canopy on a lightweight metal structure, with a fall and a collection channel. Includes the structure, laying and the finishings.
cadenas.Media caña sanitaria en encuentro de par: Sanitary cove at the wall and floor junction.
cadenas.Medición de atmósfera en espacio confina: Atmospheric testing in a confined space.
Measurement of the thickness of the concrete cover.
cadenas.Medición de espesores de aislamiento exi: Measurement of the thickness of existing insulation.
Measurement of moisture in a floor.
cadenas.Medición de la atmósfera de espacio conf: Atmospheric testing of a confined space (oxygen, gases) with a detector before entry.
cadenas.Medición de la resistencia de puesta a t: Measurement of ground resistance with a ground resistance tester, to verify compliance with the value required by the standard.
cadenas.Medición de la temperatura de impulsión: Measurement of the supply and return air temperature of the HVAC system, to verify performance.
cadenas.Medición de la tensión y frecuencia de l: Measurement of the voltage and frequency of the electrical supply, to verify the quality of the service.
cadenas.Medición de las infiltraciones de aire d: Measurement of the air infiltration of the dwelling, to assess the airtightness of the envelope.
cadenas.Medición de los espesores de aislamiento: Measurement of the thickness of the existing insulation in the envelope with a detector.
cadenas.Medición del contenido de humedad de mur: Measurement of the moisture content of walls with a moisture meter, to diagnose water ingress or rising damp.
cadenas.Medición del contenido de humedad del pi: Measurement of the moisture content of a floor, to verify suitability before laying finishes.
cadenas.Medición del espesor de recubrimiento de: Measurement of the thickness of the concrete cover to reinforcement with a cover meter, with a report.
Improvement of a foundation with a geotextile.
cadenas.Mejoramiento de suelo con adición de cem: Soil improvement by the addition of cement and compaction. Includes mixing and compaction. Measured per cubic meter improved.
Polyurea membrane on a roof deck.
Bathroom countertop with an integrated lavatory.
Bathroom countertop on a vanity unit or frame.
cadenas.Mesón de granito, cuarzo o piedra natura: Countertop of granite, quartz or natural stone.
Laundry room countertop with a drainer.
cadenas.Montacargas o pluma de obra para bajada: Site hoist or crane for lowering material, per month.
cadenas.Montaje de andamio con barandilla de pro: Erection of a scaffold with a guardrail and toe board, for work at height.
cadenas.Montaje de andamio de fachada con malla: Erection of a facade scaffold with debris netting. Includes the scaffold and the netting. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Montaje de andamio de fachada con red de: Erection of a facade scaffold with safety netting. Includes the scaffold and the netting. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Montaje de cercha metálica prefabricada: Erection of a prefabricated metal roof truss, hoisted and fixed to its bearings. Includes setting out the bearings and fixing.
cadenas.Montaje de estantería metálica de almacé: Assembly of metal warehouse shelving, with the levels and fixing. Includes setting out and assembly.
Erection of a wood structure on site.
cadenas.Montaje de góndola o estantería comercia: Assembly of gondola shelving or shop shelving, with the levels and fixing. Includes setting out and assembly.
cadenas.Montaje de la caja de medidor y de la pr: Installation of the meter enclosure and the service protective device, with its base, the inlet and outlet conduits and sealing. Includes setting out at the position and height the supply company requires, a requirement without which the connection is not authorized, anchoring the enclosure, bringing in the conduits with their glands, fitting the main protection and preparing for inspection and sealing by the company. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Montaje de puerta provisional con cierre: Installation of a temporary lockable door at the entrance to the work area, to separate it from the area in use and control access. Includes the frame, the wood sheet facing, the hinges and the padlock hasp, the perimeter sealing strip that keeps dust out, the restricted access signage and dismantling on completion. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Montaje de taquilla o casillero de perso: Assembly of staff lockers, fixed. Includes assembly and fixing.
cadenas.Montaje del conjunto de regulación y med: Assembly of the pressure regulating and metering set of the gas installation, with its pressure regulator, main shut-off valve, gas meter and ventilated cabinet or recess. Includes the field layout in a ventilated and accessible position as required by the regulations and by the supply company, mounting the cabinet, installing the regulator and the main valve, the inlet and outlet connections, the tightness test of the assembly and preparing it for inspection and commissioning. Measured per set installed.
cadenas.Montaje del juego de accesorios de baño:: Fitting the set of bathroom accessories: towel rail, toilet paper holder, soap dish, hook and shelf, fixed to the tiling. Includes setting out the heights and positions for use, coordinated with the setting out of the tiling so as to drill at the center of the tile and not on the joint or near the edge, where the ceramic chips, drilling with a glass drill bit at low speed and without hammer action, inserting the plugs and fitting the accessories. The accessories are selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per set installed.
cadenas.Montaje y uso de andamio colgante o sill: Erection and use of a swing stage for work on a facade. Includes erection and operation. Measured per square meter of facade reached.
cadenas.Montaje y uso de andamio de borriquetas: Erection and use of a trestle scaffold for indoor work. Includes erection and operation. Measured per square meter of surface reached.
cadenas.Montaje y uso de andamio interior móvil: Erection and use of a mobile or trestle scaffold indoors. Includes erection and operation. Measured per square meter of surface reached.
cadenas.Montaje, alquiler y desmontaje de andami: Erection, hire and dismantling of a tubular facade scaffold with working platforms. Includes erection, hire and dismantling. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Montante o alimentación principal de agu: Riser or main water supply in 25 mm polypropylene PPR pipework, with heat fusion joints, supports and isolating valves. Includes setting out the route, looking for accessible runs wherever possible, cutting and fusion, placing the supports at the spacing that prevents sag and noise from thermal expansion, the penetrations through slab and wall with their sleeves, the pressure test for watertightness and making good. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Mortero impermeabilizante en área húmeda: Waterproofing mortar in wet areas, as a base for tiling.
cadenas.Motorización de persiana existente, con: Motorization of an existing roller shutter, with electrical connection and programming. The motor is selected by the client.
Motorization of an existing roller shutter.
cadenas.Movimiento interno de escombro a zona de: Internal movement of debris to the storage area.
cadenas.Movimiento interno de escombro desde el: Internal movement of debris from the point where it arises to the storage area, by hand or by wheelbarrow.
cadenas.Mueble bajo de cocina con fregadero inte: Base kitchen cabinet with an integrated sink.
Base kitchen cabinet with a sink.
Bathroom vanity unit with a lavatory.
Wall-hung bathroom vanity unit with a lavatory.
cadenas.Mueble de despensa con gavetas y entrepa: Pantry unit with drawers and shelves.
cadenas.Mueble de dormitorio a medida (gavetero): Custom bedroom unit, such as a chest of drawers.
Furniture for a common area, such as a lobby.
Fixed furniture with shelves and doors.
Laundry room unit with a sink.
cadenas.Muro de cerramiento con acabado de friso: Boundary wall with a stuccoed finish.
Retaining wall with an exposed finish.
cadenas.Muro de contención con junta de dilataci: Retaining wall with an expansion joint.
cadenas.Módulo de actuación on/off para circuito: On/off actuator module for lighting circuits.
cadenas.Módulo de control de persiana o cortina: Control module for a motorized blind or curtain.
cadenas.Módulo de enchufe inteligente para carga: Smart plug module for plug-in loads.
cadenas.Neutralización y limpieza de derrame men: Neutralization and clean-up of a minor spill of a chemical substance, with absorbent material and disposal of the waste.
Neutralization and clean-up of a minor spill.
cadenas.Nivelación con mortero autonivelante de: Leveling with self-leveling mortar, 5 mm average thickness.
Leveling of a surface with a laser level.
cadenas.Nivelación puntual de paramento con past: Localized leveling of a substrate with leveling compound to smooth irregular areas prior to the finish. Includes applying the filler and sanding. Measured per square meter leveled.
Localized leveling of a surface with compound.
cadenas.Nivelación y compactación de fondo de fu: Leveling and compaction of the foundation bearing surface.
cadenas.Nivelación y compactación de la superfic: Leveling and compaction of the surface of the ground after clearing or filling, leaving it at the level and fall of the design and with the density needed to receive the next layer. Includes going over the surface, cutting off the high spots and making up the low ones, moisture conditioning to optimum moisture content, compaction with a plate compactor in crossed passes and checking levels and falls with a laser level. Measured by the area actually leveled and compacted.
Leveling and compaction of the subgrade.
Leveling and compaction of the subgrade. Includes leveling and compaction. Measured per square meter constructed.
Leveling and compaction of the ground.
cadenas.Nivelación y compactación del fondo de f: Leveling and compaction of the bottom of the footing excavation. Includes leveling and compaction. Measured per square meter constructed.
cadenas.Nivelación y preparación de terreno para: Leveling and preparation of the ground for a garden, with clearing, filling and raking. Includes clearing and leveling.
Leveling and preparation of the ground for a garden.
cadenas.Nivelación y remate de umbral entre ambi: Leveling and finishing of a threshold between rooms.
Cork board or whiteboard for an office.
cadenas.Panel táctil de pared para el sistema do: Wall-mounted touch panel for the home automation system.
cadenas.Pararrayos con dispositivo de cebado sob: Early streamer emission air terminal on a mast on the roof.
cadenas.Pararrayos tipo Franklin de punta simple: Franklin lightning rod, single point, on a support.
cadenas.Pared de 12 cm de espesor con bloque hue: Wall 12 cm thick built of 12x20x40 cm hollow concrete blocks bedded in mortar, laid in stretcher bond with flush joints. It is the intermediate thickness most used in internal divisions in dwellings where a 10 cm partition is not enough in height or in acoustic requirement and a 15 cm one takes up too much usable space. Includes setting out, wetting the units, laying the courses level and plumb, forming openings, tying to the structure and clearing away. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Pared de 15 cm de espesor ejecutada con: Wall 15 cm thick built of 15x20x30 cm hollow clay blocks bedded in mortar, laid in stretcher bond with flush joints. Includes setting out, wetting the units beforehand, laying the courses level and plumb, forming openings, tying to the structure with connectors and clearing away waste. It does not include the stucco or the lintels. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².

Wall 15 cm thick built of 15x20x40 cm hollow concrete blocks bedded in mortar, laid in stretcher bond with 1 cm flush joints. It is used for dividing walls with a higher acoustic requirement and for single leaf facade enclosures. Includes setting out and marking the line on the floor, wetting the units beforehand, laying the courses level and plumb using straightedges and a line, forming openings, tying to the existing walls and structure with connectors, and clearing away waste. It does not include the stucco or the lintels. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Pared de 20 cm de espesor ejecutada con: Wall 20 cm thick built of 20x20x40 cm hollow concrete blocks bedded in mortar, laid in stretcher bond with flush joints. It is used for facade enclosures, boundary walls and any panel that has to provide mass for acoustic or security reasons. Includes setting out, wetting the units, laying the courses level and plumb, forming openings, tying to the structure with connectors and clearing away. It does not include the stucco or the lintels. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Pared de bloque de concreto ejecutada co: Concrete block wall built with an exposed finish, without stuccoing afterwards, with the units selected beforehand and the joint tooled and recessed. With no stucco to cover the defects, the work demands careful bonding, exact plumb and level and continuous cleaning of the face, which reduces output appreciably against a wall intended to be stuccoed. Includes selecting and rejecting defective or chipped units, setting out the bond to avoid cuts in visible areas, laying with a constant joint, tooling and recessing the joint while the mortar is still fresh and cleaning off the fins immediately. It does not include the final water repellent treatment. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Pared de ladrillo de arcilla ejecutada c: Clay brick wall built with an exposed finish, with the units selected, the bond set out and the joint tooled and recessed. It is the lowest output masonry work in the catalog: with no stucco afterwards to correct anything, every unit and every joint is on show. Includes selecting and rejecting chipped units or those off in tone, setting out the bond to resolve the junctions and the openings without cut units on show, wetting, laying with a constant joint controlled with a gauge rod, tooling the joint and cleaning off the fins immediately before they set. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Pared divisoria de 10 cm de espesor ejec: Dividing wall 10 cm thick built of 10x20x30 cm hollow clay blocks bedded in mortar, laid in stretcher bond with flush joints. The clay block is lighter than the concrete one and gives better thermal performance, although lower mechanical strength, so it is reserved for dividing panels with no structural function. Includes setting out, wetting the units beforehand, laying the courses level and plumb, forming openings, tying to the existing walls and clearing away. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Pared ejecutada con ladrillo macizo de a: Wall built of fired solid clay bricks bedded in mortar, laid in stretcher bond with flush joints. The small size of the unit multiplies the number of units per square meter and makes this the lowest output masonry, although it provides the greatest mass and strength. Includes setting out, wetting the units beforehand, which with clay brick is decisive because it draws water out of the mortar and prevents it setting, laying the courses level and plumb in bond, forming openings and clearing away. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Pared portante de mampostería estructura: Loadbearing wall of structural masonry with concrete blocks of certified strength 15x20x40 cm, with bedding mortar of controlled strength, horizontal joint reinforcement and vertical cells filled with flowable concrete at the positions specified. Unlike confined masonry, here the wall is the structural element and not an infill between frames, so the strength of the block, the mix of the mortar and the effective filling of the cells cease to be matters of workmanship and become verifiable requirements. Includes setting out, wetting, laying the courses level and plumb in bond, the horizontal ladder reinforcement, placing the vertical steel, cleaning the bottom of the cells before filling and pouring the flowable concrete with vibration. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².

Loadbearing wall of structural masonry with concrete blocks of certified strength 20x20x40 cm, with horizontal reinforcement, vertical steel and the cells filled with flowable concrete. Includes setting out and checking the modular coordination, which in structural masonry has to be respected because cutting blocks breaks the continuity of the cells and leaves the vertical steel with nowhere to go, wetting, laying the courses level and plumb, the ladder reinforcement, the vertical steel with its laps, cleaning the cells and pouring and vibrating the fill. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
cadenas.Pasamanos de acero para escalera exterio: Steel handrail for an exterior stair.
cadenas.Pasamanos de madera para escalera con so: Wood stair handrail on metal brackets.
cadenas.Pasamanos de madera sobre baranda o pare: Wood handrail on a guardrail or wall.
Services penetration through a roof deck.
Penetration for a duct in a slab.
Penetration for pipework through a wall, sealed.
Paver paving restrained with an edge.
cadenas.Pavimento exterior de adoquín de concret: External paving of concrete pavers on a sand bed and compacted base, with edge restraint and the joints filled with sand. The edge restraint is what keeps the paving interlocked: without a curb to contain it the pavers at the edge move out and the whole area loses its interlock. Includes spreading and screeding the laying course, laying the pavers to the bond, cutting the closing units, compacting with a plate and brushing and vibrating sand into the joints. Measured by the area actually constructed.
External paving of concrete pavers on a sand bed and compacted base, with edge restraint. Includes laying, cutting and compaction.
cadenas.Pavimento exterior de baldosa cerámica a: External non-slip ceramic tile paving on a bedding mortar, with the joints sealed. Includes laying and grouting. The tile is selected by the client.
cadenas.Pavimento exterior de concreto alisado c: External concrete paving power troweled to a smooth finish, for pedestrian and vehicular traffic. Includes pouring and troweling.
cadenas.Pavimento exterior de concreto con acaba: External concrete paving with a non-slip broom finish, on a compacted base, with shrinkage joints. Includes pouring, finishing and the joints.
cadenas.Pavimento exterior de concreto estampado: External stamped concrete paving using mats and a colored release agent, sealed. Includes pouring, stamping and sealing.
cadenas.Pavimento exterior de gravilla o piedra: External gravel or decorative stone surface on a geotextile and compacted base, with edge restraint. The separating geotextile is what stops the gravel sinking into the ground and vegetation growing up through it, the two reasons this surface breaks down. Includes leveling and compacting the base, laying the geotextile with laps, spreading the gravel to the uniform thickness specified and the final raking. Measured by the area actually constructed.
External loose gravel or stone surface on a leveled base, with a separating geotextile. Includes spreading and leveling.
cadenas.Pavimento exterior de lajas de piedra so: External stone flag paving on a mortar bed, with the joints filled. Includes laying and pointing. The stone is selected by the client.
cadenas.Paño de bloque de vidrio recibido con mo: Panel of glass blocks bedded in mortar, with plastic spacers that keep the joint constant and bar reinforcement in the horizontal and vertical joints. It brings in natural light while keeping privacy, and is usual in bathrooms and internal divisions. It requires a panel with all four edges restrained and with a perimeter expansion joint, since glass does not accept deformation of its surroundings. Includes setting out the layout, which must be resolved in whole units because the block cannot be cut, laying with spacers, reinforcing the joints with bar, pointing and the final cleaning of the faces. Measured overall, deducting voids over 2 m².
Fixed pane of tempered glass on a facade.
cadenas.Pedestal de concreto armado de resistenc: Reinforced concrete pedestal of 210 kg/cm² strength rising from the footing and taking the bearing of the column up to the commencing level, including its formwork, pouring and curing. Includes setting out on the footing, erecting and plumbing the formwork with bracing on all four faces, checking that the starter bars are in position and have the lap length specified, pouring and vibrating in layers, stripping and curing. It does not include the reinforcement, which is priced by weight. Measured by the theoretical volume to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Pedestal de concreto armado sobre fundac: Reinforced concrete pedestal on a foundation.
cadenas.Peldaño de madera sobre escalera de conc: Wood tread on a concrete stair.
Reflective film on a roof deck.
cadenas.Pendientado de cubierta con concreto lig: Sloping fill to a roof deck with lightweight concrete.
cadenas.Pendientado de cubierta con mortero alig: Sloping fill to a roof deck with lightweight mortar.
cadenas.Pendientado de cubierta plana con morter: Sloping fill to a flat roof with lightweight mortar.
cadenas.Perfil de cierre entre cielos de distint: Closing trim between ceilings at different levels.
cadenas.Perfil de remate perimetral entre cielo: Perimeter trim between a ceiling and a wall.
cadenas.Perfil de remate, esquinero o transición: Finishing, corner or transition profile in tiling.
cadenas.Perfilado y compactación del fondo de ex: Trimming and compaction of the bottom of an excavation.
cadenas.Perfilado y limpieza de fondo de excavac: Trimming and cleaning of the bottom of an excavation.
cadenas.Perfilado y limpieza manual del fondo de: Hand trimming and cleaning of the bottom of an excavation. Includes cleaning and trimming. Measured per square meter trimmed.
cadenas.Perfilado, refine y compactación del fon: Trimming, fine grading and compaction of the bottom of the excavation, leaving it at the exact level, flat and with the density required to receive the foundation or the base of the paving. Includes removal of loose and disturbed material from the bottom, hand trimming to the design level, moisture conditioning of the ground to optimum moisture content and compaction with a plate compactor or rammer depending on the width available. Measured by the area of the bottom actually trimmed.
cadenas.Perforación de hueco para caja de mecani: Cutting an opening for a back box. Includes drilling. Measured per unit constructed.
Cutting of a recess for a box.
Drilling of a small penetration in a wall.
cadenas.Perforación de mechinal o hueco de venti: Forming a weep hole or ventilation opening in a wall. Includes drilling. Measured per unit constructed.
cadenas.Perforación de mesón de piedra o cuarzo: Drilling a stone or quartz countertop for the faucet or sink, with a diamond core bit and water cooling. Includes setting out and cutting.
cadenas.Perforación de mesón para grifería o fre: Cutting of a countertop for a faucet or sink.
cadenas.Perforación de paso en losa para instala: Drilling a penetration through a slab for services. Includes drilling. Measured per unit constructed.
Drilling of a penetration in a slab.
cadenas.Perforación de paso en muro para instala: Drilling a penetration through a wall for services. Includes drilling. Measured per unit constructed.
Drilling of a penetration in a wall.
cadenas.Perforación para anclaje en concreto o m: Drilling for an anchor in concrete or masonry. Includes drilling. Measured per unit constructed.
cadenas.Perforación para pilote vaciado en sitio: Drilling for a cast-in-place pile. Includes drilling. Measured per meter drilled.
cadenas.Perforación rotatoria para pilote vaciad: Rotary drilling for a cast-in-place pile, in ground of medium consistency, with the drilling rig and its operator. Includes moving and positioning the rig, setting out and centring on the axis of the pile, drilling to the design level with the verticality controlled, removing and stockpiling the spoil, cleaning the bottom of the bore before the cage is inserted and protecting or temporarily casing the mouth to prevent collapse. Measured by the length actually drilled.
cadenas.Permanencia adicional de andamio de fach: Additional month of hire of a facade scaffold.
cadenas.Permanencia de andamio tubular de fachad: Hire of a tubular facade scaffold beyond the first month already included in the erection item, with the periodic inspections that keeping it in service requires. Includes the monthly inspection of bearings, ties, platforms and collective protective measures, retightening of the couplings, replacement of damaged components and recording of the inspections. Measured by the area of scaffold for each additional month on hire.
Insulated roller shutter with a sealed box.
cadenas.Persiana enrollable de aluminio para con: Aluminum roller shutter for solar control.
Chipping off ceramic cladding from a facade.
cadenas.Picado de aplacado cerámico o porcelánic: Chipping off ceramic or porcelain cladding from a facade, removing the bedding mortar. Includes chipping off the units and cleaning the substrate. Measured per square meter chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de enchapado cerámico en pared y: Chipping off ceramic wall tiling and its adhesive bed.
cadenas.Picado de enchapado cerámico o de porcel: Chipping off existing ceramic or porcelain wall tiling, including its bedding mortar, with a hand held electric breaker, down to the stucco or the block, without compromising the stability of the wall or damaging the concealed pipes and conduits. Includes locating the services running in the wall beforehand, protecting floors, fittings and doors, dust control by vacuum, removing the debris by hand in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the surface, leaving it ready to receive the new stucco. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de enchapado de granito o terrazo: Chipping off terrazzo or granite wall cladding.

Chipping off existing precast granite or terrazzo wall cladding, including its bedding mortar, with a hand held electric breaker. Because these units are thicker and heavier than ceramic tiling, output is lower and the debris heavier. Includes protecting floors and adjoining rooms, dust control, removing the debris by hand in sacks to the stockpile and hacking off the mortar remaining bonded to the wall. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de enchapado de piedra natural en: Chipping off natural stone wall cladding.
cadenas.Picado de enchapado de piedra natural ex: Chipping off existing natural stone wall cladding, whether marble, flagstone or facing stone, including its bedding and the metal anchors where present, with a hand held electric breaker. Where the client wishes to recover the units they are taken down one by one with care, cleaned and stored protected, which reduces output and should be noted in the price. Includes protecting the surroundings, dust control, removing the debris in sacks and hacking off the material remaining bonded. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de estuco o pasta decorativa en p: Chipping off stucco or a decorative compound from a surface.
Chipping off stucco from a facade.
cadenas.Picado de friso de mortero de cemento ex: Chipping off an existing cement stucco from an internal or external wall, with a hand held electric breaker, down to the block or the brick, where the stucco is friable, hollow or generally cracked. Includes sounding beforehand by tapping to define the areas that have lost adhesion, protecting floors and adjoining rooms, dust control by vacuum, removing the debris by hand in sacks to the stockpile and sweeping and cleaning the face, leaving it ready to receive the new stucco. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de friso de mortero en fachada, c: Chipping off a cement stucco from a facade, removing the finish. Includes chipping off the stucco and cleaning the substrate. Measured per square meter chipped off.
Chipping off cement stucco from a surface.
cadenas.Picado de friso de mortero o de pasta en: Chipping off a mortar or filler finish from a ceiling or the soffit of a slab, by hand and with an electric breaker working overhead. The working position reduces output considerably against the same chipping on a wall, and the material falls directly onto the operative and onto the floor, which makes face protection necessary and requires the whole room to be covered. Includes fully protecting the room, sounding by tapping, chipping in sections, dust control, removing the debris and cleaning up. It does not include disposal of the debris. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Picado de friso de yeso o pasta en param: Chipping off gypsum plaster or compound from a surface.
cadenas.Picado de friso en techo o cara inferior: Chipping off stucco from a soffit or the underside of a slab.
Chipping off a single-coat stucco from a facade.
cadenas.Picado de revestimiento de estuco, pasta: Chipping off an existing stucco, decorative paste or textured finish from a wall, by hand and with an electric breaker according to the thickness and the hardness of the material, until the substrate is clean and ready to receive the new finish. Includes a trial patch beforehand to identify the thickness and the type of substrate, protecting the surroundings, dust control, removing the debris in sacks and the final clean. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de revestimiento de mortero monoc: Chipping off a single coat stucco from a facade, including its reinforcing mesh and the stop and drip beads, with a hand held electric breaker, down to a clean substrate ready to receive the new finish. Includes sounding the face beforehand, working from scaffold with the corresponding collective protective measures, protecting the joinery and the walkway at the foot of the facade, cutting out and removing the mesh, controlling the fall of debris, removing it in sacks and cleaning the substrate. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de revestimiento de salpicado, gr: Chipping off a spatterdash, graniplast or sprayed stone finish from a facade, with a hand held electric breaker and a scraper, down to sound backing stucco or to the block according to the condition of the substrate. Includes sounding beforehand by tapping to define the areas that have lost adhesion, working from scaffold with the corresponding collective protective measures, protecting the joinery and the walkway at the foot of the facade, controlling the fall of debris, removing it in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the face. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de revestimiento de yeso o pasta: Chipping off an existing plaster or filler finish from an internal wall, by hand with a broad scraper and a chisel, with an electric breaker only where the thickness requires it. Being a soft material the output is appreciably higher than for a cement stucco, although it produces a great deal of fine dust. Includes protecting the surroundings, dust control by continuous vacuum, removing the debris in sacks to the stockpile and cleaning the resulting face. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually chipped off.
cadenas.Picado de salpicado o graniplast en fach: Chipping off a textured stucco from a facade.
cadenas.Picado y limpieza de paramento deteriora: Hacking off and cleaning of a deteriorated substrate, removing the loose covering prior to repair. Includes removing the loose material and cleaning the surface. Measured per square meter hacked off.
Chipping out and cleaning a deteriorated surface.
cadenas.Pintado de cancha deportiva con demarcac: Painting of a sports court with line markings and traffic paint. Includes cleaning and application.
cadenas.Pintado de demarcación de cancha deporti: Painting of sports court line markings with traffic paint. Includes setting out and application.
cadenas.Pintado de demarcación de puestos de est: Painting of parking bay markings with traffic paint. Includes setting out and application.
cadenas.Pintado de demarcación de zona de seguri: Painting of safety zone markings with traffic paint and stencils. Includes cleaning and application.
cadenas.Pintado de demarcación y señalización en: Painting of floor marking and signage with traffic paint, using stencils and masking. Includes cleaning and application.
cadenas.Pintura a dos colores con guarda de sepa: Two-color painting with a dividing border.
Washable acrylic paint in a kitchen.
cadenas.Pintura anticorrosiva sobre estructura m: Anti-corrosion paint on a steel structure.
Anti-mold paint for kitchens and bathrooms.
cadenas.Pintura de caucho exterior sobre friso n: Exterior latex paint on new stucco, three coats.
cadenas.Pintura de caucho mate lavable en parame: Washable matte latex paint on interior surfaces, two coats.
cadenas.Pintura de caucho satinada lavable en in: Washable satin latex paint indoors, two coats.
cadenas.Pintura de caucho sobre friso nuevo, tre: Emulsion paint on new plaster, three coats.
Paint on an exposed concrete soffit.
cadenas.Pintura de cornisa, alero y remates de f: Painting of the cornice, eaves and facade trims.
Painting of an exterior roof or deck.
cadenas.Pintura de demarcación de pisos industri: Line marking paint for industrial floors.
Painting of an interior steel structure.
Facade paint with a matte finish.
cadenas.Pintura de fachada con acabado satinado,: Facade paint with a satin finish, two coats.
cadenas.Pintura de fachada con acabado texturado: Facade paint with a textured finish.
cadenas.Pintura de fachada con esquema de manten: Facade painting under a maintenance program.
cadenas.Pintura de fachada con hidrofugante prev: Facade painting with a prior water-repellent treatment.
cadenas.Pintura de fachada con puente de adheren: Facade painting with a bonding agent.
cadenas.Pintura de fachada de bloque de concreto: Facade painting on a concrete block wall.
cadenas.Pintura de franja inferior o rodapié pin: Painting of a lower band or painted baseboard on an internal substrate, with two coats of washable paint. Includes masking the top line and the two finish coats. Measured per meter of band painted.
Painting of the lower band or baseboard.
cadenas.Pintura de guarda o friso decorativo int: Painting of a decorative border or dado indoors.
Painting of reveals and opening finishes.
cadenas.Pintura de mocheta, arista y remate inte: Painting of the reveal, arris and internal trim of door and window openings, with two coats of enamel paint or latex paint. Includes protecting the adjacent surfaces and the two finish coats. Measured per meter of reveal painted.
cadenas.Pintura de mueble de cocina con laca, co: Painting of kitchen cabinets with lacquer, with the preparation and two coats. Includes preparation of the surface, the primer and the two coats of lacquer. Measured per square meter painted.
Painting of a lacquered kitchen unit.
cadenas.Pintura de muro de cerramiento o pared m: Painting of a boundary wall or party wall.
Painting of an exterior retaining wall.
cadenas.Pintura de paramento con acabado perlado: Paint on a surface with a pearl finish.
cadenas.Pintura de paramento de cocina con esmal: Washable enamel paint on kitchen surfaces.
cadenas.Pintura de portón o puerta metálica exte: Painting of an exterior metal gate or door.
cadenas.Pintura de protección de estructura de t: Protective paint on a roof structure.
cadenas.Pintura de puerta de madera con desmonta: Painting of a wood door with the hardware removed.
cadenas.Pintura de reja, verja o elemento metáli: Painting of an exterior grille, railing or metal element.
Painting of a basement or interior garage.
Ceiling painting with an extension roller.
Painting of high ceilings from scaffolding.
cadenas.Pintura de tuberías y conducciones metál: Painting of metal pipes and ductwork.
cadenas.Pintura de una puerta de madera con desm: Painting of a wood door with removal and refitting of the hardware, with a primer and two coats of enamel paint. Includes the removal of the hardware, the preparation, the painting of both faces and the refitting. Measured per door leaf painted.
cadenas.Pintura elastomérica impermeabilizante d: Elastomeric waterproof coating on a facade.
cadenas.Pintura epóxica sobre paramento vertical: Epoxy paint on a vertical surface.
Epoxy paint on a floor or surface.
cadenas.Pintura impermeabilizante de cubierta me: Waterproofing paint on a metal roof.
Magnetic paint as a wall base coat.
cadenas.Pintura semibrillo lavable de alto tráns: Washable semi-gloss paint for high-traffic areas.
cadenas.Pintura sobre concreto visto o superfici: Paint on exposed concrete or a mineral surface.
cadenas.Pintura sobre superficie galvanizada o d: Paint on a galvanized or aluminum surface.
cadenas.Piso cerámico colocado en capa gruesa so: Ceramic tile flooring laid thick-bed on mortar.
Ceramic tile flooring with a border.
cadenas.Piso cerámico en terraza o área exterior: Ceramic tile flooring on a terrace or outdoor area.
cadenas.Piso cerámico en área húmeda con pendien: Ceramic tile flooring in a wet area, laid to fall to the drain.
cadenas.Piso cerámico o porcelanato de formato e: Ceramic or porcelain tile flooring, standard format, thin-set.
cadenas.Piso continuo de cemento con acabado pul: Continuous cement floor with a hand troweled finish, over a mortar bed or a slab, with control joints. It is the traditional finish for service areas, garages and patios: more economical than power troweling and perfectly valid on small surfaces where bringing in a power trowel is not worth it. Includes pouring and ruling off, dusting with cement, troweling in successive passes as the mortar loses water, marking the joints and curing. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Piso continuo de concreto con acabado al: Continuous concrete floor with a mechanically power troweled finish, with sawn control joints and curing. Includes pouring and ruling off the concrete, the initial floating, the power troweling in as many passes as needed to obtain the texture and the closing of the pore required, sawing the control joints at the moment when the concrete will take it without spalling or cracking, and curing, which on a power troweled floor is decisive because all the surface quality is lost if the mix water evaporates too quickly. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Piso continuo de granito vaciado en siti: Continuous cast in place terrazzo floor, formed by a layer of mortar with marble aggregate, divided into bays by divider strips, with the final grinding and buffing. It is a traditional floor widely used in Venezuela, very durable and with no joints between slabs, and its result depends on the homogeneity of the mix and on how the grinding is carried out. Includes preparing the substrate, setting out and placing the divider strips that absorb the shrinkage and define the bays, pouring and ruling off the aggregate layer, curing, grinding in passes of decreasing grit with water, filling the pores and the final buffing. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Piso continuo de gravilla lavada o chino: Continuous exposed aggregate floor, formed by a layer of mortar with a selected aggregate that is exposed by washing the surface before it has fully set. It is a traditional finish, highly slip resistant and for that reason usual on walkways, ramps, terraces and pool surrounds. The whole result depends on the moment of washing: done too early it drags the aggregate and too late it does not expose it. Includes pouring and ruling off, seeding or mixing in the aggregate, the controlled wait, washing with gentle pressurized water, the final cleaning and curing. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Piso continuo de resina epóxica autonive: Continuous self-leveling epoxy resin floor, with a primer and a finishing coat, for industrial areas, kitchens, laboratories and parking areas. It offers a joint free, watertight surface resistant to chemicals. It demands a substrate with moisture below the manufacturer's limit: applied over damp concrete, the vapor pressure lifts the resin off in flakes. Includes shot blasting or sanding the substrate to open the pore, measuring the moisture, priming, sealing the cracks and joints, applying the self-leveling coat and de-aerating it with a spiked roller, and respecting the curing times before putting it into service. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Piso de alfombra o moqueta, encolado o t: Carpet flooring, glue-down or stretched in.
cadenas.Piso de caucho o grama sintética para ex: Rubber or artificial grass surfacing for outdoors.
cadenas.Piso de concreto con acabado estampado m: Concrete floor with a stamped finish by means of textured mats and a pigmented release agent, with a final sealing. It is used on entrances, patios and exterior areas where the look of stone or pavers is wanted with the continuity of a concrete floor. Includes pouring and ruling off, applying the powdered color hardener, dusting on the pigmented release agent, stamping with the mats at the exact point of set, a narrow window of time on which the whole result depends, sawing the joints, washing off the excess release agent and applying the coats of sealer. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Piso de concreto exterior con acabado es: Exterior concrete floor with a broom finish.
cadenas.Piso de concreto exterior de 10 cm de es: External concrete slab 10 cm thick on a compacted base, with shrinkage reinforcement, control joints and a non-slip broom finish. The brooming is carried out across the direction of travel and at just the right point of set, because done too soon the texture closes up and too late it leaves no mark. Includes checking the base, placing the mesh on chairs, pouring and vibrating, screeding to the drainage falls, brooming, saw cutting the joints and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Piso de deck de madera o madera técnica: Timber or composite decking for outdoors.
cadenas.Piso de deck para exterior con tablas de: Exterior deck floor with treated or engineered wood boards, mounted on battens with a gap between boards for drainage and ventilation. The gap between boards and the ventilation underneath are not aesthetic: they are what allows the water to drain away and the wood to dry out, preventing rot. Includes setting out and leveling the battens with a drainage fall, applying the preservative to the cuts and to the end grain, fixing the boards with a hidden clip or stainless steel screws, keeping a constant gap with a spacer and the perimeter trim. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
Flagstone or irregular natural stone flooring.
cadenas.Piso de madera maciza clavada sobre rast: Solid wood flooring nailed to battens.
Parquet flooring bonded to the leveling bed.
Natural stone flooring with a minimal joint.
cadenas.Piso de tabla de madera maciza clavada s: Solid wood board floor nailed to battens fixed to the mortar bed, with a ventilated cavity. It is the traditional solution and the most durable, since solid wood takes several sandings over its life. Includes applying the preservative to the battens and to the underside of the board, setting out and leveling the battens, ventilating the cavity through perimeter grilles, secret nailing the board, the perimeter expansion gap and the trim. The final sanding and varnishing are not included and are priced separately. The wood is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Piso flotante sobre pedestales en cubier: Pedestal-mounted paving on a roof deck.
cadenas.Piso laminado flotante con manta acústic: Floating laminate flooring with acoustic underlay.
cadenas.Piso técnico exterior formado por loseta: External paving on adjustable pedestals laid over the roof waterproofing, without adhesive or fixing through it. It has a double advantage: it levels the finished surface over a sloped base and it leaves the waterproofing accessible, since lifting the slabs is enough to inspect or repair it. Includes setting out the grid, placing the protective pads on the membrane, assembling and adjusting the pedestals, laying the slabs and fitting the perimeter pieces. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Placa base con pernos de anclaje para co: Base plate with anchor bolts for a steel column.
Base plate with bolts for a column.
cadenas.Placa base de acero con sus pernos de an: Steel base plate with its anchor bolts, gussets and leveling on non-shrink grout, to carry a steel column on a concrete footing. Includes the precise setting out of the position of the bolts, the critical operation of the whole assembly because an error here means cutting out and redoing anchors in hardened concrete, placing the bolt template before the footing is poured or chemically anchoring afterwards, leveling the plate on wedges or leveling nuts, filling the space beneath the plate with fluid non-shrink grout, tightening the nuts to the specified torque and protecting the assembly. Measured per unit actually constructed.
cadenas.Plan de seguridad y documentación de obr: Site health and safety plan and documentation.
Health and safety plan for the works.
cadenas.Plantación de vegetación trepadora para: Planting of climbing plants to shade the facade, reducing heat gain. The plants are selected by the client.
cadenas.Poda y mantenimiento de áreas verdes con: Pruning and maintenance of planted areas with removal of green waste. Includes pruning and clearing.
Pruning and maintenance of planted areas.
cadenas.Portero eléctrico o videoportero de acce: Door entry intercom or video intercom at an access.
Pedestrian gate in a boundary wall.
cadenas.Portón batiente de dos hojas con automat: Two-leaf swinging gate with an operator.
cadenas.Portón corredizo de acero con hoja ciega: Sliding steel gate with a solid leaf.
Metal garage gate with a frame.
Exterior drainage pit or catch basin.
cadenas.Preparación completa de paramento interi: Complete preparation of an interior substrate before painting. Includes protecting floors, joinery and furniture with plastic sheeting and masking tape, removing loose material, patching cracks and holes with repair filler, smoothing and sanding until an even surface is obtained, removing the residual dust and applying one coat of stabilizing primer to consolidate the substrate and even out its absorption. Leaves the substrate ready to receive the finish. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Preparación de fachada o paramento exter: Preparation of a facade or exterior substrate before painting, with pressure washing, removal of loose material, treatment of mold and the application of a stabilizing primer. Outdoors, the preparation matters more than the paint: applied over a surface with mold or with stucco that has broken down, the best paint comes off within a single rainy season. Includes washing with a pressure washer, scraping the areas that have come away, applying a fungicidal solution to the mold patches with its dwell time and rinsing, patching the cracks and the stabilizing primer. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Preparación de la superficie y aplicació: Preparation of the surface and application of two coats of anti-corrosion primer to structural steelwork. The durability of the coating depends far more on the preparation than on the quality of the paint, so the degree of cleanliness achieved is what decides it. Includes removing rust, mill scale, grease and slag residue with a wire brush and by grinding, degreasing, applying the first coat over the arrises, edges and awkward areas, which are the first to fail, respecting the recoat time and applying the second coat. Measured by the area actually treated, taking every face of the section.
cadenas.Preparación de losa o piso existente que: Preparation of an existing slab or floor that is to remain as the base, by cleaning, making good and applying a bonding coat, to receive a fill layer or an adhered floor. It is used in refurbishment where the base is not demolished and the new layer has to be guaranteed not to come away. Includes sounding by tapping and making good the hollow areas, degreasing and removing the remains of adhesives or paints, vacuuming up the dust, opening up the pore by sanding or light hacking, and applying the bonding coat respecting the open time before receiving the next layer. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Preparación de paramento exterior para p: Preparation of exterior surfaces for painting.
cadenas.Preparación de paramento interior para p: Preparation of interior surfaces for painting: patching, smoothing and undercoat.
cadenas.Preparación de piso existente para la co: Preparation of an existing floor for the laying of a new covering, with scraping, cleaning and leveling out the irregularities. Includes removing the residue and the prior leveling. Measured per square meter prepared.
cadenas.Preparación de piso existente para nuevo: Preparation of an existing floor for a new finish.
cadenas.Preparación de soporte de enchapado con: Preparation of the mortar substrate for tiling.
cadenas.Preparación de soporte de madera para pi: Preparation of a wood substrate for painting, with sanding, cleaning and the application of a sanding sealer. Includes sanding and applying the primer. Measured per square meter prepared.
Preparation of a wood substrate for painting.
cadenas.Preparación de soporte de metal para pin: Preparation of a metal substrate for painting.
cadenas.Preparación de soporte de yeso con sella: Preparation of a plaster substrate with sealer.

Preparation of the ground and laying sod, with leveling and initial watering. Includes preparation and laying.

cadenas.Protección de mobiliario, electrodomésti: Protection of furniture, appliances and equipment that stay in the building during the works, using polyethylene sheeting held with tape. Includes first moving the furniture together in the area furthest from the work face, covering it completely with lapped sheeting, sealing with tape to keep dust out, checking the protection periodically while the works last, and removing and disposing of it at the end. Measured over the area of furniture actually protected.
cadenas.Protección de piso existente que permane: Protection of existing flooring that is to remain, using overlapping rolls of corrugated cardboard taped at the joints, laid over polyethylene sheeting where there is a risk of moisture. Used on partial refurbishments where the flooring in areas not being worked on has to be handed back undamaged. Includes cleaning the surface beforehand, laying and lapping the material, sealing the joints and the perimeter against the baseboard, replacing any areas that deteriorate during the works, and removing and disposing of the protection when the work finishes. Measured over the area actually protected.
cadenas.Protección de piso terminado durante la: Protection of finished flooring while the works are carried out.
cadenas.Protección de puerta existente durante l: Protection of an existing door during the works. Includes covering with cardboard or sheet. Measured per square meter protected.
cadenas.Protección de puertas, ventanas, aparato: Protection of doors, windows, plumbing fixtures and finished elements that remain inside the work area, using plastic sheeting and cardboard held with low-tack tape that leaves no residue and does not damage the finishes. Measured over the area actually protected.

cadenas.Prueba de estanqueidad de la trampa de g: Watertightness test of a grease interceptor by filling and verifying the absence of leaks.

cadenas.Prueba de estanqueidad de piscina por ll: Watertightness test of a swimming pool under controlled filling, with the water loss recorded and the pool shell inspected.

cadenas.Prueba de estanqueidad de trampa de gras: Watertightness test of a grease interceptor.
cadenas.Prueba de estanqueidad de zona húmeda (b: Watertightness test of a wet area (bathroom, shower) by flooding, to verify the waterproofing.
Leak test of a gas pipe.

Pressure test of the water system.

Commissioning test of an electrical panel.

cadenas.Prueba de resistencia de aislamiento de: Insulation resistance test of the conductors with a megohmmeter, to verify there is no leakage.
cadenas.Prueba de vacío de sistema de climatizac: Vacuum test of the HVAC system.

Test of the drainage vent system.

Hydrostatic test of a water pipe.

Hydraulic test of the water installation. Includes pressurizing and verifying. Measured per installation tested.

cadenas.Prueba y verificación del sistema comple: Testing and verification of the complete lightning protection system: electrical continuity of the air termination, down conductors and connections, and measurement of the resistance of the grounding system. Includes visual inspection of all the joints, measurement with a ground resistance tester, recording the values obtained and the results report with the observations for remedial work. Measured per system verified.
cadenas.Prueba y verificación del sistema de pro: Testing and verification of the lightning protection system.
