cadenas.Puesta a disposición de andamio colgante: Provision of a swing stage or suspended cradle for one-off work on a facade where erecting a tubular scaffold is not justified. Its safety depends entirely on the anchor points on the roof and on the mandatory use of a lifeline independent of the suspension equipment, a requirement that admits no exception. Includes the assessment and installation of the anchors, erection of the equipment, the proof load test beforehand, daily inspection of ropes and brakes, use over the period and dismantling. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Puesta a disposición de baño portátil pa: Provision of a portable toilet for the site workforce, including delivery, siting, maintenance and periodic emptying for one month. Required on sites with no usable sanitary facilities, and it keeps the workforce out of the facilities of a building being refurbished. Includes transport and siting at a point the service truck can reach, supplying consumables, periodic emptying and cleaning, and removal at the end of the period. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Puesta a disposición de contenedor de es: Provision of a debris container on site, including its placing, removals and emptying over one month. Includes obtaining the street occupation permit where the container stands outside the plot, setting it on blocks that protect the pavement, reflective marking, removal and replacement as it fills and cartage to a licensed disposal site with its tipping fee. Measured per month on site.
cadenas.Puesta a disposición de montacargas o pl: Provision of a site hoist or crane for lowering debris and raising materials on works above ground floor level, including one month on hire. Includes delivery of the equipment, its erection and anchoring, verification of the maximum permissible load and of the bearing point, signage and barring off of the landing area, periodic inspection of ropes and brakes, dismantling and removal. Measured per month of the equipment on site.
Grounding with a copper electrode. Includes driving it and the connection. Measured per ground electrode constructed.

Commissioning of the backup power system. Includes the verification and the adjustment. Measured per system commissioned.

cadenas.Pulido y abrillantado de enchapado de má: Polishing and buffing of marble cladding on a wall, to recover the shine. Includes the mechanical polishing and the final buffing. Measured per square meter polished.
cadenas.Pulido y abrillantado de enchapado de pi: Polishing and buffing of natural stone cladding.
cadenas.Pulido y abrillantado de mesón de piedra: Polishing and buffing a natural stone countertop with diamond pads and sealer. Includes cleaning and polishing.
Polishing and buffing of a stone countertop.
cadenas.Pulido y abrillantado de piso de piedra: Polishing and buffing of an existing stone floor.
cadenas.Pulido y abrillantado de piso existente: Grinding and buffing of an existing marble, granite or terrazzo floor, to recover the lost shine and to remove surface scratches and stains. It is a very cost effective alternative to replacing the floor, since it restores the original appearance for a fraction of the cost. Includes protecting the surroundings and the baseboards, grinding with successive passes of decreasing grit with water, collecting and removing the slurry generated, filling the pores and small chips, buffing with a crystallizing agent and applying the stain resistant sealer. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Pulido y abrillantado en obra de enchapa: Polishing and buffing of natural stone cladding on site, to even out the plane between slabs and to recover or give the final shine. It is carried out when the stone is laid unpolished or when the small lippage between slabs makes it necessary to correct the whole plane. Includes protecting the surroundings, polishing with successive passes of decreasing grit with water, collecting and removing the slurry generated, buffing with a crystallizing agent, cleaning and applying the water repellent and stain resistant sealer. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².

Exterior water point with a hose.
cadenas.Punto de agua exterior con su derivación: External water point with its branch, hose bibb and trim. Includes the branch off the main with an accessible shut-off valve, the buried or concealed pipe run, fitting the hose bibb with its hose thread, anchoring the assembly so that it cannot turn when used, which is what eventually breaks the connection, and the tightness test. Measured per point completed and tested.
cadenas.Punto de agua fría y caliente para apara: Hot and cold water connection for a plumbing fixture.

Includes the branch off the main line, mounting the shut-off valve in an accessible position without having to move the appliance, connecting with an approved flexible hose within its validity date, the tightness test of the joint with a leak detector and checking the combustion of the appliance after commissioning. Measured per point completed and tested.
Data outlet in the suspended ceiling.

cadenas.Punto de desagüe para nevera o congelado: Waste point for a refrigerator or freezer. Includes the connection. Measured per point constructed.
cadenas.Punto de fuerza dedicado para electrodom: Dedicated power outlet for an appliance or equipment of high consumption, with a conductor of larger size, its specific receptacle and a separate protective device in the panel. High consumption equipment such as air conditioning, a water heater, an electric range or a dryer needs its own circuit: sharing it with general purpose receptacles is the most frequent cause of conductors overheating. Includes the conduit, the conductor sized to the power, the box and the receptacle, the connections and checking continuity and voltage drop. Measured per point completed and tested.
Power outlet for an electric range.
cadenas.Punto de fuerza para cocina o electrodom: Power outlet for a kitchen or an appliance. Includes the connection. Measured per point constructed.

cadenas.Punto de iluminación exterior de jardín: External lighting point for a garden or access, with its buried conduit, cabling, weatherproof box and base to anchor the fixture. Includes setting out, opening the trench, the buried conduit with warning tape over it, drawing in a cable rated for external use, constructing the anchorage base, the weatherproof connection and testing. The fixture is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per point completed and tested.
cadenas.Punto de instalación para sensor de alar: Installation point for an alarm sensor, CCTV camera or access control reader, with its containment, cabling and back box. Includes the field layout of the position taking into account the coverage angle of the device and avoiding backlighting in the case of cameras, the independent containment, running the cable through to the control panel or recorder, terminating, mounting the device and the operational and coverage test. The equipment is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per point completed and tested.
cadenas.Punto de interruptor doble. Incluye la c: Two-gang switch point. Includes the box and the device. Measured per point constructed.
cadenas.Punto de interruptor o tomacorriente, in: Switch or receptacle point, including box and device.
cadenas.Punto de red de datos, telefonía o telev: Data, telephone or television outlet, with its own independent containment, category 6 or coaxial cable depending on the service, back box and outlet plate. The containment must be independent of the power containment and kept separate from it, because running alongside power conductors induces interference that degrades the signal. Includes the containment, running the cable without joints through to the rack or distribution point, terminating both ends, labelling the outlet and the continuity test and basic certification. Measured per outlet completed and tested.
cadenas.Punto de tomacorriente doble. Incluye la: Duplex receptacle point. Includes the box and the device. Measured per point constructed.
cadenas.Punto eléctrico para ventilador de techo: Electrical point for a ceiling fan, with its fan-rated box, conduit, conductor and control. The box has to be specifically rated for a fan and anchored to a structural member or to a ceiling brace: an ordinary light fixture box is not designed to carry the weight and the vibration of a fan running. Includes setting out, strengthening the anchorage, the fan-rated box, the conduit and the conductor with the additional core for the speed control, the control device and testing. Measured per point completed and tested.
Pergola or shade structure over a pool area.
cadenas.Rampa de acceso vehicular de concreto ar: Reinforced concrete driveway ramp with a non-slip grooved finish and a drainage channel at the foot. The transverse grooves are not decorative: on a slope and in rain they are the only thing that gives the vehicle grip and the pedestrian purchase. Includes setting out the gradient and checking that the vehicle will not ground at the breaks at the top and bottom, preparing the base, the mesh, the side formwork, pouring and screeding, the transverse grooving, the channel or grate at the foot of the ramp that keeps water out of the garage, saw cutting the joints and curing. Measured by the area actually constructed.
cadenas.Rampa de concreto con acabado antidesliz: Concrete ramp with an anti-slip finish.
cadenas.Rasqueteado y retirada del friso o reves: Scraping back and removal of the existing deteriorated stucco or covering, leaving the substrate clean for the new finish. Includes removing the loose material and the cleaning. Measured per square meter scraped back.
cadenas.Realización de ensayo o prueba de carga: Carrying out a load test or proof test of the existing structure. Includes preparation and measurement. Measured per test carried out.
cadenas.Realización de la charla de inducción en: Delivery of the safety induction to site personnel and of the periodic toolbox talks during the works, with an attendance register. The signed register is what evidences that the worker was informed of the risks of his job, a document that proves decisive in the event of any incident. Includes preparation of the content around the real risks of the site, delivery of the initial induction and of the periodic talks, issue of the safe working instructions and the documented attendance record. Measured per set of talks for the site.
cadenas.Recalce de fundación existente mediante: Underpinning of an existing footing in bays, to widen its bearing area or to lower its level where settlement has appeared or where the load on the structure is being increased. It is carried out in alternate bays and never continuously: excavating under the whole footing at once leaves it without support and causes the collapse it is meant to prevent. Includes the study and the fixing of the order of the bays, excavation in alternate bays, the formwork, the reinforcement tied into the existing footing with chemical anchors, pouring with shrinkage-compensating mortar, wedging against the existing footing and waiting before the next bay is opened. Measured by the length actually underpinned.
Underpinning of a footing in concrete.
cadenas.Recalce de zapata existente con concreto: Underpinning of an existing footing with concrete. Includes cutting out and pouring. Measured per cubic meter constructed.
cadenas.Recibido de aparato sanitario con morter: Bedding and fixing a plumbing fixture in mortar with anchors. Includes bedding and fixing. Measured per unit fixed.
Bedding and fixing of a plumbing fixture.
cadenas.Recibido de barra de apoyo de accesibili: Fixing an accessibility grab bar. Includes anchoring the bar. Measured per unit fixed.

cadenas.Refuerzo de columna existente mediante e: Strengthening of an existing column by reinforced concrete jacketing, increasing its section with a perimeter layer of concrete with its own reinforcement, tied to the original core. Includes shoring the structure beforehand to take the load off the column, hacking the existing surface to provide a bond, drilling and chemically anchoring the dowels that stitch the jacket to the core, the longitudinal reinforcement and the confinement stirrups, the formwork, pouring with shrinkage-compensating concrete or a fluid mortar given the small thickness, curing and the staged removal of the shoring. Includes preparing and sanding the substrate to a flat surface free of laitance, rounding the arrises over which the fabric has to bend, priming, applying the saturating resin, laying the fabric in the direction of the tension and rolling out the air bubbles, the second coat of resin and curing. It is the quickest solution when the capacity of an existing slab has to be increased without thickening it from above. Includes shoring the element to be strengthened beforehand, leveling the soffit, drilling and chemical anchoring, hoisting and offering up the section, filling the interface with non-shrink grout to guarantee the transfer of load, since a section that does not bear does not strengthen, tightening the anchors and anti-corrosion protection. Measured by the length of strengthening actually constructed.

It is used in refurbishment where the existing stucco is mostly sound and only needs repair and leveling, avoiding hacking off the whole of it. Includes sounding by tapping to mark out and remove the hollow areas, cleaning and wetting, applying the bonding coat in the areas of greater thickness, laying and ruling off the mortar flush with the existing stucco, and floating, leaving an imperceptible transition between the new work and what has been kept. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².

Includes cleaning and vacuuming the substrate beforehand, applying a pore sealing primer to even out the absorption, placing the perimeter isolation strip, mechanical mixing, pouring, spreading and de-aerating the product, and waiting until it is ready for foot traffic. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Regularización de techo de concreto prev: Making a concrete soffit level prior to the installation of a ceiling or painting, with mortar or leveling compound. Includes correcting the unevenness and the finishing. Measured per square meter made level.

cadenas.Relleno con material de excavación reuti: Backfill with reused excavated material, after screening. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per cubic meter filled.
cadenas.Relleno con material granular de préstam: Backfill with imported granular fill. Includes spreading and compaction. Measured per cubic meter filled.
cadenas.Relleno con material granular selecciona: Backfill with selected imported granular fill, such as natural run of crusher, spread and compacted in layers not exceeding 20 cm, used where the material on site does not meet the requirements. Includes supply and placing of the material, spreading it in layers, moisture conditioning to optimum moisture content, compacting each layer to the specified density and checking the final level. Measured by the volume of compacted fill to the design dimensions.
cadenas.Relleno de celda vertical de mampostería: Filling of a vertical masonry cell with its reinforcing steel and flowable concrete, at the positions the design indicates. It is the operation that turns a wall of blocks into a structural element, and its typical failure is incomplete filling through segregation or through the cell being blocked with mortar fins. Includes cleaning the bottom of the cell beforehand through the clean-out opening, placing and centring the steel with its laps, pouring the flowable concrete in limited heights and vibrating or compacting it with a rod. Measured by the length of cell actually filled.

Measured by the volume of compacted fill to the design dimensions.

cadenas.Reparación de mueble de baño con ajuste: Repair of a bathroom cabinet with adjustment of the hardware and replacement of damaged parts. Includes inspection and adjustment.
Repair of a bathroom vanity unit.

cadenas.Reparación de reja con sustitución de tr: Repair of a grille by replacing a damaged length of tube. Includes cutting out the length, welding in the new and repainting. Measured per meter repaired.
cadenas.Reparación de reja con sustitución de tu: Repair of a grille with replacement of a tube.
cadenas.Reparación de sistema de seguridad o ala: Repair of a security or alarm system. Includes the diagnosis and the repair. Measured per repair carried out.
cadenas.Reparación de tablero eléctrico. Incluye: Repair of an electrical panel. Includes the replacement of the protective devices. Measured per repair carried out.
cadenas.Reparación de vaso de piscina con resane: Repair of a pool shell by filling cracks and local rewaterproofing. Includes repair.
cadenas.Reparación de ventana con ajuste de herr: Repair of a window by adjusting the hardware and mechanisms. Includes checking and adjustment. Measured per square meter repaired.
Repair of a window with adjustment of hardware.
cadenas.Reparación de viga con mortero estructur: Repair of a beam with a structural mortar. Includes cutting out and repair. Measured per square meter repaired.
Repair of a beam with mortar.
cadenas.Reparación de zonas puntuales de friso d: Repair of localized areas of gypsum plaster damaged by knocks, damp that has already been dealt with, or areas that have come away, replacing the material and flushing up with the existing plaster. Includes marking out and removing the loose material until sound, well adhered plaster is found, cleaning and wetting the edge, applying the bonding coat, replacing the compound in layers, flushing up with the existing surface and sanding the transition. On repairs over damp it is essential to have removed the cause beforehand, because otherwise the area fails again. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Reparación puntual de cubierta con susti: Localized repair of a roof by replacing the damaged length of membrane or sheeting, with the laps sealed. Includes cleaning and sealing.
cadenas.Reparación puntual de cubierta en zonas: Localized repair of a roof where there is a local leak, cutting out the area, replacing the waterproofing and reinforcing the point of failure. Includes locating the real origin of the leak, which rarely coincides with the point where the stain appears on the ceiling because the water travels across the slab before it drips, cutting out the affected area, priming, reinstating the system with a generous lap onto the existing, reinforcing the detail and the watertightness test. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting voids over 1 m².
cadenas.Reparación puntual de forro de placa de: Localized repair of a damaged cement board lining, replacing the area and sealing the joints. Includes cutting out the area, replacing the board and the finish. Measured per square meter repaired.
cadenas.Reparación puntual de piso existente med: Localized repair of an existing floor by replacing loose, hollow or broken tiles and patching the deteriorated areas, keeping the rest of the floor. This is the intervention that avoids replacing a whole floor over localized damage, and its success depends on having tiles from the same batch or on relocating tiles taken from a hidden area, such as the inside of a closet, because a tile from another batch is obvious from a distance. Includes carefully lifting the affected tiles, cleaning the substrate, replacing them with adhesive, leveling with the adjoining tiles, grouting to match and cleaning. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Reparación puntual de trasdosado de plac: Localized repair of a gypsum board wall lining.
cadenas.Reparación puntual de un trasdosado o fo: Localized repair of a gypsum board lining or enclosure damaged by a knock or by localized damp. Includes cutting out the affected length, replacing the board in the area, the joint treatment of the patch and sanding to leave the surface ready to paint. Measured per repair carried out.
cadenas.Reparación superficial de concreto con m: Surface repair of concrete with structural mortar.
Surface repair of concrete with a structural mortar. Includes cutting out and repair. Measured per square meter repaired.
cadenas.Reparación y parcheo puntual de piso exi: Localized repair and patching of an existing floor.
cadenas.Repello de paramento exterior con acabad: Base coat on exterior surfaces with a smooth finish.
cadenas.Repello de paramento exterior con morter: Stucco base coat on an exterior substrate with mortar and a smooth finish, ready to paint. Includes the screeds, applying the mortar and the finishing. Measured per square meter stuccoed.
cadenas.Repello y afinado de la mocheta o arista: Stucco base coat and finishing of the reveal or arris of a door or window opening, with a reinforcing corner bead, leaving the arris straight and plumb. The arris of an opening is the first thing looked at on entering a room and the first thing that gets knocked, so the corner bead is not only a guide but the protection that prevents permanent chipping. Includes the cleaning, placing and plumbing the corner bead, laying and ruling off the mortar on both faces, and floating. Measured by the length of arris actually completed.
cadenas.Repello y afinado de mocheta o arista de: Base coat and finishing of a reveal or opening arris.
cadenas.Repetidor de señal inalámbrica para la r: Wireless signal repeater for the home automation network.
cadenas.Repicado de superficie de concreto para: Scarifying of a concrete surface to improve adhesion.
cadenas.Repicado superficial de paramento o losa: Surface hacking of a concrete wall or slab, with an electric breaker and a point, to create the roughness needed to guarantee the bond of the stucco or the screed that follows. Includes cleaning the surface beforehand, hacking uniformly without exposing the reinforcement, removing surface laitance and release agent residue, blowing out and vacuuming the resulting dust and clearing away the waste. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually hacked.
cadenas.Repintado de fachada sobre pintura exist: Repainting of a facade over existing paint in good condition, with cleaning and two coats of exterior latex paint. Includes the cleaning of the surface, the treatment of the cracks and the two finish coats. Measured per square meter repainted.
Repainting of a facade over existing paint.
cadenas.Repintado de mantenimiento de fachada, c: Maintenance repainting of a facade, with cleaning, treatment of cracks and two coats. Includes the cleaning, the patching and the two coats. Measured per square meter repainted.
cadenas.Repintado de paramento interior sobre pi: Repainting of an internal substrate over existing paint in good condition, with two coats of latex paint. Includes the surface cleaning, the touching up of small defects and the two finish coats. Measured per square meter repainted.
Repainting of interior surfaces over existing paint.
cadenas.Repintado integral de vivienda con desal: Complete repainting of a dwelling, with the occupants moved out.
cadenas.Repintado integral de vivienda con prote: Full repainting of a dwelling with protection of furniture and clearing of spaces, with two coats. Includes protecting the furniture and the application. Measured per square meter repainted.
cadenas.Replanteo de cielos rasos y alturas. Inc: Setting out of suspended ceilings and their heights. Includes marking the levels. Measured per square meter set out.
cadenas.Replanteo de desagües y pendientes de pi: Setting out of floor drains and falls. Includes marking the falls. Measured per linear meter set out.
Setting out of drains and falls.
cadenas.Replanteo de ejes de muros con nivel lás: Setting out of wall grid lines with a laser level. Includes marking the lines. Measured per linear meter set out.
Setting out of wall grid lines.
cadenas.Replanteo de escalera y peldaños. Incluy: Setting out of a stair and its treads. Includes marking the treads and risers. Measured per stair set out.
cadenas.Replanteo de instalaciones (eléctrica, s: Setting out of services (electrical, plumbing) with the runs marked. Includes marking. Measured per installation set out.
cadenas.Replanteo de niveles y pendientes de pis: Setting out of floor levels and falls. Includes marking the levels. Measured per linear meter set out.
Setting out of levels and falls.
cadenas.Replanteo de particiones y tabiques. Inc: Setting out of partitions and partition walls. Includes marking the grid lines. Measured per square meter set out.
cadenas.Replanteo de pendientes y niveles de cub: Field layout of the falls and levels of a roof deck.
Setting out of openings and door and window units.
cadenas.Replanteo de vanos y carpintería. Incluy: Setting out of openings and door and window units. Includes marking the positions. Measured per linear meter set out.
cadenas.Replanteo general de la intervención sob: General setting out of the works in the building, marking the partition grid lines, the finished floor levels and the datum levels, carried out with a laser level and measuring equipment. Includes checking squareness and comparing the actual geometry against the drawing, marking the grid lines on floor and walls, establishing the datum level that will govern the whole job, marking the fixed reference points and noting any discrepancies found against the design. Measured over the area of work actually set out.
cadenas.Replanteo general de la obra y trazado d: General setting out of the works and marking of grid lines.
cadenas.Replanteo topográfico de las pendientes,: Setting out the falls, levels and drainage points of a roof by survey, with a laser level and reference rails. Includes marking the ridge and valley lines.
cadenas.Replanteo y nivelación de paramento con: Setting out and leveling of a substrate with a laser level prior to stucco or tiling, to guarantee that it is plumb and level. Includes checking with the laser and marking out the screeds. Measured per square meter leveled.
Replacement of PPE during the works.
cadenas.Reposición de botiquín de primeros auxil: Replenishment of the first aid kit.
cadenas.Reposición de grama dañada con sustituci: Replacement of damaged turf by lifting the sods and relaying, and watering. Includes replacement and watering.
cadenas.Reposición de los equipos de protección: Replacement of personal protective equipment worn out or damaged during the works.
cadenas.Reposición de tornillería y sellado de s: Replacement of the fixings and sealing of the laps of a metal roof, to stop leaks. Includes replacement and sealing.
cadenas.Reposición de tornillería y solapes de c: Replacement of fasteners and laps in a roof.
cadenas.Reposición del material consumido del bo: Replenishment of the contents used from the first aid kit during the works.
cadenas.Resalte sanitario de resina en encuentro: Resin sanitary cove at the floor and wall junction.
cadenas.Resane de paramento interior con masilla: Patching of an interior substrate with filler to remove imperfections prior to painting. Includes applying the filler and sanding. Measured per square meter patched.
Patching of an interior surface with filler.
cadenas.Resane de rozas y pasos de instalaciones: Patching of chases and service penetrations. Includes making good and finishing. Measured per square meter patched.
cadenas.Resane general de paramentos tras el pas: General patching of surfaces after the services have been run. Includes making good and finishing. Measured per square meter patched.
General patching after the installation of services.
cadenas.Restauración de baranda de madera con li: Restoration of a wood guardrail by sanding and varnishing. Includes preparing the surface and varnishing. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de carpintería de madera co: Restoration of wood joinery with stripping of the previous finish, sanding and new varnishing. Includes the stripping, the sanding, the primer and the two coats of varnish. Measured per square meter restored.
Restoration of woodwork by stripping and varnishing.
Restoration of wood joinery with filling with wood filler, sanding and finishing. Includes the filling of the knocks, the sanding and the finish. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de enchapado de piedra con: Restoration of stone cladding with replacement of missing pieces.
cadenas.Restauración de enchapado de piedra natu: Restoration of natural stone cladding with the reinstatement of missing pieces and grouting. Includes replacing the pieces and grouting the whole. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de enchapado existente con: Restoration of existing tiling with the removal of the deteriorated grout and re-grouting with new mortar. Includes the raking out of the joints, the cleaning and the filling with the appropriate mortar. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de enlucido con mortero de: Restoration of a plaster finish with lime mortar.
cadenas.Restauración de enlucido de mortero de c: Restoration of a lime mortar skim coat, with the reinstatement of the damaged areas and the finish. Includes the replacement of the mortar and the finishing. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de friso de fachada, con re: Restoration of a facade stucco, with reinstatement. Includes reinstating the stucco and the finish. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de juntas de fachada, con r: Restoration of the joints of a facade, by repointing. Includes raking out and repointing. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de moldura o cornisa de fac: Restoration of a molding or cornice on a facade. Includes reinstatement and the finish. Measured per meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de molduras decorativas de: Restoration of decorative gypsum moldings, with the reinstatement of the missing sections and the finish. Includes the replacement of the moldings and the finish. Measured per meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de piso de madera con lijad: Restoration of a wood floor with sanding, filling of the joints and varnishing. Includes the sanding, the filling and the two coats of varnish. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de puerta de madera con res: Restoration of a wood door by filling, sanding and finishing. Includes filling the dents, sanding and varnishing or painting. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de revestimiento de fachada: Restoration of a facade cladding, with units reinstated. Includes replacing the units and pointing. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración de ventana de madera con re: Restoration of a wood window by filling, sanding and finishing. Includes filling, sanding and varnishing or painting. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración puntual de papel tapiz, con: Localized restoration of wallpaper, with the replacement of damaged lengths and finishing the joints. Includes the removal of the damaged length and the replacement. Measured per square meter restored.
cadenas.Restauración y rejuntado de enchapado ex: Restoration and re-grouting of existing tiling.
cadenas.Retirada de cartón y embalajes a recicla: Removal of cardboard and packaging for recycling.
Removal of scrap metal by a licensed waste carrier.
cadenas.Retirada de embalajes de la zona de trab: Removal of packaging from the work area.
cadenas.Retirada de embalajes y material de dese: Removal of packaging and waste material from the work area, sorted for recycling.
cadenas.Retirada de escombro procedente de demol: Removal of debris arising from demolition from the storage point on site and cartage by dump truck to a licensed disposal site or spoil site, including the tipping fee. Includes hand loading of the debris onto the vehicle, sheeting and securing the load to prevent spillage in transit, cartage based on an average distance of 25 km, tipping and cleaning of the loading area. Measured per cubic meter of bulked debris actually removed.
cadenas.Retirada de madera y pallets a reciclaje: Removal of lumber and pallets for recycling.
cadenas.Retirada de material combustible de las: Removal of combustible material from the work areas, to reduce the risk of fire.
cadenas.Retirada final de las protecciones de ob: Final removal of the site protection and general cleaning, leaving the building ready for handover.
cadenas.Retirada final de protecciones y limpiez: Final removal of protection and general cleaning.
cadenas.Retirada y entrega de cartón y embalajes: Removal and delivery of cardboard and packaging to a recycling plant, including loading and cartage.
cadenas.Retirada y entrega de chatarra metálica: Removal and delivery of scrap metal to a licensed waste carrier, including loading and cartage.
cadenas.Retirada y entrega de madera y pallets a: Removal and delivery of lumber and pallets to a recycling or reuse facility, including loading and cartage.
cadenas.Retirada y transporte de escombro a vert: Removal and cartage of debris to a licensed disposal site.
cadenas.Retiro de aislamiento de fachada ventila: Removal of insulation from a ventilated facade.
Removal of insulation from a rainscreen facade. Includes removing the insulation. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of insulation from a wall or facade. Includes removing the insulation. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de aislamiento de piso o suelo fl: Removal of insulation from a floor or floating floor. Includes removing the insulation. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de aislamiento de tanque o depósi: Removal of insulation from a tank or vessel. Includes removing the insulation. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de aislamiento térmico en cubiert: Removal of thermal insulation from a roof deck.
Removal of thermal insulation from a roof. Includes removing the insulation and cleaning up. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de aislamiento térmico o acústico: Removal of existing thermal or acoustic insulation, whether mineral wool, polystyrene or polyurethane, held in the cavity of a partition, a ceiling or a roof. Includes wearing a mask and gloves because of the irritation caused by mineral fibers, taking the material out in complete pieces where its condition allows, bagging it immediately to prevent fibers dispersing into the air, vacuuming the remains and cleaning the area. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
Removal of thermal or acoustic insulation.
cadenas.Retiro de barrera de vapor o lámina de p: Removal of a vapor barrier or polyethylene sheet. Includes removing the sheet. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de capa de asfalto superficial de: Removal of a surface layer of asphalt from the site. Includes lifting and removal. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of a surface layer of asphalt.
Removal of pipe insulation. Includes removing the insulation. Measured per meter removed.
Removal of geotextile from a roof or wall. Includes removing the geotextile. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de grama o pavimento vegetal supe: Removal of the surface grass or vegetative cover. Includes cutting and removal. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de impermeabilización de muro ent: Removal of waterproofing from a buried wall.
Removal of waterproofing from a buried wall. Includes removing the membrane and cleaning up. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de impermeabilización existente d: Removal of existing bituminous membrane waterproofing from a roof, including the laps, the reinforcement at the junctions and the primer bonded to the substrate, by hand with a scraper and a crowbar, applying local heat to soften the areas strongly bonded. Includes protecting the drains so that they do not block with debris, cutting the membrane into manageable strips, scraping the substrate until it is clean and ready to receive the new waterproofing, removing the material in tied rolls and clearing away. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually removed.
cadenas.Retiro de impermeabilización líquida o a: Removal of a liquid or acrylic waterproofing.
cadenas.Retiro de lámina drenante o geocompuesto: Removal of a drainage membrane or geocomposite from a wall. Includes removing the membrane. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de láminas decorativas, vinilos o: Removal of bonded decorative sheets, vinyls or mirrors.
cadenas.Retiro de manta reflectiva de aislamient: Removal of reflective foil insulation. Includes removing the foil. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of a bituminous membrane from a roof deck.
cadenas.Retiro de membrana impermeabilizante de: Removal of a PVC waterproofing membrane. Includes removing the membrane. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de mortero impermeabilizante de p: Removal of waterproofing mortar from a wall. Includes hacking off and cleaning up. Measured per square meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de obstáculos y escombros superfi: Removal of obstructions and surface debris.
cadenas.Retiro de obstáculos, escombros y basura: Removal of obstructions, debris and surface rubbish from the site. Includes clearing and stockpiling. Measured per square meter cleared.
cadenas.Retiro de panel de lana mineral de tabiq: Removal of mineral wool board from a partition or ceiling. Includes removing the board. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of a mineral wool panel.
Removal of wallpaper from a surface.
cadenas.Retiro de papel tapiz existente en param: Removal of existing wallpaper from an internal wall, together with the wallpaper paste residue, by hand after wetting with a softening solution and scraping with a broad scraper. Includes protecting floors, baseboards and accessories, applying the solution in several passes until the paper comes away without pulling the stucco off, scraping off the paste residue, washing the wall down finally and drying it, leaving it ready to receive the new finish. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually treated.
Removal of the vegetative cover or grass.
cadenas.Retiro de raíces y obstáculos menores en: Removal of roots and minor buried obstructions.
cadenas.Retiro de raíces, restos de fundaciones: Removal of roots, remains of old foundations, disused pipework and other minor obstructions found buried when the site is cleared. Includes locating and exposing the obstruction, extracting it by hand or with a backhoe depending on size, cutting it with a chainsaw or angle grinder where it has to be broken up, backfilling and compacting the resulting void with material from the site, and separating the material removed as debris, scrap or green waste. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the area of ground actually probed and cleared of obstructions.
cadenas.Retiro de recubrimiento impermeabilizant: Removal of an existing liquid, acrylic or cementitious waterproof coating from a roof or terrace, by hand with a scraper and by mechanical sanding, down to a clean substrate with the right roughness to receive the new system. Includes protecting the drains, scraping the areas with bubbles or delamination, sanding the remaining surface, vacuuming the dust produced and removing the waste. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually treated.
cadenas.Retiro de residuos de pinturas y disolve: Removal of paint and solvent waste.
Removal of small quantities of hazardous waste.
cadenas.Retiro de revestimiento decorativo adher: Removal of a decorative covering bonded to a wall, whether a vinyl sheet, a wall decal or a glued mirror, together with the adhesive residue. Includes protecting the floor and the furniture, heating or wetting beforehand to soften the adhesive, peeling the material away under control with a scraper, and in the case of mirrors taping the face beforehand to prevent fragments flying if it fractures. Includes scraping off the adhesive residue, removing the material in sacks and cleaning the wall. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area actually treated.
cadenas.Retiro de sellado de juntas existente. I: Removal of existing joint sealant. Includes removing the sealant. Measured per meter removed.
cadenas.Retiro de tocones y raíces de árboles ta: Removal of stumps and roots of felled trees. Includes extraction and clearing. Measured per unit removed.
cadenas.Retiro de tubos fluorescentes y lámparas: Removal of fluorescent tubes and lamps.
cadenas.Retiro de vidrio de carpintería existent: Removal of glass from existing joinery.
cadenas.Retiro de vidrio de carpintería que perm: Removal of glass from joinery that is staying, whether because it is broken, because the glazing is being replaced or to lighten the window before it is taken out. Carried out by hand, removing the glazing beads, putty or retaining silicone. Includes taping the face of the glass beforehand so that, if it fractures, the fragments are held by the adhesive film, using face protection and cut resistant gloves, cleaning the rebate, removing the glass in a specific rigid container and thoroughly sweeping up the splinters. It does not include disposal of the debris, which is priced in the waste management chapter. Measured by the area of glass actually removed.
cadenas.Retiro de vidrio de fachada, con desmont: Removal of glass from a facade, taken out carefully. Includes removing the glass and cleaning the frame. Measured per square meter removed.
Removal of glass from a facade.
cadenas.Retoque y repaso puntual de pintura inte: Touching up and localized repair of internal paint in damaged or worn areas, with one finish coat. Includes cleaning the area, the patching of small defects and the touch-up coat. Measured per square meter touched up.
Localized touching up of interior paintwork.
cadenas.Reubicación de punto eléctrico existente: Relocation of an existing electrical point.
cadenas.Reubicación de un punto eléctrico existe: Relocation of an existing electrical point, moving the box and the device to the new position and abandoning the previous point. It is one of the most frequent interventions in refurbishment when the layout of the furniture changes. Includes isolating and verifying dead, forming the new chase and box, diverting the conductor through an accessible junction box, since a buried joint with no access is a future fault impossible to find, fitting the device in the new position, filling in and making good the abandoned box and testing. Measured per point relocated.
cadenas.Revestimiento continuo de microcemento e: Continuous microcement covering on a vertical substrate, applied in successive coats with reinforcing mesh, with a sealed finish. It offers a continuous joint free surface, much in demand in bathrooms and contemporary spaces, but it is extremely sensitive to the quality of the substrate: any crack or movement in the substrate shows through in the finish. Includes checking and stabilizing the substrate, priming, applying the base coat with the mesh, the finishing coats with the chosen texture, sanding between coats and applying the coats of protective sealer. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
Seamless microcement coating on a vertical surface.
cadenas.Revestimiento continuo de microcemento s: Continuous microcement covering over an existing floor or mortar bed, applied in coats with reinforcing mesh and sealed with several coats of protective varnish. It allows a floor to be renewed without demolishing it and with hardly any gain in level, which in refurbishment resolves the problem of thresholds and doors. It is very sensitive to the substrate: any crack or movement shows through in the finish. Includes checking and stabilizing the substrate, priming, the base coat with mesh, the finishing coats with the chosen texture, sanding between coats and the coats of heavy traffic sealer. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Revestimiento de alta resistencia químic: High chemical resistance coating for a laboratory.
cadenas.Revestimiento de escalera completa (huel: Covering of a complete stair (treads, risers and trim) with porcelain tile, in a thin bed. Includes the preparation, laying and grouting. Measured per meter of tread covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de escalera completa con p: Complete stair tiling with porcelain tile.
cadenas.Revestimiento de escalera con cerámica o: Stair tiling with ceramic or porcelain tile.
cadenas.Revestimiento de fachada con friso rústi: Textured rustic stucco on a facade, applied over a stucco base coat or directly over the masonry, with the finish obtained by spraying or by combing depending on the texture chosen. Includes working from scaffolding, preparing and wetting the substrate, applying the base coat, working the texture continuously over complete bays between joints or breaks so that the stoppages do not show, and curing. The uniformity of the finish depends on keeping the same crew and the same mix throughout the whole bay. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Revestimiento de lámina acrílica o polic: Decorative acrylic or polycarbonate sheet cladding.
cadenas.Revestimiento de madera con acabado laca: Wood cladding with a lacquered finish.
cadenas.Revestimiento de mueble de baño con lámi: Facing of a bathroom vanity unit with a waterproof sheet.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con espejo, f: Covering of a substrate with a mirror, fixed with adhesive or brackets. Includes preparing the substrate, fixing the mirror and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con fibra nat: Covering of a substrate with woven natural fiber (sisal, jute or bamboo), with adhesive and trim. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and finishing the edges. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con gres porc: Covering of a substrate with wood effect porcelain stoneware, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con ladrillo: Covering of a substrate with decorative facing brick (facing brick or brick slips). Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con lámina ac: Covering of a substrate with decorative acrylic or polycarbonate sheet, with a fixing profile. Includes the preparation, laying and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con láminas o: Covering of a substrate with cork sheets or panels, with their adhesive and trim. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con panel de: Covering of a substrate with expanded metal or decorative mesh panel, with mechanical fixing. Includes preparation of the substrate, fixing the panel and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con panel per: Covering of a substrate with decorative perforated acoustic panel, with the framework. Includes preparation of the substrate, fixing the panel and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con paneles 3: Covering of a substrate with decorative 3D panels, with their adhesive and trim. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con paneles d: Covering of a substrate with lacquer finished wood panels, with their batten framework. Includes preparation of the substrate, fixing the panel and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con paneles o: Covering of a substrate with bamboo panels or battens, with the fixing framework. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con pieza de: Covering of a substrate with lightweight decorative stone, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con placa de: Covering of a substrate with decorative or precast cement board, with mechanical fixing. Includes preparing the substrate, fixing the boards and sealing the joints. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con plancha d: Covering of a substrate with melamine sheet, with the framework and the trim. Includes preparation of the substrate, fixing the board and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con tablero O: Covering of a substrate with decorative OSB board, with the framework and the finish. Includes preparation of the substrate, fixing the board and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con tela o te: Covering of a substrate with stretched or adhered fabric or textile, with its trim. Includes preparing the substrate, fixing the textile and finishing the edges. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paramento con vidrio de: Covering of a substrate with decorative lacquered or colored glass, with mechanical fixing. Includes preparing the substrate, fixing the glass and the finishing. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de pared de baño con panel: Bathroom wall cladding with PVC panels.
cadenas.Revestimiento de paredes de baño o área: Covering of bathroom or wet area walls with interlocking PVC or composite panels, with their trim profiles and sealing. It is the quick and economical alternative to tiling when there is no wish to hack off or to wait for the mortar to set, and it is installed over the existing covering if it is sound, which avoids demolition altogether. Includes checking the substrate, fitting the perimeter profiles, fixing the panels with a driven fit and adhesive, the cuts around the taps and accessories, and sealing every junction with sanitary silicone. Measured by the area actually completed, deducting openings over 1 m².
cadenas.Revestimiento de peldaño con pieza de pi: Covering of a tread with reclaimed natural stone or flagstone, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per meter of tread.
cadenas.Revestimiento de peldaño de escalera con: Covering of a stair tread with a granite or precast stone tread and riser. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per meter of tread.
Covering of a stair tread with a vinyl sheet or tile, with an anti-slip profile. Includes preparing the substrate and laying the covering. Measured per meter of tread.
cadenas.Revestimiento de rampa con pieza antides: Covering of a ramp with an anti-slip tile or a resin system, for safe circulation. Includes preparing the substrate and laying the covering. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento de rellano de escalera con: Covering of a stair landing with natural stone, in a thin bed. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revestimiento del descansillo de escaler: Covering of a stair landing with ceramic or porcelain tile. Includes preparation of the substrate, laying and grouting. Measured per square meter covered.
cadenas.Revisión completa de la instalación eléc: Full review of the electrical installation as built, with measurement of continuity, insulation and ground resistance and tripping test of the ground-fault circuit interrupters, and the issue of a report of results. It is what shows the client that the installation not only works but is safe, and the document that backs the installer if there is an incident later. Includes visual inspection of the panel and of the outlets, measurements with calibrated equipment, checking the labelling of the circuits, the tripping tests and delivery of the report with the values obtained. Measured per installation reviewed and certified.
cadenas.Revisión general de cubierta con informe: General inspection of a roof, with a report.
cadenas.Revisión general de cubierta con inspecc: General survey of a roof with inspection of the finishings, drains and structure, and the issue of a condition report and recommendations. Includes visual inspection.
cadenas.Revisión y certificación de instalación: Inspection and certification of the electrical installation.
cadenas.Revisión y limpieza de cubierta con info: Inspection and cleaning of a roof, with a report.
cadenas.Riego de implantación de área verde tras: Establishment watering of a planted area after planting, to settle the vegetation. Includes watering.
Establishment watering of a planted area.
Watering and compaction of a foundation.
cadenas.Riego y compactación del fondo de fundac: Watering and compaction of the bottom of the footing excavation. Includes watering and compaction. Measured per square meter constructed.
Recessed track for a sliding gate.
cadenas.Rodapié de PVC con canaleta de instalaci: PVC baseboard with a services raceway.
cadenas.Rodapié de mortero con media caña sanita: Mortar baseboard with a sanitary cove.
Chase in a clay block wall.
cadenas.Roza en pared de bloque para instalación: Chase in a block wall for services.
cadenas.SATE de fachada con poliestireno expandi: EIFS on a facade with expanded polystyrene.
EIFS on a wall with a textured finish.
cadenas.SATE de zócalo con panel de alta densida: EIFS on a base with a high-density board.
EIFS on a facade, including trims.
cadenas.Sacos de rafia para clasificación de res: Heavy-duty woven sacks for sorting waste.
cadenas.Saneado de muro con eflorescencias salin: Treatment of a wall with salt efflorescence, by cleaning and treatment. Includes removing the salts and applying the treatment. Measured per square meter treated.
Removal of salt efflorescence from a wall.
cadenas.Saneado de paramento con eflorescencias: Making good of a substrate with salt efflorescence, with brushing, washing and the application of a neutralizing treatment. Includes cleaning off the salts and the treatment prior to the finish. Measured per square meter made good.
Removal of efflorescence from a surface.
cadenas.Seguimiento y medición de ahorro energét: Monitoring and measurement of energy savings.
cadenas.Seguimiento y medición del ahorro energé: Monitoring and measurement of the energy saving after the refurbishment, by comparison of consumption.
cadenas.Sellado antihumedad de paramento interio: Damp sealing of an internal substrate followed by two coats of latex paint. Includes applying the sealer in the areas affected by damp, the two coats of paint and protecting the area. Measured per square meter treated and painted.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de cierre perimetral: Firestopping of the perimeter closure of a penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de encuentro muro-los: Firestopping of a wall and slab junction.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de junta de construcc: Firestopping of a construction joint. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de junta de dilatació: Firestopping of an expansion joint. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de junta lineal en mu: Firestopping of a linear joint in a wall or slab. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de paso de bandeja de: Firestopping of a cable tray penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de paso de bandeja po: Firestopping of a cable tray penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de paso de climatizac: Firestopping of an HVAC penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de paso de conducto d: Firestopping of a ventilation duct penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
Firestopping of a data cable penetration.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de paso de instalació: Firestopping of a data penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
Firestopping of an electrical penetration through a wall or slab. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
Firestopping of a plumbing penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de paso de tubería de: Firestopping of a gas pipe penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego de paso múltiple de i: Firestopping of a multiple service penetration. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per unit sealed.
cadenas.Sellado cortafuego del encuentro muro-lo: Firestopping of the wall to slab junction. Includes the application of intumescent mastic. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of the floor and wall junction.
cadenas.Sellado de fisuras en cubierta previo a: Sealing of cracks in a roof deck before waterproofing.
cadenas.Sellado de fisuras en fachada con sellad: Sealing of cracks in a facade with an elastic polyurethane sealant, prior to the finish. Includes the opening up and cleaning of the crack and the application of the sealant. Measured per meter of crack sealed.
Sealing of cracks in a facade.
cadenas.Sellado de fisuras en paramento previo a: Sealing of cracks in a surface before painting.
Sealing of a joint with a PVC waterstop.
Sealing of a joint with polyurethane.
cadenas.Sellado de junta con sellador elástico d: Sealing a joint with an elastic polyurethane sealant. Includes cleaning and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of a joint with sanitary silicone.
Sealing a joint with sanitary silicone. Includes cleaning and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de construcción con ban: Sealing a construction joint with a PVC waterstop. Includes placing the waterstop and the finish. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de construcción con pol: Sealing of a construction joint with polyurethane.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de construcción con sel: Sealing a construction joint with an elastic polyurethane sealant. Includes cleaning the joint and applying the sealant. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de dilatación en cubier: Sealing an expansion joint in a roof with a reinforcing strip and sealant. Includes laying the strip and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of an expansion joint in a roof deck.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de dilatación en escale: Sealing an expansion joint in a stair with a profile and sealant. Includes fitting the profile and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of an expansion joint in a stair.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de dilatación en fachad: Sealing an expansion joint in a facade with elastic sealant. Includes cleaning the joint and applying the sealant. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of an expansion joint in a facade.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de dilatación en piso c: Sealing an expansion joint in a floor with a profile and elastic sealant. Includes cleaning the joint, fitting the profile and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of an expansion joint in a floor.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de encuentro piso-pared: Sealing the floor to wall junction with sanitary sealant. Includes cleaning the joint and applying the sealant. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of the floor and wall junction.
Sealing of a joint in a stair.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de escalera. Incluye la: Sealing the joint of a stair. Includes cleaning and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de hormigonado con bent: Sealing of a construction joint with bentonite.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de hormigonado con cord: Sealing a construction joint with an expansive bentonite waterstop. Includes placing the waterstop and the finish. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de junta de mesón de cocina. Inc: Sealing the joint of a kitchen countertop. Includes cleaning and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de junta en piscina con sellador: Sealing a joint in a swimming pool with a sealant suitable for immersion. Includes cleaning the joint and applying the sealant. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of a joint in a swimming pool.
cadenas.Sellado de junta en tanque de agua con s: Sealing a joint in a water tank with a sealant suitable for immersion. Includes cleaning the joint and application. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of a joint in a tank.
cadenas.Sellado de junta perimetral de bañera o: Sealing the perimeter joint of a bathtub or shower. Includes cleaning and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de junta perimetral de muro con: Sealing the perimeter joint of a wall with elastic sealant. Includes cleaning the joint and applying the sealant. Measured per meter sealed.
Sealing of a perimeter joint of a wall.
Sealing of the perimeter joint of a window.
Sealing the perimeter joint of a window. Includes cleaning and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de juntas de hormigonado con ben: Sealing of construction joints with bentonite.
cadenas.Sellado de juntas de hormigonado en muro: Sealing of construction joints in a buried wall with a bentonite waterstop. Includes placing the waterstop and the finish. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de juntas y encuentros de mesón: Sealing the joints and junctions of a countertop with sanitary silicone, to prevent water ingress. Includes cleaning and sealing.
cadenas.Sellado de las uniones de los conductos: Sealing of the joints of the HVAC ductwork, to prevent air leakage.
cadenas.Sellado de pase de tubería en impermeabi: Sealing of a pipe penetration in waterproofing.
cadenas.Sellado de paso de instalaciones en muro: Sealing a services penetration through a wall or slab, with sealant and a collar. Includes preparing the penetration and sealing. Measured per unit sealed.
Sealing of a services penetration in a wall.
Sealing a pipe penetration with a split collar. Includes cleaning and sealing. Measured per unit sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de piso de concreto con sellador: Sealing of a concrete floor with an acrylic or polyurethane sealer, for protection and enhancement. Includes the cleaning and applying the sealer. Measured per square meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado de solapes y remates de cubierta: Sealing the laps and finishings of a metal roof with elastic sealant and replacement screws, to stop leaks. Includes cleaning and sealing.
cadenas.Sellado del encuentro piso-pared con sel: Sealing the floor to wall junction with sealant. Includes cleaning and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado del paso de tubería, antena, sop: Sealing of the penetration of a pipe, aerial, support or any element passing through the waterproofing, with a collar, reinforcing strip and elastic mastic. Every penetration is a deliberate hole in the layer that has to be watertight, and dealing with it using a simple bead of silicone is the usual cause of localized leaks. Includes cleaning and preparing around the penetration, fitting the collar or wall sleeve, reinforcing with a strip embedded in the waterproofing, sealing with a compatible elastic mastic and checking. Measured per penetration actually sealed.
cadenas.Sellado del perímetro de las ventanas, p: Sealing of the perimeter of the windows, to eliminate air infiltration.
Perimeter sealing of a shower with a sealing tape.
cadenas.Sellado perimetral de la zona de ducha c: Perimeter sealing of a shower area with a reinforcing strip at the junctions. Includes laying the strip and sealing. Measured per meter sealed.
cadenas.Sellado y restitución del monolitismo de: Sealing and restoring the monolithic action of cracks in concrete elements by injecting low viscosity epoxy resin through injection ports. Includes mapping beforehand and recording the width and the run of the cracks, determining whether the crack is live or dormant, since injecting a moving crack with a rigid resin makes it reappear alongside the seal, cleaning the run, fitting the ports and sealing the surface of the crack, injecting progressively from port to port until it appears at the next, setting, and removing the ports and the seal and making good the surface. Measured by the length of crack actually injected.
cadenas.Sensor de movimiento para iluminación y: Motion sensor for lighting and alarms.
cadenas.Señalización de extintores y equipos de: Signage for fire extinguishers and safety equipment.
cadenas.Señalización de seguridad pintada en pis: Painted safety signage on a floor.
cadenas.Señalización de áreas y zonas interiores: Signage for interior areas and zones.
cadenas.Señalización y balizamiento nocturno de: Signage and night-time marking of an open trench, to prevent traffic accidents.
cadenas.Señalización y delimitación de la zona d: Signage and delimitation of the work area. Includes the placing of signs and barrier tape. Measured per square meter delimited.
cadenas.Señalización y delimitación de zona de o: Signage and delimitation of the work area.
cadenas.Siembra de arbusto o árbol con hoyo de p: Planting of a shrub or tree with a planting pit, topsoil and watering. Includes excavation and planting. The plant is selected by the client.
cadenas.Siembra de arbusto o árbol en hoyo prepa: Planting of a shrub or tree in a prepared pit, with imported topsoil, staking and initial watering. Includes digging the pit far larger than the root ball, since a tight pit in compacted ground acts as a pot and the roots will not grow beyond it, improving the bottom, setting the plant at the right depth without burying the collar, backfilling with topsoil, forming the watering basin, staking in the case of trees and watering in. The plant is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured per unit planted.
Planting of a shrub or tree.
cadenas.Siembra de cerca viva o seto perimetral: Planting of a perimeter hedge with plants, on prepared ground. Includes preparation and planting. The plants are selected by the client.
cadenas.Siembra de grama en talud o pendiente co: Turfing of a slope or bank with anchorage, to prevent erosion. Includes preparation and laying.
Grass seeding on a slope or embankment.
cadenas.Siembra de plantas ornamentales en área: Planting of ornamental plants in a planted area, with preparation of the soil and watering. Includes planting. The plants are selected by the client.
cadenas.Sistema de aislamiento térmico exterior: External insulation and finish system (EIFS) to a facade, with expanded polystyrene, mesh and stucco.
Lapping and sealing of a metal roof.
cadenas.Soldadura de conexiones estructurales en: Welding of structural connections on site. Includes welding and cleaning. Measured per meter welded.
cadenas.Soldadura estructural en obra. Incluye l: Structural welding on site. Includes welding and cleaning. Measured per meter welded.
Acoustic floating floor with an underlay.
Floating floor with a double acoustic underlay.
cadenas.Suelo flotante con panel de lana mineral: Floating floor on mineral wool panels.
Catch basin in a yard or parking lot.
cadenas.Suministro de agua potable para el perso: Supply of drinking water for site personnel, in accordance with hygiene regulations.
cadenas.Suministro de botiquín de primeros auxil: Supply of a first aid kit.
cadenas.Suministro de camilla de evacuación para: Supply of an evacuation stretcher for the site, with its location signposted.
cadenas.Suministro de la dotación de equipo de p: Supply of the set of personal protective equipment for one worker: hard hat, safety boots, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection and high-visibility vest, with replacement during the works. Includes documented issue of the equipment, which evidences that the employer has met its duty, checking of condition and size, basic training in its use and replacement of damaged items through the works. Measured per set issued.
cadenas.Suministro de material granular de prést: Supply of imported granular fill from a quarry or approved supplier and its cartage and tipping on site at the stockpile indicated. Includes checking the grading and cleanliness of the material on arrival, rejecting the load if it does not comply, tipping at the agreed point and recording the volumes received against the delivery tickets. Measured by the volume of material actually received on site.
cadenas.Suministro de sacos de rafia de alta res: Supply of heavy-duty woven sacks for sorting and manual removal of site waste, stacked and labelled by type of material.
cadenas.Suministro del equipo de protección indi: Supply of personal protective equipment for work at height: full-body harness, lanyard with shock absorber and connectors. Includes inspection of the equipment before each use and checking of its expiry date, since webbing and stitching degrade under solar radiation and the equipment has a limited service life even where it looks intact, documented issue and training in the valid anchor points. Measured per set issued.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de bajante de a: Supply and installation of a rainwater downpipe. Includes assembly. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de bajante de d: Supply and installation of a 2 inch PVC waste stack. Includes assembly and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de baranda o ce: Supply and installation of a tempered glass guardrail or screen with its fixing profiles, clamps or continuous recessed channel, and a top handrail. Includes checking the anchorage and the strengthening of the support, which must be sized for the horizontal thrust required by the regulations, fitting the profile or the clamps, placing and plumbing the glass on its setting blocks, wedging and sealing, and fitting the top handrail that protects the edge. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de barra de apo: Supply and installation of a stainless steel grab bar in an accessible bathroom, anchored to the wall. The anchorage is the critical part: a grab bar has to take the full weight of a person leaning on it or falling against it, so fixing it with plastic plugs into gypsum board without internal strengthening serves no purpose beyond the decorative. Includes checking or providing the strengthening of the backing, setting out the standard height and position, drilling, mechanical or chemical anchoring depending on the substrate and load testing. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de canal de dre: Supply and installation of a precast linear drainage channel with its grate, on a concrete bed, connected to the drainage system. Includes setting out the line and the fall to the discharge point, excavation, pouring the bed, setting the channel to the exact level, which must sit a couple of millimetres below the finished paving so that water enters it rather than riding over it, the haunching, the outlet connection and fitting the grate. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de canalón de a: Supply and installation of a rainwater gutter. Includes assembly. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de celosía o ro: Supply and installation of an aluminum louver screen for permanent ventilation, with its frame and insect mesh. It is an element widely used in a tropical climate to ventilate utility rooms, stores and bathrooms that have no opening window. Includes measuring the opening, erecting and plumbing the frame, anchoring, sealing the perimeter, fitting the insect mesh on the inside face and checking the free ventilation area. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de cinta LED co: Supply and installation of an LED strip with its aluminum heat sink profile, diffuser and driver, for indirect lighting in cornices, under cabinets or in recesses. The aluminum profile is not decorative: it dissipates the heat from the diodes, and without it the strip loses brightness and service life quickly. Includes setting out, fitting the profile, laying the strip and cutting only at the marked points, the connection and siting the driver at an accessible point, and testing. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de detector de: Supply and installation of a domestic gas detector with a local alarm and communication to the home automation controller. Includes choosing the mounting point according to the density of the gas being detected, fixing, the power connection, pairing and the detection test. Measured per detector installed.

Supply and installation of a water leak or flood contact detector, with an alarm to the home automation controller. Includes the field layout at the lowest point of the area to be monitored, fixing the sensor, pairing it and the detection test by wetting the contact. Measured per detector installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de mampara de d: Supply and installation of a tempered glass shower or bath screen, with its profiles, hardware and sealing. Tempered glass admits no cutting or drilling after toughening, so every dimension and every hole must be defined before it is made: an error in measuring means the whole unit has to be remade. Includes measuring on site over the finished tiling, fitting the profiles and hardware, installing the glass on its setting blocks, adjusting the door and sealing with sanitary silicone, leaving the inner bottom edge free so that water drains back inside. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de mampara divi: Supply and installation of an office partition screen, solid, glazed or mixed, with its framing, panels, joints and trims. Its advantage is that it can be taken down and reconfigured without building work, which makes it ideal in rented premises or where the layout changes. Includes setting out the line, fixing the tracks to floor and ceiling with an acoustic seal, erecting the posts plumb, installing the panels and glass with their gaskets, adjusting the doors where there are any and the perimeter trim. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de mesón de bañ: Supply and installation of a stone, quartz or solid surface vanity top onto a unit or structure, with the basin cut-out and its profiled edge. Includes templating on site off the unit once installed, machining the cut-out for an overmount, recessed or undermount basin, offering up and leveling, sealing the cut edge and sealing the perimeter against the wall. The material is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length of vanity top.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de mesón de gra: Supply and installation of a granite, quartz or natural stone countertop onto cabinets or a supporting structure, with its profiled edge and the sink and cooktop cut-outs. Includes templating on site off the cabinets once installed and leveled, never off dimensions from a drawing, machining the cut-outs and the edge in the workshop, transport and offering up of the pieces, leveling on shims, joining lengths with color-matched adhesive and sealing the perimeter against the wall. The material is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length of countertop.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de montante de: Supply and installation of a 32 mm PPR water riser. Includes assembly. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a waste stack. Includes assembly. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de módulo de ac: Supply and installation of an on/off actuator module (relay) for controlling lighting circuits and loads, integrated into the home automation controller. Includes mounting in the panel or in a recessed box, connection of the power circuit and of the control signal, the configuration and the switching test. Measured per module installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de módulo de co: Supply and installation of a control module for a motorized blind, curtain or awning, with limit switch detection, integrated into the home automation controller. Includes checking the existing motor, mounting the module, the connection, setting the limit switches and the raising and lowering test. Measured per module installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de módulo de en: Supply and installation of a smart plug module for metering and on/off control of plug-in loads, integrated into the home automation controller. Includes checking the load to be controlled, the connection or pairing and the switching and metering test. Measured per module installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de módulo regul: Supply and installation of a dimmer module for lighting control, integrated into the home automation controller. Includes checking the compatibility of the load to be dimmed, mounting, the connection, the configuration and the dimming test across the whole range. Measured per module installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de panel táctil: Supply and installation of a wall mounted touch panel for control and display of the home automation system, with its recessed back box. Includes the field layout of the accessible mounting point, cutting the opening, flush mounting, the power and data connections, and configuring the screens and the access levels. Measured per panel installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de pararrayos c: Supply and installation of an early streamer emission lightning conductor, on a mast on the roof, with its lightning strike counter and connection to the down conductor. Includes the field layout of the air terminal to cover the protected volume, mounting and bracing the mast, fixing the air terminal, inserting the strike counter in the down conductor, the mechanical and electrical connection to the down conductor and corrosion protection of the joints. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de pararrayos t: Supply and installation of a single point Franklin lightning rod, on a support on the roof or on a parapet, with connection to the down conductor. Includes the field layout of the air terminal, mounting the support, fixing the air terminal, the connection to the down conductor and protection of the joints. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de pasarela de: Supply and installation of a communication gateway that integrates protocols from different manufacturers with the home automation controller.
