Includes choosing the gateway according to the devices to be integrated, mounting it next to the controller, the power and data connections, and pairing and verifying the devices through the gateway. Measured per gateway installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de paño fijo de: Supply and installation of a fixed aluminum and glass light, without opening sashes. Includes measuring on site, erecting and plumbing the frame, anchoring, glazing with the setting blocks and side blocks that distribute the weight of the glass without transmitting point stresses to it, wedging, sealing the perimeter and cleaning. On large lights the glass thickness is verified against its size and exposure to wind. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de protector co: Supply and installation of a surge protective device for data and telecommunication lines, with its connection to ground. Includes inserting the protector in the line, connecting the ground terminal and verifying the continuity of the signal. Measured per unit installed.

Supply and installation of a type 3 (class III) surge protective device for sensitive electronic equipment, at the point of connection of the equipment. Includes choosing the suppressor according to the equipment being protected, its connection and verifying the operation. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de puerta de cl: Supply and installation of a hinged or folding closet door, with its hardware, guides and pulls. Includes setting out and checking the actual dimensions of the opening, fitting the guides and hardware, hanging the leaves, adjusting the reveals and the alignment of the closed fronts, which is what determines the final appearance of the whole, and fitting the pulls and stops. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de repetidor o: Supply and installation of a wireless signal repeater or extender to extend the coverage of the home automation network in dwellings or premises with low signal areas. Includes choosing the intermediate installation point, fixing, the power supply and verifying the improvement in coverage. Measured per repeater installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de sensor de mo: Supply and installation of a motion or occupancy sensor, with its mounting bracket and its integration into the home automation controller. Includes the field layout of the detection point to cover the intended area, fixing the bracket, the connection and pairing with the controller, and the detection and range test. Measured per sensor installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de sensor de ni: Supply and installation of a light level sensor for automation of lighting and blinds, integrated into the home automation controller. Includes the field layout of the point with representative exposure, fixing, pairing and calibration of the trigger threshold. Measured per sensor installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de sensor de te: Supply and installation of a room temperature and humidity sensor, integrated into the home automation controller for air conditioning control. Includes choosing a representative measurement point, away from heat sources and drafts, fixing, pairing and verifying the reading. Measured per sensor installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de sensor magné: Supply and installation of a magnetic door and window contact, with its transmitter and bracket, integrated into the home automation controller. Includes the field layout of the mounting point, fixing the magnet and the transmitter in line, the connection or pairing and the opening and closing test. Measured per sensor installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de tabique móvi: Supply and installation of a movable or folding partition hung from a track, to divide or join spaces according to use. All the weight hangs from the top track, so the structure it is suspended from must be sized and checked before installation: that is the point where these installations fail. Includes checking and strengthening the structural support, fitting and leveling the track, hanging the panels on their carriers, adjusting the top and bottom seals that provide the acoustic insulation, regulating the travel and the stacking and testing the full operation. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de teclado o pu: Supply and installation of a keypad or scene controller for direct activation of preconfigured scenes, integrated into the home automation controller. Includes mounting in a recessed box, the connection, configuring the scenes and the activation test. Measured per keypad installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de termostato i: Supply and installation of a smart thermostat for air conditioning control, with time scheduling and communication to the home automation controller. Includes choosing the mounting point in a representative zone, fixing, the power connection and the control signal connection to the air conditioning unit, setting the schedules and the control test. Measured per thermostat installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de tope o mesón: Supply and installation of a countertop in the laundry or utility area, with its cut-out for the sink and its profiled edge. Includes templating on site off the base once leveled, machining the cut-out, offering up and leveling, sealing the cut edge, which is where the material takes up moisture in a permanently wet area, fixing and sealing the perimeter against the wall. The material is selected by the client and priced separately. Measured by the length of countertop.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de tubería de a: Supply and installation of insulated hot water pipework. Includes assembly and the insulation. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of 32 mm PPR water pipework. Includes assembly and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of 40 mm PPR water pipework. Includes assembly and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of copper water pipework. Includes assembly and soldering. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of surface water pipework. Includes assembly and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de tubería de d: Supply and installation of 2 inch PVC waste pipework. Includes assembly. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de ventana de P: Supply and installation of a PVC window with internal steel reinforcement, its sashes, hardware and glazing. Against aluminum it gives better thermal and acoustic performance and does not pass condensation to the frame, although it needs internal reinforcement on large sashes because the profile on its own has not enough stiffness. Includes measuring on site, erecting and plumbing the frame, mechanical anchoring, sealing the external perimeter, fitting the sashes and hardware, adjusting the compression of the closing and checking the weathertightness. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro e instalación de ventana de a: Supply and installation of an aluminum casement or awning window with its frame, sashes, opening hardware and glazing. Against the sliding type it gives far better resistance to water and air because the gasket is compressed on closing, at the cost of needing clear space for the sash to swing. Includes measuring on site, erecting and plumbing the frame, mechanical anchoring, sealing the perimeter, fitting the sashes with their hardware, adjusting the compression of the closing at every point and checking the weathertightness. Measured by the area actually completed.

Supply and installation of an aluminum sliding window with its frame, sashes, tracks, brush seals and glazing. Includes measuring the finished opening on site, never from the drawing, because the difference between the two is the usual cause of windows that do not fit, erecting and plumbing the frame on shims, mechanical anchoring, sealing the external perimeter with neutral silicone to keep water out, fitting the sashes, adjusting the rollers and brush seals and checking the sliding and the closing. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de acero de refu: Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a pile cap. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to columns. Includes cutting, bending and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a lintel. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a stair. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a mat foundation. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to slabs. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a retaining wall. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to walls. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a structural wall. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a pile. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a ring beam. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a grade beam. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a tie beam. Includes cutting, bending and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to tie beams. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to beams. Includes cutting and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
Supply and placing of reinforcing steel to a footing. Includes cutting, bending and placing. Measured per kilogram placed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de aislamiento a: Supply and installation of acoustic insulation to ventilation or HVAC ducts. Includes applying the insulation and sealing. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of acoustic insulation to a party wall. Includes the framing and placing the wool. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de aislamiento d: Supply and installation of impact sound insulation to a floor, beneath the finish. Includes laying the underlay or boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de aislamiento t: Supply and installation of insulation beneath a pitched roof, with wool boards or reflective foil. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of external wall insulation (EIFS), with boards and mechanical fixing. Includes laying the boards, fixing and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of internal wall insulation, with boards and gypsum board. Includes the framing, the boards and the board lining. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of thermal insulation to HVAC ductwork. Includes applying the insulation and sealing the joints. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of thermal insulation to a trafficable roof, with high density polystyrene. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of thermal insulation to a water tank. Includes applying the insulation and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de balconera de: Supply and installation of an aluminum sliding patio door with tempered glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de baranda de ac: Supply and installation of a steel guardrail with a wood handrail. Includes fabricating the guardrail, installation and fixing the wood handrail. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a steel guardrail with decorative perforated sheet infill panels. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a steel guardrail with wire mesh infill. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a galvanized steel guardrail with a wood handrail. Includes fabrication, installation and fixing the handrail. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a stainless steel guardrail with a handrail and horizontal tension rods. Includes fabrication, installation and tensioning. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a stainless steel guardrail with tempered glass infill panels. Includes fixing the guardrail and the glazing. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a stainless steel balcony guardrail, with posts and handrail. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a stainless steel guardrail for a pool or wet area, with posts and handrail. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de baranda de al: Supply and installation of an aluminum balcony guardrail, with posts and handrail. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de baranda de es: Supply and installation of a stair guardrail with a wood stringer and handrail. Includes fixing the guardrail and the finish. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de baranda de fo: Supply and installation of a decorative wrought iron guardrail, with posts and handrail. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de baranda de ma: Supply and installation of a wood guardrail to an internal balcony, with posts and handrail. Includes fixing the guardrail and the finish. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a wood guardrail to an internal stair, with posts and handrail. Includes fixing the guardrail and the finish. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de baranda de pr: Supply and installation of a guardrail to a roof or terrace, with posts and handrail. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de baranda de tu: Supply and installation of a galvanized steel tube guardrail, with posts and handrail. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de baranda de vi: Supply and installation of a tempered glass guardrail without vertical posts, with a bottom fixing channel. Includes fixing the channel and the glazing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de barandilla de: Supply and installation of a facade guardrail with a security guard. Includes fabrication and installation. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de botiquín de p: Supply and siting of a site first aid kit. Includes the contents and restocking them. Measured per kit supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de cabina de duc: Supply and installation of a complete tempered glass shower enclosure, with panels and door. Includes measuring, installation and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de cajón de pers: Supply and installation of a prefabricated insulated roller shutter box over the window lintel, with its access panel. Includes checking the level and the internal dimensions required by the shutter system envisaged, placing the box level with its bearings, bedding and sealing the perimeter, verifying that the cover remains accessible once the stucco is finished, a requirement without which any future repair of the mechanism means breaking out, and the trim. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de celosía cerám: Supply and installation of a ceramic facade screen. Includes the support frame and installing the units. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de celosía de fa: Supply and installation of a steel facade screen. Includes fabrication and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminum facade louver screen, with fixed or adjustable blades. Includes the support frame and installing the blades. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a treated wood facade louver screen. Includes the support frame and installing the blades. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de celosía de ma: Supply and installation of a wood louver screen for ventilation. Includes measuring, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de celosía fija: Supply and installation of a fixed aluminum louver screen for ventilation. Includes measuring, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de celosía metál: Supply and installation of a decorative metal facade screen. Includes fabrication and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de cerrajera de: Supply and installation of a protective metal grille to a window, anchored to the wall. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de cerramiento d: Supply and installation of a level access tempered glass shower enclosure. Includes measuring, installation and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a PVC louver screen to the facade. Includes the support frame and installing the blades. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminum adjustable louver screen. Includes the support frame and installing the blades. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a tempered glass screen in a corridor or gallery, with a fixing profile. Includes fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a tempered glass screen to a terrace or balcony, with a fixing profile. Includes fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de cinta o perfi: Supply and installation of an anti-slip strip or profile on the stair nosing, glued or screwed depending on the system. It is a safety element required on stairs in public use and highly advisable on any stair with a polished covering, where the risk of slipping is real. Includes setting out the line, cleaning and degreasing the seating area, cutting to length, fixing under pressure or screwing, and sealing the ends. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de columna de ma: Supply and installation of a structural lumber column. Includes installation and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de coquilla aisl: Supply and installation of pipe insulation to hot water or HVAC pipework. Includes fitting the insulation and sealing the joints. Measured per meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de correa de mad: Supply and installation of a treated lumber purlin. Includes installation and treatment. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a lumber purlin for a roof. Includes installation and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de correas de ma: Supply and installation of lumber purlins for a roof. Includes installation and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de correas metál: Supply and installation of steel purlins for a roof structure. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de defensa de fa: Supply and installation of a grille guard to the facade. Includes fabrication and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a stainless steel guard to the facade. Includes fabrication and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de dintel de mad: Supply and installation of a wood lintel to an opening. Includes placing the lintel and fixing it. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de dintel metáli: Supply and installation of a steel lintel to an opening. Includes fabricating and installing the lintel. Measured per meter constructed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de división de b: Supply and installation of a bathroom division in frosted glass, for privacy. Includes fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de división de o: Supply and installation of a glazed office division, with framing and glass. Includes the structure, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de doble acrista: Supply and installation of double glazing in existing joinery. Includes measuring and installation with sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de doble manta a: Supply and installation of a double layer of acoustic underlay beneath a floor, for greater impact sound insulation. Includes laying both layers and the finish. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de doble panel d: Supply and installation of a double layer of thermal insulation boards to a partition. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de espejo con ca: Supply and installation of a mirror with polished edges, fixed to the wall with a specific adhesive and safety clips. The adhesive must be neutral and compatible with the backing of the mirror: acid adhesives attack the silvering on the reverse and produce irreversible black staining at the edges within a few months. Includes checking that the substrate is flat, applying the adhesive in vertical beads that allow the reverse to ventilate, fitting the safety clips or profiles and sealing the perimeter. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de espejo de bañ: Supply and installation of a framed bathroom mirror, fixed to the wall. Includes preparing the substrate and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de espejo de par: Supply and installation of a wall mirror, fixed with adhesive or brackets. Includes preparing the substrate and installing the mirror. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de espejo de ves: Supply and installation of a full length dressing mirror, fixed to the wall. Includes preparing the substrate and installation. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a mirror.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de estructura de: Supply and installation of the support structure for solar panels. Includes anchoring the structure. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de extintor de C: Supply and installation of a CO2 fire extinguisher next to the site electrical panel.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de extintor de o: Supply and siting of a site fire extinguisher. Includes fixing it in place and signing it. Measured per extinguisher supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de extintor port: Supply and installation of a portable dry chemical powder fire extinguisher with its wall bracket and signage. Includes selecting the agent and the capacity according to the risk of the premises, the field layout of the position on an escape route and at the regulated height of the top of the appliance, anchoring the bracket, placing the extinguisher with its service record tag and the signage visible from the regulatory distance. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a portable fire extinguisher on site, with its signage.
Supply and installation of a portable fire extinguisher.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de herraje metál: Supply and installation of galvanized metal connectors in a lumber structure, such as a joist hanger, plate, angle or rafter connector, with the specified fasteners. Includes setting out the position, pre-drilling the lumber to the correct diameter so as not to split it, placing the connector, screwing or nailing with every hole filled, a requirement on which the declared capacity of the connector depends, and checking the tightness. Measured per unit actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de herraje o con: Supply and installation of hardware or connectors for joints in a lumber structure. Includes placing the connector. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de lana de roca: Supply and installation of rock wool to a party wall, with a support frame. Includes laying the wool and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de lana mineral: Supply and installation of mineral wool in a partition or lining, for acoustic insulation. Includes placing the wool in the cavity. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of mineral wool over a ceiling, for acoustic insulation. Includes laying the wool over the board. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de malla antiins: Supply and installation of insect mesh to a window, fixed to the frame. Includes measuring and fixing the mesh. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de malla electro: Supply and placing of welded wire mesh as slab reinforcement, on spacers that hold it in position within the depth. Includes setting out, cutting the sheets, laying them with a minimum lap of two grids tied with wire, placing the spacers and chairs, and going over the position of the mesh immediately before the pour, since it is common for it to be trodden down onto the bottom, with which it loses its function entirely. Measured by the area actually reinforced.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mampara de ba: Supply and installation of a tempered glass bath screen, hinged or fixed. Includes measuring, installation and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a tempered glass bath screen with a stainless steel profile. Includes measuring, installation and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a fixed tempered glass bath screen, with profile and sealing. Includes measuring, fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mampara de du: Supply and installation of a hinged tempered glass shower screen, with hinges and sealing. Includes measuring, installation and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a sliding tempered glass shower screen, with track and sealing. Includes measuring, fitting the track and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a frameless tempered glass shower screen, with point fixings. Includes measuring, installation and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a folding tempered glass shower screen, with hinges. Includes measuring, installation and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mampara de vi: Supply and installation of a tempered glass screen for commercial premises, with profile and door. Includes the structure, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mampara divis: Supply and installation of a tempered glass toilet partition. Includes measuring, installation and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de manta acústic: Supply and installation of acoustic underlay beneath a floating or laminate floor. Includes laying the underlay and the finish. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de manta reflect: Supply and installation of reflective foil beneath a metal roof. Includes laying the foil and the laps. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of double bubble reflective foil to a facade or roof. Includes laying and lapping the foil. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of reflective foil in the cavity of a facade or roof. Includes laying the foil and the laps. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de marco de made: Supply and installation of a wood frame for an internal door, erected plumb and bedded. Includes setting out, erection and bedding the frame. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mesón de gran: Supply and installation of a granite, quartz or natural stone countertop, cut and profiled and drilled for the sink. Includes templating, cutting and sealing. The stone is selected by the client.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de moldura decor: Supply and installation of a continuous decorative molding in plaster or polyurethane at the junction of the wall and the ceiling or as a decorative element on a substrate, bedded in adhesive compound. Includes setting out the reference line with a level, mitring the joints at internal and external corners, fixing with compound, filling and smoothing the joints between lengths until they are imperceptible, and the final going over leaving the molding ready to paint. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de moldura perim: Supply and installation of a perimeter molding at the junction of the ceiling with the walls, in gypsum, polyurethane or wood depending on the finish. It resolves the joint between two elements that move independently, which without a molding ends up cracking. Includes setting out the line with a level, mitring the corners, fixing with compound or adhesive, filling the joints between pieces and going over it to leave it ready to paint. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mosquitero co: Supply and installation of an insect screen with an aluminum frame and mesh, fixed or sliding according to the type of window. Includes measuring, assembling the frame with the mesh stretched free of creases, fitting the guides or retaining clips and checking the fit around the perimeter, since a gap of a few millimetres defeats its purpose entirely. Measured by the area actually completed.
Supply and installation of a sliding insect screen to a window or patio door. Includes measuring, fitting the track and installing the screen. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mosquitero en: Supply and installation of a roller insect screen to a window. Includes measuring, installation and adjusting the mechanism. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mosquitero fi: Supply and installation of a fixed framed insect screen to a window. Includes measuring, assembling the frame and fitting the mesh. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de mosquitero pa: Supply and installation of an insect screen to a door, with frame and mesh. Includes measuring, installation and adjustment. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de muro cortina: Supply and installation of a tempered glass curtain wall with its supporting structure. Includes the structure, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de panel de aisl: Supply and installation of insulation boards beneath underfloor heating. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de panel de lana: Supply and installation of rock wool boards to a wall or partition. Includes preparing the substrate and laying the boards. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of mineral wool boards as a floating acoustic floor. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de panel de poli: Supply and installation of polystyrene boards to a slab, before pouring. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of polystyrene boards to a floor, before the slab. Includes laying the boards and finishing the joints. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of polystyrene boards to a ceiling, before the finish. Includes laying the boards and the finish. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of extruded polystyrene (XPS) boards to a wall, bonded or fixed. Includes preparing the substrate and laying the boards. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de panel sándwic: Supply and installation of insulated sandwich panels to a roof. Includes fixing the panels and finishing the joints. Measured per square meter insulated.
Supply and installation of insulated sandwich panels to a facade. Includes fixing the panels and finishing the joints. Measured per square meter insulated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de paneles acúst: Supply and installation of acoustic panels in a room, to absorb sound. Includes fixing the panels and the finish. Measured per square meter treated.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de pasamanos de: Supply and installation of a stainless steel handrail over a stair, with brackets. Includes fixing the handrail and polishing the joints. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a steel handrail to an external stair, with brackets. Includes fixing the handrail and the anti-corrosion protection. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a wood handrail over a stair, with brackets and end caps. Includes fixing the handrail and the finish. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de paño fijo de: Supply and installation of a fixed tempered glass light in a facade, with a fixing profile. Includes fitting the profile, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de peldaño prefa: Supply and installation of a precast concrete tread over an existing structure. Includes preparing the substrate, placing and leveling the tread. Measured per tread installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de perfil de alu: Supply and installation of an aluminum or PVC trim, angle or transition profile in the tiling, bedded in the adhesive itself under the edge of the tile. It protects the arris of the tiling, which is where chipping occurs, and resolves the junction between different materials with a clean line. Includes setting out, cutting to length and mitring at the junctions, embedding it in the adhesive before bedding the adjacent tile, and cleaning. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de perfil de tra: Supply and installation of an aluminum transition profile between floors of different materials or different levels, generally in doorways. It resolves the junction by protecting the edges of both floors and taking up the difference in level, which is where trips and chipping occur. Includes setting out, cutting to length, drilling and fixing with plugs, or gluing depending on the system, and sealing the edges. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de persiana enro: Supply and installation of an aluminum roller shutter with its box and strap. Includes measuring, fitting the box and installing the shutter. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a motorised aluminum roller shutter, with control. Includes fitting the box, the motor and the programming. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de placa base co: Supply and installation of a base plate with anchor bolts for a steel column. Includes setting out, anchoring and installation. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de portón batien: Supply and installation of a two leaf hinged gate with automation. Includes fabrication, installation, the motors and the programming. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a hinged steel tube gate, with hinges and a lock. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de portón corred: Supply and installation of a sliding gate with motor and automation, track and carriers. Includes fabrication, fitting the track, the motor and the programming. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a steel sliding gate with a solid sheet leaf, with track and carriers. Includes fabrication, fitting the track and hanging the gate. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a steel tube sliding gate, with track, carriers and guides. Includes fabrication, fitting the track and hanging the gate. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de portón de ace: Supply and installation of a stainless steel access gate, with hinges and a lock. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de portón de dos: Supply and installation of a two leaf gate for vehicular access, with hinges and a lock. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de portón levadi: Supply and installation of an overhead garage door, with a counterbalance mechanism and guides. Includes fabrication, fitting the guides and hanging the door. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de portón metáli: Supply and installation of a metal garage door with a frame, in folded sheet. Includes fabrication, erecting the frame and hanging the leaves. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de portón peaton: Supply and installation of a pedestrian tube grille gate, with hinges and a lock. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta blinda: Supply and installation of a security door with a multi-point lock. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and adjusting the lock. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta de acc: Supply and installation of an access door with a panic bar. Includes hanging the leaf, the panic bar and adjustment. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of an access door with an electronic keypad or fingerprint lock. Includes hanging the leaf and the installation and programming of the lock. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of an access door with a hydraulic door closer. Includes hanging the leaf, the door closer and adjusting the closing speed. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of an access door with a fixed glazed transom. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and the glazed transom. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of an access door with a fixed glazed side panel. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and the glazed side panel. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a stainless steel access door with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame and hanging the leaf. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a wood access door with two security locks. Includes hanging the leaf and fitting both locks. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a wood access door with a peephole. Includes hanging the leaf and fitting the peephole. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a wood access door with a safety glass panel. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and the glazing. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a wood access door with a metal security reinforcement. Includes hanging the leaf, the reinforcement and the lock. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta de ace: Supply and installation of a steel door for a service entrance, with a metal frame and lock. Includes fitting and hanging the leaf. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta de clo: Supply and installation of a hinged melamine closet door, with hinges and hardware. Includes hanging the leaves and adjusting the hinges. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a wood or melamine sliding closet door, with track and hardware. Includes fitting the track and hanging the leaves. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta de coc: Supply and installation of a kitchen door with a louvered ventilation panel over, with frame and hardware. Includes fitting and adjustment. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta de ent: Supply and installation of an entrance door with a mirror or peephole. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and fitting the peephole. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta de rej: Supply and installation of an access grille gate with lock and hardware. Includes hanging the grille and fitting the lock. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta de vai: Supply and installation of a double leaf swing door for a kitchen or service area, with frame and double acting hardware. Includes fitting and adjusting the mechanism. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta doble: Supply and installation of a double wood door for a living room or main internal access, with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame and hanging both leaves. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta exteri: Supply and installation of an external PVC door with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame and hanging the leaf. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of an external aluminum door with tempered glass and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and the glazing. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta interi: Supply and installation of an internal door with concealed hinges, with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and adjusting the hinges. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of an internal door with a ventilation grille, with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and the grille. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of an internal sliding tempered glass door, with track and fittings. Includes fitting the track and installing the glass. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a painted MDF internal door, with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and adjustment. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a galvanized steel internal door, with a metal frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame and hanging the leaf. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a wood internal door with a glazed panel, with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and adjustment. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a solid wood internal door with its frame and hardware. Includes setting out, erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and adjusting the hardware. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a frameless internal tempered glass door, with pivot or hinge fittings. Includes fitting the hardware and installing the glass. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a melamine faced internal door with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and adjustment. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a white lacquered internal door with frame and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and adjusting the hardware. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta plegab: Supply and installation of a PVC folding closet door, with track and hardware. Includes fitting the track and hanging the panels. Measured per unit installed.
Supply and installation of a wood folding door for confined spaces, with track and hardware. Includes fitting the track and hanging the folding panels. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de puerta princi: Supply and installation of a solid wood main entrance door with frame and security lock. Includes erecting the frame, hanging the leaf and fitting the lock. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de reja batiente: Supply and installation of a hinged tube grille to a window, with hinges and a lock. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de reja de acero: Supply and installation of a stainless steel grille to a window, anchored to the wall. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de reja de tubo: Supply and installation of a tube grille with a frame to a doorway, with hinges and a lock. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de reja decorati: Supply and installation of a decorative wrought iron grille to a window, anchored to the wall. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de reja fija de: Supply and installation of a fixed steel tube grille to a window, anchored to the wall. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de rejilla de ve: Supply and installation of a ventilation grille in a wall, door or ceiling, with its frame and insect screen. Includes the field layout, cutting the opening with a clean cut suited to the material, fitting the frame flush, sealing the perimeter, fitting the grille and its screen and checking that the free area is the required one, since a grille of the correct overall size but with very closely spaced blades can pass only half the intended air. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de romanilla de: Supply and installation of an aluminum facade louver screen with adjustable blades. Includes measuring, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de saco big-bag: Supply and placing of a bulk bag for storing debris, with lifting loops for removal by crane.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de separador de: Supply and installation of a tempered glass room divider, with a fixing profile. Includes fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a tempered glass kitchen divider, with a fixing profile. Includes fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de soporte de ca: Supply and installation of a support bracket for a water heater. Includes anchoring. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de soporte metál: Supply and installation of a metal support bracket for equipment. Includes anchoring the bracket. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de soporte para: Supply and installation of a support bracket for a condensing unit. Includes anchoring the bracket. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de soportes anti: Supply and installation of anti-vibration mounts to HVAC or pumping equipment. Includes fitting the mounts and adjusting them. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de tapa de regis: Supply and installation of an access panel in a ceiling, for access to shut-off valves, junction boxes, air conditioning units or any element that needs maintenance. Fitting one is the difference between checking a valve in two minutes and breaking open the ceiling. Includes setting out coordinated with the real position of the element to be accessed, cutting the opening, reinforcing the edge with sections, fitting the frame flush with the board and adjusting the panel. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de techo de vidr: Supply and installation of a tempered glass roof over an internal courtyard, with its supporting structure. Includes the structure, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de toldo extensi: Supply and installation of a retractable fabric awning with arms and brackets. Includes measuring, fitting the brackets and installing the awning. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de trasdosado di: Supply and installation of a direct lining of 12.5 mm gypsum board bonded to the substrate with adhesive compound, without a metal framework. Includes checking that the wall has no active damp, applying the compound in dabs, placing the board plumb, the joint treatment and finishing the junctions. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana de PV: Supply and installation of a PVC window with double glazing. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a sliding PVC window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana de al: Supply and installation of a two sash sliding aluminum window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a single casement aluminum window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminum window opening as an awning, with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and adjusting the mechanism. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminum window with double glazing. Includes erecting the frame, installing the window and sealing the perimeter. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminum window with an integrated ventilation grille. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and the grille. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminum window with frosted glass for privacy. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminum window with safety laminated glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of an aluminum sliding window with an integrated insect screen. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and the screen. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana de ma: Supply and installation of a wood window with a louvered ventilation panel. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and the louvres. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a wood window with glass and hardware. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of a sliding wood window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana fija: Supply and installation of a fixed aluminum window for a shop or a shopfront. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana oscil: Supply and installation of an aluminum tilt and turn window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and adjusting the mechanism. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana proye: Supply and installation of an aluminum awning window with glass. Includes erecting the frame, the glazing and sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventanal de v: Supply and installation of a fixed internal glazed screen, with a fixing profile. Includes fitting the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio blinda: Supply and installation of security glass, sealed. Includes measuring and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio decora: Supply and installation of decorative etched or sandblasted glass, sealed. Includes measuring and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio en car: Supply and installation of glass in existing or new joinery, with its setting blocks, glazing beads and sealing. Includes measuring the rabbet with the expansion clearance needed, since glass fitted tight with no clearance cracks with thermal expansion, cleaning the rabbet, placing the setting blocks and side blocks in the correct position for the type of sash, wedging the glass, fitting the glazing beads and sealing the perimeter. Measured by the area actually completed.
Supply and installation of glass in joinery.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio esmeri: Supply and installation of frosted glass in an internal division, for privacy. Includes measuring and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio lamina: Supply and installation of safety laminated glass in joinery. Includes measuring, cutting and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and installation of safety laminated glass in an access door. Includes measuring, cutting and installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio templa: Supply and installation of tempered glass in existing joinery. Includes measuring, cutting and installation with sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de viga de mader: Supply and installation of a structural lumber beam. Includes installation and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
Supply and installation of a glue laminated lumber beam. Includes installation and fixing. Measured per meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación del botiquín de: Supply and installation of the site first aid kit, stocked and replenished during the works. Includes siting it in a visible and accessible place known to all personnel, periodic checking of the contents and expiry dates, replacement of what has been used and signage of its location together with the emergency telephone numbers. Measured per first aid kit installed and maintained.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación del conjunto de: Supply and installation of the set of safety signage for the site: warning, mandatory, prohibition and emergency signs, barrier tape and cones. Includes siting each sign at the point where the risk is real and visible before anyone is exposed to it, fixing the signs, delimiting the risk areas and maintaining and replacing them during the works. Measured per set of signage installed.
cadenas.Suministro y dotación de botiquín de pri: Supply and stocking of a site first aid kit, with its replenishment.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de bajante de aguas: Supply and installation of a PVC rainwater downpipe, with its brackets, bends and connection to the drainage system. Includes setting out the run, fixing the brackets to the wall at the spacing specified, assembling the lengths with the offset and shoe bends, sealing the joints and connecting to the inspection chamber or discharge point, avoiding a free discharge onto the ground, which erodes it and splashes the facade. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de baranda o pasama: Supply and installation of a stainless steel guardrail or handrail with its posts, tubes and joint fittings, anchored to the floor or to the edge of the slab. Includes setting out, cutting and polishing the tubes, erecting the posts with their bases mechanically anchored, assembling the runs with fittings or by stainless welding, polishing the joints until they match the finish of the tube and checking the stiffness against horizontal thrust. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de canal de recogid: Supply and installation of a rainwater gutter at the eaves, with its brackets, unions, stop ends and connection to the downpipe. The fall towards the downpipe is what decides whether the gutter drains or overflows: a gutter set level fills with water and leaves and ends up discharging over the facade. Includes setting out to the minimum fall to the outlet, fixing the brackets at the spacing specified, assembling the gutter, sealing the unions, fitting the stop ends and connecting to the downpipe. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de cercha de madera: Supply and erection of a lumber truss. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de columna metálica: Supply and erection of a steel column. Includes hoisting, erection and fixing. Measured per meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de correas metálica: Supply and erection of cold formed steel purlins to support the roof covering, fixed to the main structure by bolting or welding, with their sag rods and spacers. Includes taking delivery of and checking the material, setting out the purlin spacing according to the permissible span of the roof covering, hoisting and offering up, fixing to the main structure, placing the sag rods that prevent lateral buckling and checking the alignment and the plane of support for the roof covering. Measured by the weight actually erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de correas o viguet: Supply and installation of lumber purlins or joists to support a roof covering or intermediate floor, fixed to the main structure with connectors or nailing. Includes taking delivery of and selecting the pieces, setting out the spacing between centers, cutting to length, offering up and leveling, fixing to the bearings, placing the bracing or blocking that prevents lateral overturning and checking the plane of support. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de escalera metálic: Supply and erection of a steel stair with a guardrail. Includes erecting the stair and the guardrail. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of a steel stair with grating treads. Includes erection. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of a steel spiral stair. Includes erection. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of a steel escape stair. Includes erection. Measured per square meter erected.

Supply and erection of a structural steel stair of rolled section stringers, treads and landings, with its anchors to the structure. Includes checking the actual levels at the foot and the head on site before fabrication, an essential step because a steel stair admits no adjustment in place, hoisting and offering up the stringers, leveling and plumbing them, making the welded or bolted connections, fitting the treads and landings and checking that the going and the rise stay constant over the whole flight. It does not include the guardrails or the finish to the treads. Measured by the weight actually erected.
Supply and erection of a structural steel stair. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de estructura de ma: Supply and erection of a sawn lumber structure of beams, rafters and ties, with joints made using metal connectors or traditional carpentry joints. Includes taking delivery of and checking the section sizes, the moisture content and the absence of defects that would compromise capacity, cutting and shaping the members, offering up and fitting the joints, hoisting and erecting with temporary supports, final fixing, the geometric check of the assembly and adjusting the camber. It does not include the preservative treatment or the connectors, which are priced separately. Measured by the volume of lumber actually placed.

Supply and erection of a lumber roof structure of rafters, purlins and ties, with metal connector joints, and its preservative treatment. Includes selecting the members and checking the section sizes and the absence of defects, cutting and shaping, hoisting and erecting with temporary supports, fixing with the hardware, applying preservative to every face and particularly to the end grain and the bearing areas, and checking levels and falls. Measured by the area actually constructed.
Supply and erection of a wood structure.
Supply and erection of a lumber structure. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per cubic meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de estructura metál: Supply and erection of structural steelwork with full anti-corrosion protection. Includes erection and protection. Measured per square meter erected.

Supply and erection of a metal roof structure of trusses, beams and purlins in rolled or cold formed sections, with welded or bolted connections and an anti-corrosion primer. Includes checking the bearings and the base plates, hoisting and offering up the members, temporary bracing during erection, making the final connections, the geometric check of levels and falls and touching up the anti-corrosion protection where it has been affected by welding. Measured by the weight actually erected.
Supply and installation of minor metalwork for a canopy, with welded sections. Includes fabrication, installation and anchoring. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a roof. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a lightweight intermediate floor. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a stair. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a canopy. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a mezzanine. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork for a lightweight roof. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per square meter erected.
Supply and erection of structural steelwork. Includes hoisting, erection and bolting. Measured per kilogram erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de forro de placa d: Supply and installation of a lining of fiber cement board on a metal framework, for wet areas and premises exposed to splashing. Includes the framework held off the wall, screwing the board with the appropriate screws, the joint treatment with mesh and sealing the junctions. Measured per square meter of lining completed.

Supply and installation of a lining of fiber cement board on a framework, as a substrate for tiling in a shower or bath area. Includes the framework, screwing the board, the joint treatment with mesh and sealing the joints prior to the waterproofing and the tiling. Measured per square meter of lining completed.

Supply and installation of a lining of 12.5 mm gypsum board on battens fixed to the wall, creating a minimum cavity for running services. Includes fixing the battens plumb with plugs, running the services through the cavity, screwing the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de forro ignífugo d: Supply and installation of a fire resistant lining of 15 mm fire rated gypsum board, on a metal framework, for the protection of services, ducts or structure. Includes the framework, screwing the board, the joint treatment and sealing the service penetrations. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de interruptor dife: Supply and installation of a high sensitivity ground-fault circuit interrupter in the panel, with its connection and testing. It is the device that protects people against electric shock: circuit breakers protect the installation, not the person who touches it. It is required on circuits for bathrooms, kitchens and outside. Includes mounting on the rail, connecting the phases and the neutral respecting the order, checking that no neutral of the protected circuit is joined downstream to another circuit, an error that causes intermittent tripping impossible to diagnose, and testing with the test button and with measuring equipment. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de interruptor term: Supply and installation of a circuit breaker in the panel, with its connection and identification. The rating of the breaker has to match the size of the conductor it protects, not the consumption of the equipment: an oversized breaker stops protecting the cable and turns it into the fuse of the circuit. Includes mounting on the rail, connecting the phase and tightening it to torque, labelling the circuit on the schedule and the tripping test. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de llave de paso de: Supply and installation of a 20 mm PPR ball valve, concealed in the wall, to isolate the water supply by zone. Includes opening up the recess, fitting it into the pipework by heat fusion, checking that the handle operates, the watertightness test and making good the wall, leaving the escutcheon flush. Measured per unit installed and tested.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de marco y contrama: Supply and installation of a metal frame and subframe to a door opening, cast into the masonry or anchored to the wall. The subframe is placed as the wall is built and ends up cast in, so its setting out and plumb condition all the joinery that follows: a subframe that is out of plumb cannot be put right afterwards. Includes setting out, plumbing with temporary bracing, bedding the fixing lugs into the masonry, the anti-corrosion protection and fitting the final frame. Measured by the perimeter length of the opening.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de pasamanos de mad: Supply and installation of a wood handrail over an existing guardrail or directly onto a wall on brackets. Includes setting out a constant height following the pitch of the stair, cutting and joining the lengths with hidden joints, fitting the brackets at the spacing that avoids flexing, fixing the handrail, sanding the joint until it cannot be felt, which is how a handrail is judged, and varnishing. Measured by the length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de placa de yeso la: Supply and installation of 12.5 mm gypsum board on battens to make a wall level and to conceal exposed services without resorting to wet trades. Includes setting out, fixing the battens, running and protecting the services, screwing the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of substrate made level.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de portón corredizo: Supply and installation of a metal sliding gate for vehicular or pedestrian access, with its frame, track, wheels, guides and stops. Includes fabricating or taking delivery of the frame, constructing or checking that the running track is perfectly level, since any unevenness makes the gate run by itself or jam, fitting the wheels and the top guides, adjusting the travel and the stops, the anti-corrosion primer and checking the operation. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de protector contra: Supply and installation of a type 1 (class I) surge protective device at the main distribution board, with its connection to ground. Includes choosing the model according to the expected discharge current, mounting on the rail of the board, connecting the phase, neutral and ground conductors with the specified cross section and as short as possible, and the operational test. Measured per unit installed.

Supply and installation of a type 2 (class II) surge protective device at a secondary distribution board, with its connection to ground. Includes mounting on the rail of the board, connecting the conductors with the specified cross section and as short as possible, and the operational test. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de puerta corrediza: Supply and installation of a sliding closet door with its top and bottom tracks, carriers, door leaves and pulls. Includes leveling the top track, which carries the weight and on which it depends that the leaves neither drop nor drag, fitting the bottom guide, hanging the leaves on their adjustable carriers, adjusting the verticality and the overlap between leaves and fitting the stops and brush seals. Measured by the area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de rampa metálica e: Supply and erection of a structural steel ramp. Includes erection. Measured per square meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de tablero eléctric: Supply and installation of an electrical panel with protective devices. Includes assembly and the connection. Measured per unit installed.

Supply and installation of an electrical distribution panel, flush or surface mounted, with its neutral and ground busbars and spare space for additions. Includes setting out at a point that is accessible and not obstructed, forming the recess and mounting flush, bringing the conduits in tidily, fitting the busbars, connecting the circuits with the cables dressed and identified, fitting the labelled circuit schedule, which is what allows anyone to find a fault without testing each one, and the continuity and insulation test. Measured per panel installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de tragante, boquil: Supply and installation of a roof drain with its leaf guard, integrated into the waterproofing. It is the point through which all the water leaves the roof and also the one that fails most, whether through blockage or through a poor seal at the junction with the membrane. Includes forming the recess at the low point, placing the unit with its flange embedded between the layers of waterproofing, sealing the junction, fitting the grate and checking the discharge with a water test. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de trasdosado autop: Supply and installation of a self-supporting lining with a double layer of 12.5 mm gypsum board, to increase the acoustic mass and the impact resistance. Includes the framework held off the wall, screwing both boards with staggered joints, the joint treatment on both layers and finishing the junctions. Measured per square meter of lining completed.

Supply and installation of a self-supporting lining of gypsum board with internal reinforcement in wood or a metal profile, for the later anchoring of loads such as hung cabinets, televisions or shelving. Includes the framework, placing the reinforcement in the position intended for the loads, screwing the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining completed.

Supply and installation of a self-supporting lining of 12.5 mm gypsum board with a 60 mm mineral wool panel in the cavity, for thermal and acoustic insulation. Includes the framework held off the wall, placing the mineral wool panel in the cavity without compressing it, screwing the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining completed.

Supply and installation of a self-supporting lining of 12.5 mm high hardness gypsum board, for substrates subject to impact and circulation areas such as corridors and common areas. Includes the framework held off the wall, screwing the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining completed.

Supply and installation of a self-supporting lining of standard 12.5 mm gypsum board, on a galvanized steel framework held off the wall, without insulation. Includes setting out the framework with studs every 60 cm, fixing the base and head tracks to the floor and to the ceiling with a perimeter sealing strip, screwing the board, treating the joints with compound and tape, and finishing the junctions with the walls and the ceiling. Measured per square meter of lining completed.

Supply and installation of a self-supporting lining of 12.5 mm moisture resistant gypsum board, for bathrooms, kitchens and premises subject to condensation. Includes the framework held off the wall, screwing the board, the joint treatment with compound and tape suited to moisture and finishing the junctions. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de trasdosado de me: Supply and installation of a party wall lining over a party wall, with a self-supporting framework, a 60 mm mineral wool panel and 12.5 mm gypsum board, to insulate against noise and damp from the adjoining property. Includes the perimeter strip, placing the panel, screwing the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining completed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de viga de amarre m: Supply and erection of a steel tie beam. Includes erection and fixing. Measured per meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de viga metálica. I: Supply and erection of a steel beam. Includes hoisting, erection and fixing. Measured per meter erected.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje del juego de acceso: Supply and fitting of the set of complementary accessories and hardware for the cabinetry: pulls, organizers, soft close hinges, lift systems and stops. Includes setting out, pilot drilling with a jig to ensure the pulls line up across every front, which is what is immediately obvious in a well finished cabinet, fitting and final adjustment of the catches and soft closers. Measured per set installed.
cadenas.Suministro y tendido de bajante de cobre: Supply and installation of a bare copper down conductor from the air terminal through to the grounding system, with its fixing clips held off the wall face. Includes the field layout of the shortest and straightest route, fixing the clips, running the conductor without tight bends and the connection at both ends. Measured per linear meter of down conductor installed.
cadenas.Suministro y tendido de conductor captad: Supply and installation of a bare copper air termination conductor on the ridge and the perimeter of the roof, with its fixing supports. Includes the field layout of the route, fixing the supports, running the conductor and the joints to the down conductors. Measured per linear meter of conductor installed.
cadenas.Suministro y transporte de arena lavada: Supply and cartage of washed sand to the site. Includes supply and cartage. Measured per cubic meter supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y transporte de gravilla a ob: Supply and cartage of gravel to the site. Includes supply and cartage. Measured per cubic meter supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y transporte de material de p: Supply and cartage of imported fill to the site.
Supply and cartage of imported fill to the site. Includes supply and cartage. Measured per cubic meter supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y transporte de piedra picada: Supply and cartage of crushed stone to the site. Includes supply and cartage. Measured per cubic meter supplied.
cadenas.Suministro, corte, doblado, armado y col: Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement of 4,200 kg/cm² yield strength to columns, to the bending schedules. Output per kilogram is among the lowest of any reinforcement on site because of the vertical work and the number of stirrups. Includes cutting and bending the bars and stirrups, assembling the cage at the stirrup spacing indicated and closing it up in the confinement zones at the ends, tying with wire at every intersection, lapping with the starter bars from the footing or the level below at the specified lap length, placing spacers on all four faces and plumbing and bracing the cage before the formwork. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement of 4,200 kg/cm² yield strength to footings and foundation bases, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending on site or taking delivery of the steel pre-bent, assembling the mats tied with wire at every intersection around the perimeter and at alternate intersections within, placing spacers to give the specified cover on every face, bracing the cage so that it cannot move during the pour and checking the schedule before the concrete is authorized. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed, excluding offcuts and laps not allowed for in the schedule.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to a reinforced concrete stair, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling the main mat of the inclined slab with its distribution steel, placing the reinforcement at the breaks in the geometry where the line of the steel must follow the direction of the tension, anchoring at the bearings at the foot and the head, tying with wire and placing spacers. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to a mat foundation, in top and bottom mats to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling the mats with wire ties, placing bottom spacers and the chairs or supports that hold the top mat at its level during the pour, the edge and corner reinforcement, and checking the schedule and the cover before the concrete is authorized. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to a solid slab, in top and bottom mats to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling the mats with wire ties, placing bottom spacers and the chairs that hold the top mat at its level, the reinforcement over the supports and around the edges of openings, and going over the position of the cage immediately before the pour. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to a retaining wall, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling the two vertical mats with their starter hooks lapped to the starter bars from the footing, tying with wire, placing spacers on both faces to give the cover, the edge and corner reinforcement, and checking that the mat on the earth side falls on the correct tension face, a frequent error with serious consequences. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement in two vertical mats to a structural concrete wall, to the bending schedules. Includes cutting and bending, assembling both mats with their vertical and horizontal bars, placing the tie hooks or chairs between the mats that stop them spreading during the pour, lapping with the starter bars from the level below, placing the edge reinforcement and the confinement elements at the ends, placing spacers on both faces and checking the schedule. Measured by the weight of steel actually placed.

Supply, cutting, bending, assembly and placing of deformed bar reinforcement to tie beams, to the bending schedules. Beam reinforcement takes longer per kilogram than footing reinforcement because of the stirrups and the work in a narrow trench.
